jobs.sourceTitle: The Sleep Company - Senior Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
About The Sleep Company

The Sleep Company is India's fastest-growing D2C sleep and comfort brand, built on patented Smart GRID technology and trusted by over 5 lakh customers. Our portfolio spans mattresses, pillows, toppers and ergonomic seating, sold across online channels and a growing network of experience centres nationwide. We move fast, think big and put the consumer at the centre of everything we do.

Role Overview

As Senior Product Manager, you will own the product roadmap for your category or platform. You will work with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Operations and Retail to build products and experiences that customers love and that grow the business.

Key Responsibilities

Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for your area
Turn customer insights, data and business goals into clear priorities
Write clear PRDs and user stories, and manage the backlog
Lead product launches from idea to release, working closely with Engineering and Design
Track key metrics such as conversion, retention and NPS, and act on what the data shows
Run experiments and A/B tests to improve the customer journey across web, app and stores
Work with Marketing, Supply Chain and Retail teams to keep product, pricing and experience aligned
Study the market and competitors to spot new opportunities
Mentor junior product managers and share best Product management experience, ideally in D2C, e-commerce or consumer products
Proven record of launching and scaling products
Strong analytical skills and comfort with tools such as GA, Mixpanel or SQL
Clear communication and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders
Sound understanding of the omnichannel customer journey
Bachelor's degree required; MBA is a plus

At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward‑thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting‑edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long‑term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.

From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.

About The Department

Franklin Templeton’s AI and Digital Platform team for Sales and Distribution builds enterprise AI, data, workflow, and digital products that help drive business growth and operational effectiveness. The team includes product managers, engineers, data specialists, AI practitioners, architects, and governance partners who work together in small, cross-functional teams. The environment is collaborative, evidence-driven, and focused on solving high-value business problems through responsible innovation.

How You Will Add Value?

Core Responsibilities

You will define product strategy, vision, metrics, and roadmaps.
You will lead discovery across business domains and user groups.
You will validate opportunities and prioritize high-impact investments.
You will establish product requirements for AI, data, and workflow solutions.
You will define and monitor product performance metrics.
You will lead product launches, adoption, and scaling activities.
You will drive measurable business outcomes.

Strategic Responsibilities

You will align stakeholders on priorities, risks, and decisions.
You will balance value, feasibility, dependencies, and capacity.
You will guide cross-product planning and investment decisions.

Team & Collaboration

You will mentor product managers and elevate team practices.
You will communicate strategy and progress to senior leaders.

What Will Help You Be Successful in This Role?

Experience, Education & Certifications

Degree from a premier business school (IIT/IIM or equivalent).
8+ years of product management experience.
Experience leading enterprise software, platform, data, or AI products.
Experience building product strategies and long-term roadmaps.
Experience delivering measurable business outcomes.

Technical Skills

Product strategy and roadmap management.
Stakeholder management.
Generative AI and AI-enabled products.
Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI ecosystems.
APIs, cloud technologies, and data platforms.
Product analytics and experimentation.
Evidence-based prioritization and decision-making.

Soft Skills

Executive stakeholder influence.
Strategic thinking.
Communication and storytelling.
Analytical problem solving.
Collaboration across complex organizations.

Work Shift Timings - 2:00 PM - 11: 00 PM IST

At Franklin Templeton, we believe your benefits should support your life, your goals, and your future. That’s why we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to help you thrive both personally and professionally.

Professional development growth opportunities through in-house classes and over 150 Web-based training courses
An educational assistance program to financially help employees seeking continuing education

Job Description Summary

The Product Manager for AI at GE Vernova plays a crucial role in the development and execution of AI-powered products that transform business processes. This role is essential to our mission of pioneering AI-driven innovation and enhancing user experiences across the enterprise.

The Product Manager will work with across GE Vernova and with the AI Portfolio Manager to identify, prioritize and build out AI products. These products (several) focus on delivering improvements and value through the lens of the Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) framework, measuring the impact of AI initiatives.

Additionally, the Product Manager facilitates cross-business coordination, leveraging AI applications to drive operational improvements and foster innovation across Vernova. Expertise in AI, combined with strong business acumen, is pivotal in translating complex technical challenges into strategic opportunities that propel the organization forward. These duties extend to not only internally developed solutions, but also to external suppliers (e.g. 3rd party software).

As a GE Vernova accelerator, GE Vernova Advanced Research is driving strategy and leading research & development efforts to execute on the business’s mission to help power the energy transition. We forge the collaborations and help invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero-carbon future.

Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernova’s businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 entities at the forefront of technology to execute on 150+ energy-focused projects. Collectively, these research programs and initiatives aim to solve near term technical challenges, deliver next generation product advances, and drive long term breakthrough innovation to enable more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

Product Ownership and Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business, engineering, and research, to develop and execute product roadmaps that align with strategic objectives.
Roadmap input: Provide input, alongside the Portfolio manager, to build the product roadmaps
Technical Collaboration: Work closely with data scientists, IT, and designers to ensure the development of robust AI solutions, maintaining technical rigor and introducing new methods for verifying success and identifying risks.
User Experience: Focus on delivering exceptional user experiences by understanding and addressing user needs in AI applications.
Cross-Business Coordination: Support the coordination of AI applications to drive improvements and innovations across Vernova.
Data-Driven Decision Making: Utilize data analytics to measure product performance and make informed decisions. Define and monitor metrics and KPIs to ensure the success and impact of AI initiatives.
Post-Launch Support: Monitor product performance post-launch, gather user feedback, and iterate on product features to enhance value delivery.
3rd party solutions: Oversee the interjection of AI products coming from 3rd party software suppliers and determine best technology fit.

Position Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, with 10-15 years' relevant experience.
Experience with GE/GE Vernova highly preferred.
Business Acumen: Ability to integrate business strategy with technical initiatives.
Leadership: Proven leadership in managing cross-functional teams and projects.
Communication Skills: Excellent communication and presentation skills to engage with diverse stakeholders and occasionally C-Suite executives.
Experience building and deploying AI applications.
Problem-Solving Skills: Analytical skills to identify and solve risks and challenges.
Technical Proficiency and Data-Driven Mindset
Must be willing to work out of an office located in Bangalore, India.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

At eBay, we connect tens of millions of buyers and sellers globally, processing billions of dollars in trade. Our platform powers trusted commerce at global scale, and we continue to invest in the products and platforms that make those experiences simpler, smarter, and more reliable.

The Billing Platform sits at the intersection of commerce, payments, and financial systems. It powers critical capabilities across billing, invoicing, financial transaction processing, and revenue-related workflows, enabling scalable and reliable financial operations across eBay.

We are seeking an ambitious, impact-driven Product Manager to lead critical capabilities for this platform. If you thrive on solving complex, large-scale platform challenges and translating intricacy into seamless user experiences, this is your opportunity to build at immense scale.

Why this role matters

As a Product Manager on the Payments Platform team, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of core billing initiatives. You will partner with cross-functional teams across engineering, finance, tax, and operations to architect modern, scalable platform capabilities that elevate trust, efficiency, and reliability for millions of users.

What you'll do

Define & Drive Strategy: Partner with payments, finance, operations, and business units to discover high-value platform opportunities and translate them into a clear product vision.
Architect Scalable Solutions: Collaborate closely with engineering to build reusable, API-based charging, invoicing, and transaction workflows that support diverse global use cases.
Lead Execution: Write clear, high-quality product requirements and user stories, set measurable success metrics, and manage end-to-end rollouts across complex multi-system dependencies.
Prioritize for Impact: Balance trade-offs between innovation, platform resilience, risk mitigation, and execution speed to maximize partner and customer value.
Optimize with Data: Leverage operational metrics, analytical insights, and partner feedback to continuously evaluate product performance and guide rapid iteration.
Champion Quality & Trust: Proactively identify risks, resolve complex cross-functional alignment blockers, and continuously elevate product quality and platform experience.


What we're looking for

Platform Product Experience: 3+ years in product management, with a proven track record of shipping technical, platform-based products.
FinTech / Payments Foundation: Practical experience in payments, billing, invoicing, or related financial transaction processing environments.
Technical Execution: Strong ability to translate business capabilities into technical requirements and partner effectively with engineering teams on architectural choices.
Analytical Rigor: Skilled in using data to quantify opportunities, validate hypotheses, and measure product performance metrics.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of driving consensus across matrixed teams.


Bonus

Hands-on experience with API-based architectures, eCommerce platforms, or large-scale multi-sided marketplaces.
Familiarity with financial reporting, ERPs, revenue recognition, tax integrations, or controllership domain workflows.
Exposure to compliance, audits, or billing-adjacent platform domains.


Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Nians is looking for a results-driven Product Manager to define product strategy, manage roadmaps, and drive end-to-end product development. The candidate will work closely with engineering, design, marketing, and business teams to deliver customer-centric digital products and technology solutions.

Responsibilities:
Define product vision, strategy, roadmap, and priorities.
Gather customer requirements and translate them into product specifications.
Collaborate with development and design teams to ensure timely delivery.
Manage product backlogs, sprint planning, releases, and product launches.
Track product performance, analyze user feedback, and identify growth opportunities.
Explore AI, automation, SaaS, CRM, and digital technology solutions.
Align product development with business goals and customer needs.

Requirements:
2-4 years of experience in product management or technology-driven roles.
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and product lifecycle management.
Experience with product roadmaps, PRDs, user stories, and analytics.
Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

About Ema

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

Product Strategy & Vision

In this role, your work will involve: 

Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap based on market trends, customer needs, and company goals.
Work closely with senior management and stakeholders to align the product strategy with business objectives.

Market & User Research

Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify opportunities, gaps, and market demands.
Understand customer needs and translate them into product requirements.
Define user personas and use cases to ensure products meet user expectations.

Product Development

Collaborate with engineering, design, and marketing teams to deliver products that are functional, user-friendly, and aligned with business goals.
Prioritize product features, enhancements, and bug fixes based on customer feedback, technical feasibility, and business impact.
Manage the product development lifecycle, including setting timelines and milestones.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with cross-functional teams (sales, marketing, customer support) to ensure successful product launches.
Communicate progress, roadblocks, and product updates with stakeholders and teams across the organization.
Lead and facilitate communication between technical and non-technical teams.

Performance Tracking & Iteration

Define key performance indicators (KPIs) for product success.
Track product performance post-launch and gather customer feedback for continuous improvement.
Iterate on product features based on data insights and feedback.

Stakeholder Management

Present product updates, roadmaps, and strategies to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
Manage relationships with external vendors and partners as needed.

Go-to-Market Strategy

Collaborate with the marketing and sales teams to define go-to-market strategies for product launches.
Ensure proper communication and training for internal teams and customers during product releases.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field. An MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.
5+ years of experience in product management, preferably in the tech or software industry.
Strong understanding of product development processes, including agile methodologies.
Ability to work with cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority.
Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
Strong organizational and project management skills.

Preferred Skills

Familiarity with tools like JIRA, Asana, or other project management platforms.
Knowledge of user experience (UX) design principles.
Experience working with APIs and technical teams.
Data-driven mindset with experience in A/B testing and user research methodologies.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

Description

Imagine being at the forefront of revolutionizing the tax industry with latest technologies. As a Product Manager – Technical in the FinTech Tax Technology team, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of tax products and solutions that empower businesses and individuals to navigate the ever-evolving landscape of tax regulations and compliance requirements.

In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for driving the product strategy, technical roadmap, and delivery of our innovative tax product suite. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and subject matter experts, to translate complex tax requirements into robust, scalable, and secure software solutions and ensure our products meet the evolving needs of our customers and comply with complex tax regulations.

Join our team and be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking organization that values excellence, collaboration, and a passion for leveraging technology to simplify the complexities of tax.

Key job responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager - Tech, you will lead new, large product initiatives to define the long-term strategy and vision to meet emerging customer needs and tax regulations. You will handle complex product development and business management scenarios, proactively identifying gaps/opportunities to then develop a suite of products to solve the problems.

Define product strategy, roadmap, and vision for tax product portfolio
Capture and translate complex tax requirements, regulations, and customer needs into technical specifications, user stories, and innovative user experiences
Drive alignment across cross-functional teams on product feature, business, and strategies
Manage end-to-end product development lifecycle
Build, maintain, and communicate comprehensive product launch plans, tracking deliverables, milestones, risks, and bottlenecks
Own customer engagement and communication for product updates
Establish KPIs, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvement of product performance

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience managing technical products or online services
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
Masters of Business Administration (MBA) in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
Experience bringing technology products to market in a fast-paced environment
Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions

Job Requirements

Job Requirements

About The Role

A Product Manager - Savings Account is responsible for driving the growth, innovation and expansion of the Savings Account product portfolio through product enhancements, lifecycle management and the development and launch of new offerings. The role includes managing the product lifecycle and leading the implementation of product enhancements and strategic initiatives, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements, business objectives and evolving customer needs. It also involves defining and executing product strategies, supported by long-term planning, market analysis and cross-functional collaboration, to drive business growth, customer acquisition and engagement.

Key Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

Manage the Savings Account product portfolio, including product lifecycle management, performance monitoring and continuous enhancement of existing products.
Identify customer, business and market opportunities to enhance product propositions, improve customer experience and drive portfolio growth.
Define product requirements, prepare business requirement documents (BRDs) and work with Technology and Operations teams to deliver product features, upgrades and process enhancements.
Lead the development, implementation and rollout of product enhancements, new features and new product offerings across channels.
Drive end-to-end execution of product enhancements, including requirement gathering, stakeholder alignment, user acceptance testing, implementation and post-launch monitoring.
Conduct market research, customer analysis and competitor benchmarking to identify trends, assess product performance, and recommend improvements.
Collaborate with Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, Analytics and Business teams to ensure successful delivery and adoption of product initiatives.

Conduct product awareness and knowledge-sharing sessions for internal stakeholders and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

What We Are Looking For

Education

Strong analytical, problem-solving and data interpretation skills.

Excellent stakeholder management, communication and collaboration skills.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Product Manager III – InsurTech

The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travellers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.

InsurTech Product team creates peace of mind so travellers can book and travel with confidence. This is an InsurTech and FinTech platform role: you will be part of the team building the platform capabilities that support protection products across Expedia Group brands. You will partner closely with engineering to shape the foundational capabilities, integrations, and ways of working that allow our protection products to scale reliably, stay compliant across markets, and drive business growth. Your efforts will focus on simplifying complex systems, unlocking new capabilities across insurance and fintech, and leading product direction with data-driven insights to maintain Expedia's competitive edge in the travel market.

In This Role, You Will

Organise the platform vision into key themes that solve for both short-term business needs and long-term scalability.
Own end-to-end the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of InsurTech and FinTech platform capabilities that support protection products across Expedia Group brands and markets.
Partner with engineering to define and build reusable capabilities that reduce complexity, improve the traveller experience, and protect margins
Translate strategy into clear product requirements, enabling dependency management and planning across complex, multi-team programmes, including large-scale platform migrations.
Represent InsurTech with partner platform teams (e.g. checkout, payments): manage inbound requests, negotiate ownership, investment and support models, and continuously improve ways of working.
Collaborate with suppliers and internal cross-functional peers (e.g. engineering, design, data science, commercial, finance, legal) to deliver customer-centric products and experiences.
Influence at all levels—align stakeholders, drive decisions in ambiguity, and communicate clearly with distinct audiences from execs to engineers.

Experience And Qualifications

You have 5+ years of product management experience, including platform or technical product management, building capabilities used by multiple products or teams; fintech/insurtech, payments, marketplace, or e-commerce experience strongly preferred. 
You have a master's or bachelor's degree in business, economics, engineering, data science or a related field; or equivalent related professional experience. 
You are a strategic platform thinker with a proven track record of connecting technical capabilities to business outcomes, and owning strategy, roadmap, and key metrics for your product area. 
You have strong technical acumen to partner with engineering on APIs, integrations, data models, architecture trade-offs, and platform constraints; experience integrating third-party suppliers is a plus. 
You are familiar with ML/AI-powered products and responsible AI practices; able to collaborate with data teams on feasibility, model health, and ethics. 
You are a skilled negotiator and influencer, with a track record of aligning priorities, ownership, and investment with partner teams without direct authority. 

Preferred Qualification

You have experience operating in regulated environments (e.g. insurance, payments, financial services) and managing compliance risk; this is a strong plus. 
You demonstrate data fluency: you define metrics, design experiments, interpret results, and use insights to make trade-offs; comfort with analytics tools/SQL is a plus. 
You have bias to action, being familiar with methods and approaches needed to get things done in a collaborative, lean and fast-moving environment. 

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Senior Product Manager, Loyalty

Team Description

The role sits within the Loyalty Product organization and is specifically focused on assurance products strategy for members across Hotels.com, Vrbo, and BEX. The broader loyalty team currently works across multiple areas including loyalty for other brands such as Expedia & Vrbo, 3P partnerships, AI/ML-driven personalization, promotions & incentives etc.

The team partners closely with brand GMs, marketing, engineering, design, finance, legal and other product stakeholders to improve the loyalty experience, drive clearer value for travelers, and increase outcomes such as active members, first transactions, repeat bookings, and direct return behavior for Expedia Group.

What You’ll Do

Define the product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for loyalty assurance products across brands.
Set clear priorities across protection and flexibility offerings.
Partner with InsurTech, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Brand teams to drive discovery, delivery, and launch readiness.
Define the member value proposition and eligibility model for assurance benefits within One Key.
Use data, experimentation, and market insight to evaluate product fit and member impact.
Drive the in-product member experience for assurance products.
Align stakeholders around strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and investment decisions.
Manage ambiguity, unblock dependencies, and keep multiple workstreams moving in a highly matrixed environment.
Apply AI/ML and rule-based contextualization and personalization to improve member relevance and business outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

A clear cross-brand assurance strategy that connects loyalty benefits to repeat booking and member retention.
A prioritized roadmap that balances member value, commercial outcomes, and delivery feasibility.
Strong partnership with InsurTech that results in scalable, compliant, and brand-appropriate launches.
Measurable improvement in loyalty engagement, repeat purchase, and assurance adoption and usage.
Clear alignment across business and technical stakeholders throughout discovery and delivery.

Who You Are

An experienced product leader with a track record of owning complex, technical, cross-functional products.
Strong at product vision, roadmap definition, prioritization, and stakeholder alignment.
Comfortable operating across brands, geographies, and business models.
A clear communicator who can simplify sophisticated product and commercial concepts.
Data-driven, customer-focused, and comfortable making decisions in ambiguity.
Skilled at leading through influence and collaborating across functions without direct authority.

Minimum Qualifications

7+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience leading complex product initiatives.
Experience leading highly technical consumer or platform products in a matrixed organization.
Proven track record of building and scaling products with multiple stakeholders and business constraints.
Experience partnering with Engineering, Design, Analytics, and business stakeholders.
Strong written, verbal, and stakeholder communication skills.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with travel, fintech, insurance, loyalty, or marketplace products.
Experience working with partner-led product models and regulated or quasi-regulated offerings.

Summary

Cloud Common Services (CCS) builds the essential cloud infrastructure and platform services that power the Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP). At the heart of this is Atmos, Guidewire's "PaaS within SaaS" layer — built on AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker — that automates the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized core applications, cloud-native services, and associated workloads.

As Platform Product Manager, you'll own the roadmap and delivery for a defined set of platform capabilities within CCS/Atmos that internal engineering teams and external insurer customers rely on every day. Working closely with senior product leaders, engineering, and SRE, you'll help shape how Guidewire delivers infrastructure as a product — with a focus on developer experience, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.

This role is a strong fit for someone with a solid technical foundation in cloud infrastructure who is building their product management career and wants to grow into platform strategy ownership.

Job Description

We are looking for candidates with 6–10 years of overall work experience, including a minimum of 1–2 years in Product Management (or a product-adjacent role such as technical program management, solutions engineering, or platform engineering with product responsibilities).

Own the roadmap and backlog for one or more platform service areas within CCS/Atmos — such as deployment tooling, observability, Kubernetes-based compute, networking, or shared platform services — in alignment with the broader CCS product strategy.
Develop a working understanding of the Guidewire Cloud ecosystem, the multi-tenant/hybrid-tenancy architecture, and the needs of both internal developer teams and external customers.
Treat platform infrastructure as a product: identify friction in developer workflows and define capabilities that improve productivity, self-service, and time-to-value.
Partner with Engineering, SRE/Operations, UX, and Enablement to discover, test, refine, and prioritize solutions.
Write clear feature requirements and user stories with well-defined use cases and acceptance criteria.
Contribute to roadmap planning by bringing customer insight, usage data, and operational feedback to prioritization discussions.
Support the launch of new platform services and features; define success metrics, measure adoption and performance, and iterate.
Be a power user of the platform capabilities you build.
Communicate progress, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to engineering teams and stakeholders.
Embrace a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI — using emerging tools and data-driven insights to improve how you and your teams work.

We're looking for someone who

Has experience working on platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing products — as a product manager, or in a technical role (engineering, SRE, DevOps, solutions/technical program management) with a demonstrated interest in moving into product management.
Has a solid understanding of AWS services and cloud-native architectures (AWS Cloud Practitioner certification is a plus).
Understands containerization and container orchestration (Docker & Kubernetes) and the basics of running services at scale.
Is familiar with core platform concerns such as CI/CD, observability/monitoring, networking, multi-tenancy, reliability (SLO/SLA), and cost awareness.
Can translate customer and developer needs into clear requirements and acceptance criteria.
Is comfortable managing and prioritizing a product backlog and working in agile delivery cycles.
Collaborates effectively with engineering and operations teams through design, development, testing, release, and maintenance.
Uses data and customer feedback to inform decisions and measure outcomes.
Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Is eager to learn, take ownership, and grow into broader product strategy responsibilities.

Nice to have

Exposure to identity and access management concepts — SAML, OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SSO, SCIM — and how they apply to platform services.
Experience with load balancing and networking in cloud environments.
AWS Cloud Practitioner (or higher) certification.
Familiarity with Aha! and JIRA.
Prior experience in a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
Ability to travel up to 5% as needed.

Role-specific competencies

Customer Need: Comfortable engaging with internal developer teams and external customers to understand their needs and document use cases.
Product Execution: Ability to turn prioritized needs into well-specified, deliverable increments and see them through to launch.
Collaboration: Works well across cross-functional teams and builds trust with engineering partners.
Results Driven: Tracks adoption and outcomes, learns from data, and iterates.
Communication: Able to explain both the technical detail and business value of platform work to the appropriate audience.
Motivation: A genuine interest in the craft of product management and in platform/infrastructure as a product.

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

About The Position

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager - Endpoint Security Cloud Platform to be part of making that happen.

Position Overview

The Senior Product Manager, Endpoint Security Cloud Platform will own the cloud backend capabilities that underpin Arctic Wolf’s Endpoint Security portfolio, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, and agent lifecycle management. Based in Bangalore, India, this is a technical, product-facing role that partners closely with Engineering and Architecture to define requirements, make product decisions, and deliver at scale. The role will be central to two of the team’s most significant initiatives: defining the cloud side of our unified agent strategy, consolidating four endpoint agents and two cloud backends into a single agent and a single cloud; and planning and executing the migration of several million endpoints from one cloud backend to another.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership – Cloud Platform

Own the product definition, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for Endpoint Security cloud backend capabilities, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, multi-tenancy, and agent lifecycle management (deployment, upgrade, and health).
Translate Endpoint Security strategy into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, partnering with Engineering and Architecture on system design, data flows, APIs, and technical trade-offs.

Agent Consolidation & Cloud Migration

Define the cloud-side requirements for the unified agent initiative, consolidating four endpoint agents and two cloud backends into one agent and one cloud, including feature parity, data model alignment, and deprecation sequencing.
Plan and drive the migration of several million endpoints between cloud backends, including migration strategy, phasing, rollback and risk mitigation, customer and partner impact, and success criteria.

Role: Product Manager, Trading Infrastructure
You will own the professional and algo trading surface of Arrow: the products where latency, data depth and execution quality are the whole point. Five areas sit in your remit, and each one is a product in its own right.

TBT charts: In-house tick-by-tick charting: sub-second candles, order-flow and footprint views, replay, with chart latency held close to feed latency
HFT algos: In-house algos and a strategy marketplace retail traders can deploy on co-located infrastructure, with risk guardrails and exchange approvals built in
API latency: The trading and market-data APIs: round-trip order latency at p50/p95/p99, WebSocket feed delivery, SDK ergonomics, rate limits, sandbox
Colocation access: Productizing exchange co-lo for clients: rack and VM offerings, provisioning, cross-connects, pricing and compliance
Tick-level data: Dissemination of full-depth, tick-by-tick market data: live feeds, snapshots, historical tick archives, entitlements and fan-out at scale

As one of the first Product Managers on the Arrow team, you will work directly with the CTO, quants, the HFT desk, and connectivity engineers. You won't just follow a product process—you will help build it from scratch. In this role, you will spend just as much time analyzing order books and latency data as you do planning roadmaps.

You'll do:
Own the TBT charting roadmap. Define what a tick-by-tick chart must do for a scalper that a one-second chart cannot: sub-second aggregation, order-flow and footprint views, volume-at-price, replay, and multi-instrument sync. Set and track the chart-update latency budget against the raw feed.
Bring in-house HFT algos to retail. Scope the first algos and the strategy marketplace: which strategies ship first, how traders discover, configure and deploy them on co-located infrastructure, what the kill switches and position limits look like, and how each algo clears SEBI and exchange approval before launch.
Own API latency as a product metric. Define the order round-trip and feed-delivery SLOs at p50, p95 and p99, instrument them end to end (client, gateway, OMS, exchange), publish them transparently, and drive the engineering backlog that moves them.
Run the developer experience for the trading API: Go and Python SDKs, WebSocket market-data streams, docs, sandbox, rate limits, static-IP and algo-tagging requirements, and onboarding for API clients from first key to first live order.
Productise colocation access. Turn exchange co-lo into something a professional client can buy: rack, VM and managed-server tiers, provisioning SLAs, cross-connects, pricing, and the compliance and audit trail each exchange requires.
Own tick-level data dissemination. Define the market-data products: full-depth live feeds, TBT versus snapshot tiers, historical tick archives, entitlements and billing, and the fan-out architecture needed to serve thousands of clients without adding latency.
Talk to professional traders every week: scalpers, option market-makers, quants and API users. Turn what they say and what their order flow shows into specs engineers can build from without a second meeting.
Write crisp PRDs with success metrics, latency budgets, failure modes and exchange-rule constraints (algo approval, order-to-trade ratios, throttles, circuit limits, square-off timings) spelled out.
Partner with the CTO, the HFT desk and exchange-connectivity engineers on trade-offs between latency, throughput, reliability and features; a feature that adds 200 µs to the hot path is a product decision, not just an engineering one.
Define and track the metrics that matter: order latency and feed latency by percentile, API uptime, active API clients, algo deployments and their P&L distribution, co-lo utilisation, and tick-data subscriptions.

What we're looking for:
4-8 years in product, trading-systems engineering or quant/HFT trading, with at least 3 years owning a technical or fintech product end to end.
You understand market microstructure. Order books, tick data, matching-engine behaviour, order-to-trade ratios, what co-lo buys you and what it does not. You know why a scalper cares about the difference between 1 ms and 3 ms.
Hands-on with trading APIs. You have built or run something against a broker or exchange API, understand REST versus WebSocket versus binary protocols, and can read a latency histogram and say where the time went.
Fluent with data. You can write SQL, pull your own latency and order-flow data, and argue a prioritisation call with numbers rather than opinions.
Shipped in a regulated environment. You can read a SEBI or exchange circular on algo trading, API access or market data and turn it into a product requirement.
Clear writer. Your PRDs, SLO definitions and API docs get read and acted on by engineers and traders alike.
Bias for shipping. You have taken a feature from a trader complaint to production in weeks, not quarters, and iterated after launch.

Nice to have:
Worked at an HFT or prop firm, an exchange, a market-data vendor or an algo trading platform.
Familiarity with NSE/BSE TBT and snapshot feeds, exchange co-lo offerings and the NNF/API order-tagging framework.
Have run a live strategy through a broker API, even a small one.
Options knowledge beyond the basics: Greeks, market-making, hedged-position margin.
Python or Go, enough to prototype an API call, parse a tick file or build your own latency dashboard.

First dedicated PM in the seat. You define the role, the process and the roadmap, and you report to the CTO.

Who We Are

This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

The Team

We are constantly innovating — challenging the way we, and the industry, think about cybersecurity. Our engineers don’t shy away from building products to solve problems no one has pursued before. We define the industry instead of waiting for directions. We need individuals who feel comfortable in ambiguity, excited by the prospect of a challenge, and empowered by the unknown risks facing our everyday lives that are only enabled by a secure digital environment.

Job Summary

As a Principal Product Manager for the AI Security team, you will lead the strategy and development for the innovative PRISMA AIRS product line. You will define and deliver competitive service offerings by deeply understanding customer needs through collaboration with sales, marketing, and engineering. Your role is crucial in creating marketing materials and evangelizing services to enhance the customer product experience. Success in this position hinges on your ability to guide and influence diverse cross-functional teams across the organization.

Understand AI systems, their differentiation from traditional software, and the evolving AI threat landscape.
Serve as a strategic advisor, providing expert guidance to various cross-functional teams.
Translate customer insights and competitive intelligence into differentiated product designs for engineering teams.
Drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment, demonstrating resilience and a high bias for action to meet goals.
Use data analytics to monitor metrics, identify trends, and influence the AI Security product roadmap.
Oversee daily product management, including feature sets and overall strategy for the AI Security space.
Lead feature prioritization and make critical tradeoff decisions to align with strategic goals.
Support the full New Product Introduction (NPI) lifecycle, including Beta testing and feature ramp-up.
Conduct market analysis, develop requirements, and create business cases to define product strategy and positioning.
Maintain a strong customer focus through active engagement and relationship development.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field.
Minimum of 14 years of product management experience.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a history of data-driven decision-making.
Demonstrated experience with enterprise-grade products and platforms.
Proven ability to own the full product lifecycle, from conception to launch.
Experience working effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
Experience thriving in an agile environment with rapid iteration and collaborative work sessions.
A demonstrable and consistent track record of success in previous roles.

Advanced degree such as an MBA or equivalent.
Product management experience for AI/ML or Cybersecurity-driven products.
Experience with cybersecurity and AI/ML-powered solutions for an enterprise platform.

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.

The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.

We are seeking an enthusiastic, analytical, and resourceful product manager to join our Investment Services Technology team, partnering closely with the Compliance team, based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. This position offers the opportunity for broad exposure to the firm’s trading, operations, and software development groups, as well as the chance to manage real-time issues related to the firm’s expanding suite of global investment products in a dynamic, constantly evolving regulatory environment. The role offers an inclusive and dynamic environment, with a focus on improving technology for efficiency, control, and scalability. The ideal candidate will bring exceptional product management fundamentals, experience in process optimization and workflow automation, and the judgment to operate effectively in a highly regulated and confidential environment with diverse stakeholders.

WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:

You will drive technological solutions that support critical compliance functions across the firm, collaborating with cross-functional teams — engineering, design, business, and other front- and back-office partners — to develop and launch new products and features. You will develop and maintain a strategic product roadmap that aligns with the firm's overall goals and evolves continuously based on user feedback, prioritization, and other factors while working with senior leadership in Compliance. You will evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, replace legacy and vendor systems with scalable in-house platforms, and develop AI- and data-enabled tools for monitoring, detection, and reporting — balancing near-term regulatory and operational needs against long-term strategic and architectural objectives, often building scalable infrastructure in areas with limited existing technology while serving as a senior point of coordination for compliance technology transformation. Furthermore, you will monitor product usage and feedback to identify areas for improvement and address technical debt in a timely manner, maintain product documentation (requirements documents, user guides, and more), conduct training and enablement as a subject-matter expert for the product suite, and manage product launches and backlogs — prioritizing features and enhancements based on end-user feedback and business needs.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

The ideal candidate should hold-

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and operational concepts clearly, influence decision-making through both meetings and written artifacts, and engage effectively with diverse stakeholder groups

Demonstrated expertise in workflow automation and process optimization, applying structured approaches and tools to improve efficiency, transparency, and control
A solid understanding of operational workflows within hedge funds and investment management firms, including how controls, data integrity, and regulatory considerations shape technology and product design

Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.

Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.

It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.

Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.

In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.

About The Role

Nium moves billions in payments every month for some of the world’s most demanding companies — banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms operating across 100+ countries. We built that on fiat rails. The next layer is digital currency: stablecoins, on/off-ramps, and card products that let customers spend, settle, and move value in USDC as naturally as they do in dollars or euros.

We’re hiring a Staff PM – Digital Assets to own that build. Not the strategy document — the actual product. If you’ve shipped a stablecoin wallet, a crypto-funded card, or a fiat-to-digital conversion flow and you understand what it takes to get that through compliance, engineering, and go-live in a regulated environment, this is your rol

Responsibilities

Own stablecoin-funded card products — physical and virtual cards funded from or settled in stablecoins (USDC and equivalents). Define the product, get it through compliance, ship it
Build digital asset support into Nium’s multi-currency wallet — hold, convert, and send stablecoins alongside fiat currencies. This is a wallet extension, not a new product line
Design and ship on/off-ramp flows — fiat-to-digital and digital-to-fiat conversion, including rate logic, settlement timing, and failure handling. Own the full customer experience
Drive stablecoin-based cross-border settlement — payin and payout flows that clear on digital rails. Work with network and settlement teams to make these production-grade
Evaluate and integrate custodians, exchanges, and blockchain infrastructure — as infrastructure decisions with integration timelines and SLAs, not as partnership strategy
Own compliance product design for digital assets — MiCA, VASP frameworks, travel rule, FinCEN requirements. These get built into the product spec, not handed off to legal


Requirements

7+ years in product management. Fintech, crypto infrastructure, or payments required
You’ve shipped at least one digital asset product in production — a stablecoin wallet, a crypto card, an on/off-ramp, or a digital settlement rail. Not a prototype. Not a strategy deck
Strong payments foundation — cross-border flows, FX, wallets, settlement mechanics. Digital assets are an extension of this, not a departure from it
Regulatory fluency as a product skill — you know what MiCA, travel rule, VASP registration, and FinCEN MSB requirements mean for your spec, your launch sequence, and your go/no-go decisions
Experience working with custodians, blockchain infrastructure, or card networks — enough to evaluate integration tradeoffs and write requirements that engineering can build against
Comfortable operating in high-ambiguity, high-compliance environments — you know when to move and when to wait for legal sign-off


How We’ll Measure Success

Volume settled on digital rails (stablecoin payins + payouts) — tracked quarterly against target
Card activation rate and spend volume for stablecoin-funded card products
On/off-ramp conversion rate and time-to-settlement
Time-to-integration for new custodian or blockchain network partners
Regulatory coverage: number of markets with compliant, live digital asset product


What We Offer At Nium

We Value Performance: Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.

We Care for Our Employees: The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our year-end shut down. We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).

We Upskill Ourselves: We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.

We Celebrate Together: We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!

We Thrive with Diversity: Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.

Beware of recruitment scams: Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites. Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Mandatory Skills and Experience
The candidate should have 8+ years of overall experience, including at least 5 years as a Product Manager owning a product or platform end to end.
Strong insurance domain knowledge is required, with a preference for health insurance underwriting experience covering the proposal lifecycle, medical underwriting, pre-existing diseases (PED), loadings, exclusions, counter-offers and moratorium.
The candidate should have working knowledge of IRDAI regulations and Master Circulars relevant to health insurance.
The candidate should demonstrate proven ownership of product roadmaps and the ability to prioritise competing business-as-usual (BAU) and transformation demands.
The candidate must be able to write clear and concise product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories, business rules and acceptance criteria.
Strong data fluency is required, including the ability to define metrics, build funnels, interpret dashboards and work with SQL and Excel.
Experience with rules engines or decisioning systems and API-based integrations is required.
The candidate should have Agile/Scrum product ownership experience and be familiar with tools such as Jira and Confluence.
The candidate should have a track record of delivering measurable outcomes such as turnaround time (TAT), conversion, cost improvements and loss ratio, rather than focusing only on feature delivery.
Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills are essential.
Good-to-Have Skills and Experience
Hands-on exposure to AI/ML in underwriting, including risk scoring, document AI/OCR or GenAI copilots for underwriters.
Experience with core policy administration systems such as TCS BaNCS or similar platforms.
Familiarity with business rules engine (BRE) platforms such as Drools, IBM ODM, Pega or equivalent.
Understanding of actuarial and pricing concepts, including how underwriting decisions affect the loss ratio.
Experience with medical or diagnostic networks, tele-underwriting and PPMC operations.
Exposure to data platforms, business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau, and experimentation.
Knowledge of the DPDP Act and privacy-by-design principles.
Relevant certifications such as CSPO, SAFe POPM or Pragmatic, as well as Licentiate or Associate qualifications from the Insurance Institute of India, are advantageous.
Prior experience managing a small team of Product Managers or Business Analysts.
An MBA from a reputed institute is preferred.
Qualifications
The candidate should hold a bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. An MBA is preferred. Insurance-specific certifications such as III or CII are an advantage.
Behavioural Competencies
Outcome ownership and a bias for action, with the ability to make trade-offs when data is incomplete.
Structured problem-solving and first-principles thinking when redesigning processes.
The ability to influence without formal authority across business teams, IT and vendors.
High integrity and sound judgement in matters involving risk and compliance.

Own Every Moment at NetApp

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.

Job Requirements

Experience or interest in data protection, backup, disaster recovery, or or related infrastructure domains


Education

Product management, technical, or customer-facing experience in enterprise software or infrastructure.

Why You'll Thrive at NetApp

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.

Our culture

About Revun

Revun is a SaaS, CRM, AI, and property operations platform that brings together leasing, maintenance, payments, owner/vendor payouts, communications, compliance, reporting, AI automation, portals, dashboards, integrations, and multiple user roles into one connected operating system.

Revun is a complex operational platform requiring strong product judgment, workflow design, technical understanding, and the ability to translate real business operations into clear software requirements.

About The Role

Revun is hiring a Senior Technical Product Manager to own product requirements, roadmap priorities, workflow design, UX alignment, and product delivery.

You will work directly with leadership to determine what should be built, why it should be built, how it should work, and what should be prioritized.

You will work closely with the Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead, who owns technical architecture and engineering execution, while providing product direction to UX/UI, engineering, and QA.

This is not a backlog administration role. We are looking for someone who can challenge unclear ideas, simplify complex workflows, make strong product decisions, and turn business requirements into clear development execution.

What You Will Do

Own the product roadmap, backlog, feature priorities, and product-side launch readiness.
Translate business needs into clear requirements, workflows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and development tickets.
Determine what should be built now, delayed, simplified, or removed.
Map complex workflows across CRM, leasing, maintenance, payments, reporting, AI, integrations, and portals.
Define product requirements across multiple user roles, permissions, dashboards, and workflows.
Provide product direction to UX/UI and ensure designs reflect user needs, business rules, workflows, and edge cases.
Work with the Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead on technical feasibility, dependencies, risks, estimates, and trade-offs.
Coordinate with frontend, backend, AI/automation, integration, QA, and DevOps resources throughout development.
Define requirements for AI-powered features and determinewhere AI, automation, or human review should be used.
Work with QA on test scenarios, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and user acceptance testing.
Review completed functionality and determine whether it meets the original product and business requirements.
Identify product gaps, workflow conflicts, unclear requirements, unnecessary complexity, dependencies, and launch blockers.
Conduct product discovery and use stakeholder feedback, user needs, workflow analysis, and product data to guide decisions.
Define measurable success criteria for major features and evaluate performance after release.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field. A technical degree is strongly preferred.
7+ years of product management, technical product management, or comparable product ownership experience.
4+ years working on complex SaaS, CRM, workflow automation, marketplace, fintech, PropTech, field-service, or multi-user operational platforms.
Strong experience creating product requirements, workflows, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, and development-ready specifications.
Experience taking complex features from initial business requirements through UX/UI, development, QA, release, and post-release evaluation.
Strong working knowledge of APIs, integrations, databases, permissions, system dependencies, AI functionality, and modern SaaS platforms.
Experience working closely with senior engineers, software architects, QA, and Product/UX/UI Designers.
Experience with product discovery, user research, backlog management, prioritization, UAT, release planning, and launch readiness.
Ability to challenge unclear requirements, unnecessary complexity, unrealistic timelines, and weak product decisions.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Strongly Preferred

Experience with PropTech, real estate technology, property management software, fintech, field service, compliance, marketplace, or operational SaaS platforms.
Experience with AI/LLM workflows, AI automation, document processing, communications, task routing, reporting, or decision support.
Experience with payments, payouts, reconciliation, accounting, ledger, or other financially sensitive workflows.
Experience inheriting an existing SaaS platform and identifying product gaps, workflow problems, UX issues, and launch blockers.
Experience preparing a complex SaaS product for commercial launch.
Experience working with remote or offshore engineering teams.
Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership.

Ideal Candidate

You are not simply someone who manages tickets or maintains a backlog.

You Should Be Able To Determine

What problem are we actually solving?
Is this the right solution?
Does the workflow make sense?
What happens in the edge cases?
Is this important enough to build now?
Can it be simplified?
How will we know whether it worked?

You should be comfortable challenging assumptions and turning incomplete business ideas into clear product decisions that designers, architects, developers, and QA can execute.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will understand the existing platform, clarify major workflows, improve product requirements and backlog quality, align UX and engineering priorities, identify launch-critical gaps, and establish a clear path toward commercial launch.

Leadership should have clear visibility into what is being built, why it is being built, what is blocking progress, and what should happen next.

Schedule

Full-time, Monday to Friday, remote.

Availability during core Eastern Time business hours is required.

How To Apply

Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you’ll receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to join our dynamic and collaborative Product Organization. Staff Product Managers will organize, define, prioritize and lead the execution of a complex product roadmap, usually responsible for more than one product in the product line. Staff Product Managers lead product teams and coach/mentor Product Owners and Product Managers. Staff Product Managers are key members in aligning solution designs into new platform services and identifying new product opportunities to drive new business growth. 

Your Mission

Successful delivery of multiple products within product line
Act as SME for product while growing knowledge of adjacent products
Outline product strategy (customer value, competitive position, business value)
Define product goals and themes (OKRs)
Drive product initiatives and lead geographically distributed cross‑functional teams
Drive alignment across product teams and GTM teams, contributing to GTM plan with Product Marketing, Sales, and Partner teams
Set and clearly communicate development objectives, needs, and status of projects to internal stakeholders and customers
Act as primary escalation point for product line, de‑escalating and communicating

You Are

A subject matter expert in your product line, who can handle significant complexity in your role and exercises independent and sound judgement. Someone who thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment while juggling multiple personas and prioritize competing tasks and deadlines to deliver on aggressive timelines. You are capable of supervising activities, projects, and teams. 

Your Experience Includes

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical or business field
7 – 10 years of relevant experience in an enterprise software development environment
4+ years of experience as a Product Manager
Experience managing product roadmaps and document goals and themes, for more than one product in a product pipeline
Proven ability to develop product strategies and effectively communicate recommendations to executive management
Proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle
Experience planning for “end of life” in product and leading EOL processes across stakeholders

About The Role

We’re hiring a Forward Deployed Product Manager to discover, build, and scale new businesses at Certify. You will work closely with Sales and customers to find valuable problems we are well positioned to solve, rapidly prototype solutions, and turn the strongest opportunities into products customers buy and use.

Certify’s provider data infrastructure and customer relationships give you a foundation for building new offerings. AI and agentic systems expand what is possible: you can explore a customer’s workflow, put a working prototype in their hands, and test an idea at a pace that would have been difficult even a year ago. You will help determine where that speed can create a lasting business advantage.

You’ll be deep in the context with our customers and have strong start points from our sales and partnership teams. That means joining discovery and sales conversations, observing operational workflows, building and iterating prototypes, and staying involved through delivery and adoption. You will connect those experiences to business decisions about whom we serve, what we offer, how we price it, and where we invest.

This is a role for someone with strong product judgment, practical fluency in agentic AI, and the instincts of a business builder. You should be as comfortable prototyping with a customer as you are challenging a business case or partnering with Engineering to turn an early solution into an enterprise grade product.

What You Will Do

Find and validate new businesses

Partner closely with Sales, Business Development, and customers to identify emerging opportunities. Understand the user’s problem, the buyer’s priorities, and where Certify’s data and platform give us an advantage.
Develop a clear point of view on which opportunities to pursue. Test willingness to pay, market demand, pricing, cost to serve, and the potential to expand beyond the first customer.
Define what must be learned before increasing investment. Make thoughtful decisions about which ideas to iterate, scale, or stop, and communicate the reasoning clearly.
Partner with existing product teams where this creates leverage and accelerates the business

Prototype and learn with customers

Work directly with customers to understand how work gets done, including the exceptions and manual steps that shape their day. Translate that understanding into solutions they can try.
Use AI coding tools and agentic systems to build working prototypes quickly. Iterate in live customer conversations and test the workflow with realistic data and clear measures of value.
Partner with Sales to make new offerings tangible through demonstrations and early customer engagements. Align on scope, success criteria, and delivery commitments so we can move quickly and earn customer trust.

Deliver And Scale What Works

Stay accountable from the first experiment through delivery, adoption, and expansion. Work with Engineering, Design, Operations, and Client Success to turn validated ideas into products we can support and sell repeatedly.
Make clear tradeoffs between the needs of an early customer and a broader product opportunity. Identify what should become a reusable capability and where a tailored solution makes commercial sense.
Bring technical judgment to agentic products, including tool and API integration, evaluations, human review, permissions, and failure handling. Partner with Engineering to establish the quality needed for production use.
Shape the offering and launch with our commercial teams, including positioning, packaging, pricing, and a repeatable approach to implementation. Help the field understand who the product is for and how to demonstrate its value.
Measure customer value and business results, including adoption, time saved, operational quality, revenue, expansion, and margin. Use those results to guide the next investment.

About You

You love building products and businesses. You have taken an ambiguous opportunity from discovery to a shipped product and can explain what customers gained and how the business benefited.
You have 5+ years of product management experience, or founder experience with comparable ownership, in SaaS, healthtech, or another complex software business.
You are practically fluent in AI and agentic systems. You use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools to build and test ideas, and have examples of working prototypes or products you helped deliver.
You earn trust with customers and Sales, ask sharp questions, and bring an independent product perspective. You know how to support a commercial opportunity while making sound product and investment decisions.
You bring clarity to complex situations and work well with engineers. You can move between a customer conversation, workflow details, technical tradeoffs, and a business case.
You are curious, experimental, and comfortable with uncertainty. You learn quickly, act on feedback, and follow through on the details that make a product useful and a business viable.

Experience That Would Help

Launching new paid offerings, working with early customers, or building businesses that combine software and operational services.
Healthcare technology, provider data, or regulated enterprise workflows; experience deploying AI agents or automation into real customer operations.

At Certify, we’re building with intention and taking care of the people doing the work.
