jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
About DevRev

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

About The Role

DevRev is hiring a Senior Product Manager for the Computer Data and Analytics Platform – a hands-on product leader who will own the trusted data foundation that makes Computer precise, useful, and safe across every experience.

Computer should not merely report on work. It should understand customer, product, and operational context; reason across it; and help people and agents take the right action. The Computer Data and Analytics Platform makes that possible through a unified, governed, low-latency data layer that turns data from DevRev and connected systems into durable context for humans, applications, analytics experiences, and AI agents.

You will define how data is captured, modeled, governed, queried, and activated across DevRev. The platform will support operational reporting and embedded analytics, while also enabling grounded, context-rich agentic conversations in Computer – helping users ask questions, investigate work, receive trusted answers, and take safe actions in the flow of work.

This is a unique opportunity to build the foundation for an AI-native operating system – where customer context, product telemetry, structured records, events, and machine reasoning converge.

What You'll Do

Lead the Computer Data and Analytics Platform vision and roadmap - Define and scale the platform that transforms operational and product data into reliable, reusable context for analytics, dashboards, applications, APIs, workflows, and Computer. Set a clear strategy for data modeling, query experiences, data freshness, governance, and activation.
Build trusted, AI agent-ready data foundations - Own the product direction for a platform that preserves source-of-record fidelity while making data easy to discover, understand, and use. Shape the abstractions that let Computer and people work with data confidently – including lineage, permissions, access controls, quality signals, and semantic definitions.
Define the data lifecycle from capture to activation - Guide the end-to-end path from source systems and event capture through change data capture, durable query representations, and governed serving layers. Ensure the platform supports real-time and historical workloads without forcing every experience to depend on a single data store or query engine.
Enable precise answers and safe actions with Computer - Partner with the AI platform to make natural-language data experiences dependable. Drive capabilities that allow Computer to retrieve grounded context, generate useful analysis and visualizations, and execute approved actions through clear permissions, guardrails, and auditability.
Build high-performance, flexible query experiences - Shape the experience for interactive analysis, embedded analytics, and developer workflows. Leverage in-process and local query technologies, including DuckDB where appropriate, to deliver responsive, secure experiences for applications, notebooks, and agents.
Design for multiple personas and levels of abstraction - Serve developers, data and product teams, support leaders, GTM teams, and operators. Provide opinionated defaults and ready-to-use experiences for common workflows, while preserving composability for technical users building applications, integrations, and custom data products.
Champion a platform-grade developer experience - Treat data as a core developer product. Prioritize intuitive APIs and SDKs, documentation, modular primitives, observability, extensibility, and a clear path from prototype to production.
Drive platform-wide interoperability - Ensure the Computer Data and Analytics Platform works seamlessly with DevRev’s product data, customer records, connected systems, applications, workflows, and AI agents. Establish the shared data contracts and platform capabilities that power a complete customer and product understanding.

What You'll Bring

8+ years of product management or complementary experience building data platforms, developer platforms, analytics products, AI products, or infrastructure products.
Experience defining products that span data ingestion, data modeling, data quality, governance, querying, and downstream activation.
Strong understanding of modern data architectures, including source systems, event streams, change data capture, lakehouse-style storage, query engines, and serving layers.
Familiarity with embedded and in-process analytics, such as DuckDB, and the trade-offs between local, operational, and centralized query patterns.
Practical understanding of AI-native data experiences, including grounded retrieval, natural-language querying, Text-to-SQL, evaluation, permissions, and safe action execution.
Ability to design products that serve both technical and non-technical users without compromising trust, usability, or extensibility.
A record of partnering deeply with engineering, design, AI/ML, security, and go-to-market teams to ship reliable, scalable platform products.
Strong product judgment in ambiguous, technical environments – with the ability to turn an architectural direction into clear customer value, milestones, and adoption measures.

Why This Role

You will define the data foundation that makes Computer increasingly capable over time. Your work will enable a future where every interaction can benefit from complete, trusted context: Computer can answer with evidence, surface insights at the right moment, automate approved workflows, and help teams build faster on a shared data platform.

This is not a traditional BI role. It is a chance to build the connective layer between DevRev’s product, customer, and operational data – and the intelligent experiences that turn that data into outcomes.

How do we work? 

Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger

Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly

We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

Own the outcome

Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

That’s DevRev!

DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

Overview

Come join the QuickBooks Desktop team (part of Mid-Market Segment) as a Senior Staff Product Manager, AI Migration & Onboarding Agent.

QuickBooks is Intuit's flagship accounting software, powering millions of small and mid-sized businesses globally. The Mid-Market team is driving a critical transformation: migrating customers from Desktop to cloud-native platforms.

Today, migration from desktop to cloud is high-friction and high-touch. It slows conversion and strains support capacity. Your mission is to change that by building an AI Agent that guides customers through the entire migration journey, from readiness assessment to data migration, configuration, and first productive use.

This is a zero-to-one role. You will own the vision, strategy, and execution for this agent, working at the intersection of LLMs, agentic architectures, and accounting domain knowledge to turn migration from a barrier into a growth engine.

Responsibilities

Own the AI Migration Agent end-to-end: Define vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI agent that guides customers through complex product migrations, from readiness assessment through post-migration validation.
Design for scalability and reuse: Architect the agent as a modular platform capability that can be extended to multiple source systems, customer segments, and net-new onboarding journeys.
Define AI/Human collaboration: Design patterns where the agent handles routine tasks autonomously and escalates complex decisions to domain experts, support teams, or customers.
Build the knowledge backbone: Own the agent's knowledge base, including product mapping logic, feature parity data, gap analysis rules, and domain-specific reasoning.
Drive adoption and migration velocity: Define success metrics (completion rate, time-to-value, CSAT, support deflection) and build feedback loops to continuously improve agent performance.
Lead cross-functional execution: Align engineering, AI/ML, design, data science, sales, care, and operations around an agent-first migration strategy. Partner with platform teams to leverage shared AI infrastructure.
Close the customer insight loop: Research migrating customers, domain experts, and internal teams to uncover friction points and benchmark against AI-driven migration experiences in SaaS and Fintech.

Qualifications

Experience: 10+ years in product management with 2+ years shipping AI agent, conversational AI, or intelligent automation products in B2B SaaS or Fintech.
AI Agent expertise: Deep understanding of agentic architectures, LLMs, RAG systems, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation pipelines. Experience defining guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human-in-the-loop escalation patterns.
B2B SaaS Migration experience: Track record building customer migration, data portability, or onboarding products. Understands the complexity of moving business-critical data between systems at scale.
Platform thinking: Designs modular, reusable agent capabilities that serve multiple source systems, customer segments, and journey types.
Customer empathy: Deep experience with SMB/mid-market customers. Understands the friction and anxiety customers face when switching business-critical software.
Analytical rigor: Comfortable defining and tracking agent performance metrics like accuracy, task completion, escalation rate, and time-to-value.
Cross-functional influence: Proven ability to align engineering, AI/ML, design, and GTM teams around a shared product vision in a matrixed organization.
Education: Undergraduate degree required (technical discipline preferred). MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

Preferred

Hands-on experience with LLM-based agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent).
Familiarity with prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and AI evaluation techniques.
Experience in accounting, ERP, or financial software domains.
Top-Tier or International MBA or other Advanced degree preferred.

Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

Principal PM AI Governance - Runtime Governance

About OneTrust

OneTrust helps organizations operationalize trust through privacy, security, data governance, and responsible technology adoption. As AI governance becomes a board-level and regulatory priority, customers increasingly need structured ways to understand AI systems, assess risk, monitor behavior, and demonstrate compliance over time.

The Challenge

We are looking for a Principal PM to help shape the future of our AI Governance product with a specific focus on observability and enforcement across AI systems. This role is for a product manager who can connect strategy, execution, and technical depth to help us build the right platform capabilities for the next generation of governed AI.

You will help run squad activities and drive clarity across product, engineering, design, and go-to-market stakeholders to ensure we are building capabilities that are durable, differentiated, and ready for where AI governance is heading next. The ideal candidate brings a strong product mindset along with a background in cybersecurity, SIEM and AI/MLOps.

Your Mission

Own and drive product direction for core AI Governance capabilities related to observability, policy enforcement, controls, and signal-driven governance across AI systems.

You Will Help Define How Customers Can

Gain visibility into AI systems, models, agents, and their behaviors over time using SIEM solutions 
Collect and operationalize governance signals across development, deployment, and runtime environments 
Enforce policies to build responsible AI and secure-AI use cases 
Investigate risk, drift, policy violations, and operational issues with confidence 
Connect governance requirements to measurable controls, workflows, and evidence for compliance outcomes 

What You’ll Do

Partner with engineering and design to run an effective squad cadence, maintain clarity on priorities, and turn ambiguous opportunities into actionable product direction 
Define product requirements and roadmap themes for AI observability, enforcement, and governance workflows 
Translate cybersecurity, platform, and AI/MLOps concepts into customer-facing product capabilities with special focus on SIEM and SOAR capabilities. 
Identify the right future-facing platform investments to support governance for models, agents, prompts, evaluations, runtime signals, and policy controls 
Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to understand market needs, technical constraints, and regulatory expectations 
Drive decisions on what signals should be captured, how they should be normalized, and how they should power governance actions 
Ensure product choices balance near-term customer value with long-term platform extensibility 
Support launches, customer conversations, and strategic storytelling for this area of the portfolio 

What Success Looks Like

The squad is operating with strong product clarity, execution discipline, and measurable outcomes 
Customers can observe meaningful AI system behavior and governance signals in a way that supports action, not just reporting 
Enforcement capabilities are practical, scalable, and aligned to real enterprise governance workflows 
The product roadmap anticipates where AI governance is going, not just where the market is today 
Cross-functional partners see this product area as strategically coherent, technically credible, and commercially important 

You Are

A strong product manager who can operate comfortably in technical, ambiguous, and fast-moving domains 
Fluent in cybersecurity concepts such as controls, risk signals, policy enforcement, monitoring, and incident-oriented thinking 
Experienced in AI/MLOps ecosystems, with experience in building SIEM and SOAR solutions including model lifecycle considerations, evaluation signals, runtime monitoring, and production governance patterns 
Comfortable leading through influence across engineering, design, GTM, and executive stakeholders 
Structured in how you run product discovery, prioritization, and squad execution 
Future-oriented and able to identify platform capabilities that will matter as AI systems become more agentic, distributed, and operationally complex 
Clear and persuasive in written and verbal communication 

Your Experience Includes

12+ years in product management, with meaningful experience in enterprise software or platform products 
Direct experience in one or more of the following domains: log collection, inference generation, cybersecurity, AI/MLOps, , platform observability, or risk/compliance technology 
Track record of shipping technical platform capabilities in partnership with engineering teams 
Experience working with telemetry, monitoring, policy, controls, or enforcement-oriented systems 
Ability to understand complex technical architectures and convert them into strong product decisions 
Experience balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, and strategic platform thinking 
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience 

Extra Impressive

Experience with AI governance, model risk, or responsible AI programs. 
Have built SIEM capabilities or product to drive meaningful signals. 
Familiarity with enterprise AI stacks, agent frameworks, or evaluation/monitoring pipelines 
Experience building products that connect governance requirements to operational systems and evidence 
Background working in privacy, security, compliance, or trust-related software markets 
Comfort engaging with strategic partners, large enterprise customers, and senior leadership on product direction 

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Job Summary
Overview: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced individual to join our team as a Product Manager in the Core HCM domain. In this role, you will be responsible for leading initiatives to streamline and improve Global HR processes, ultimately enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and employee experience across the organization in line with company policies and compliance.


About this role
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Product Manager with deep expertise in Workday Core HCM to join the People Platforms team. In this role, you will own the product strategy and continuous improvement of our Core HCM capabilities across the Hire to Retire process (excluding the Hire process, which sits with the Talent Acquisition Attraction (TAA) team), with particularly strong focus on the Change Job business process, as well as Termination and data management. You will also need working knowledge of Workday security and integrations to understand how changes in this space ripple across the wider Workday landscape. This is a strategic, solution-oriented position where you will collaborate with global leaders and cross-functional teams-including process owners, technology, security, and support functions-to accelerate implementation timelines, manage the product lifecycle, reduce operational issues, apply prioritization frameworks, and build a transparent, high-quality product roadmap.
The role is weighted roughly 50-70% product management and 50-30% process ownership; in practice the two are heavily intertwined, and the successful candidate will move fluidly between defining what we build and defining and standardizing how the underlying HR processes work.


Key responsibilities

Product
  • Product Strategy Roadmap: Define and execute a strategic product roadmap for Workday Core HCM aligned with organizational goals and evolving market needs, with a strong emphasis on the Change Job business process, Termination, and data management across the Hire to Retire lifecycle (excluding Hire, owned by TAA).
  • Feature Prioritization Backlog Management: Collaborate with process owners, technical teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize features and enhancements based on impact, feasibility, and user feedback; own and groom the product backlog in Jira (or equivalent).
  • Requirements Development Oversight: Translate business needs into clear product requirements, well-crafted user stories, and acceptance criteria. Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle using agile methodologies, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
  • Quality Assurance Testing: Partner with solution and QA teams to define test strategies-particularly for Change Job, Termination, and other core data change scenarios-and support testing efforts to ensure the reliability and performance of product releases.
  • Stakeholder Engagement Product Evangelism: Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for your products. Communicate the product vision, roadmap, and value proposition to stakeholders and end-users.
  • User-Centric Design Feedback Loops: Engage with users to gather insights, validate solutions, and drive continuous improvement through iterative feedback and data-driven decision-making.

About CrazyNeon

CrazyNeon is a fast-growing e-commerce brand specializing in custom LED neon signs and other custom signage, selling to customers across the US and other international markets. It's owned and operated by Propound Internet Pvt. Ltd.

We're building the next generation of the custom signage buying experience — combining e-commerce, technology, design, automation, and AI.


About the role

We're looking for a Product Manager who's genuinely obsessed with the customer journey, conversion rates, and building better digital experiences.

This isn't a traditional PM role focused mainly on managing a software roadmap. You'll identify opportunities across the CrazyNeon website and customer journey, figure out why customers convert or drop off, test and ship improvements, and work closely with design, technology, marketing, sales, and operations to make them happen.

A meaningful part of the role is also forward-looking: exploring and building new AI-powered products and experiences that change how customers design, customize, buy, and interact with custom signage.

The ideal candidate combines e-commerce, CRO, product thinking, data analytics, technology, and AI — in one person.


What you'll do

1. E-commerce product management

  • Own and continuously improve the CrazyNeon digital customer journey, from landing page to purchase.
  • Identify friction points across product discovery, customization, pricing, artwork submission, design approval, checkout, and post-purchase.
  • Build and maintain a product roadmap based on business impact and customer needs.
  • Work with technology, design, marketing, sales, and operations to execute improvements.
  • Find opportunities to improve customer experience, revenue, average order value, and conversion.
  • Track competitor websites and emerging e-commerce experiences for ideas worth adapting.

2. Conversion rate optimization

CRO is a major part of this role.

  • Own the website's conversion optimization roadmap end to end.
  • Analyze the full funnel and pinpoint where and why customers drop off.
  • Use analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, customer feedback, and A/B testing to diagnose problems.
  • Turn findings into testable hypotheses, then design and prioritize experiments.
  • Partner with UI/UX and development to ship tests, measure results, and roll successful ones into permanent improvements.

Areas you'll optimize include: landing pages, product pages, product customization, pricing presentation, calls to action, trust signals, reviews and social proof, quote/inquiry flows, artwork upload, design approval, cart, checkout, lead-generation forms, and mobile experience.

Over time, you should develop a sharp, evidence-backed understanding of what actually makes a customer buy custom signage online — and keep improving that journey.

3. Data & analytics

  • Use data — not just intuition — to identify product and conversion opportunities.
  • Monitor conversion rate, revenue per visitor, average order value, add-to-cart rate, checkout conversion, lead-to-order conversion, customer acquisition cost, repeat purchase rate, funnel drop-off, and product-level performance.
  • Build dashboards and reports that keep the team honest about what's working.
  • Translate data into concrete, actionable product recommendations.
  • Set up measurement frameworks for every new launch or experiment.

4. Customer research

  • Build a deep understanding of CrazyNeon's customers and how they buy.
  • Mine customer inquiries, support conversations, sales feedback, reviews, and abandoned carts for product opportunities.
  • Run customer interviews and usability studies where useful.
  • Spot recurring problems that technology, automation, better UX, or new products could solve.
  • Turn customer problems into clear product requirements.

5. AI & new-age products

A key part of this role is identifying and building AI-powered products and experiences for CrazyNeon — and continuously exploring how AI can improve both the customer experience and internal operations.

Potential areas include:

  • AI-powered custom neon/sign designer and design generation
  • AI artwork analysis and preflight
  • AI-powered product recommendations, search, and discovery
  • AI-assisted quoting and configuration
  • AI-powered customer assistance and sales tools
  • AI-assisted artwork-to-production workflows
  • AI-powered personalization and customer mockup generation
  • Internal AI knowledge systems for employees

You'll be responsible for spotting high-value AI opportunities, evaluating new AI technologies and platforms, defining MVPs and requirements, working with developers, AI engineers, designers, and outside vendors, testing with real customers, measuring adoption and impact, and taking what works from prototype to production.

You don't need to be an AI engineer — but you should be technically curious, and comfortable understanding what modern AI can and can't actually do.

Working closely with domain SMEs, customers, Product, Data Engineering, and Architecture, this role drives requirements from discovery through definition, technical validation, and customer validation. The role requires a strong combination of product thinking, business analysis, analytics, and hands-on understanding of relational data and data modeling.
We need a candidate who sits with an ERP SME or business user, understand the business process; inspect the underlying data/schema; define the business entities/KPIs; map source concepts to the semantic model; write requirements detailed enough for Engineering; validate the implementation (reports, AI query, or Agent outputs) with SMEs/customers.

Works across multiple business domains, ERP/product schemas, and analytics use cases where business terminology, source data structures, and customer requirements may differ.
Translates sometimes ambiguous business questions and existing reporting requirements into standardized entities, measures, dimensions, relationships, KPIs, and semantic definitions that can be reused across products and customers.
Balances standard product requirements against ERP-specific and customer-specific requirements and identifies where extensions to the governed model are required.
Works through dependencies across Product, Engineering, Architecture, domain SMEs, Professional Services, customers, and other stakeholders to move semantic-model and Analytics Package work from discovery through validation.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Product Manager: Growth and Guest Experience

Location: Mumbai, full time, in office

Experience: 3 to 5 years


About the role

You will help us answer a question we care about deeply: how do we use technology to make Hunger Inc. more loved, more connected and more scalable? You will think with the founders about guest relationships, community, loyalty, CRM, customer journeys and AI, and turn the best ideas into products that guests love and teams use.


What You'll Own


1. Create our community and loyalty ecosystem

We're exploring what a connected community and loyalty programme could look like across Hunger Inc. But we don't believe loyalty should begin and end with points and discounts. We believe it starts with recognition, trust, generosity, access and belonging. You'll help design, prototype and launch experiences that bring this philosophy to life. That could mean cross-brand discoveries, personalised gestures, special access, community experiences or rewards that feel genuinely meaningful. Your responsibility will be to translate these ideas into a product roadmap, work with engineering to bring them to life and measure whether they actually strengthen customer relationships.


2. Drive measurable growth through experimentation

You'll identify opportunities across customer acquisition, conversion, retention, repeat purchase frequency and lifetime value. Establish baselines, develop hypotheses, run experiments and measure results. You'll also explore how AI can accelerate product discovery, customer analysis, experimentation and prototyping. We want someone who can connect customer insights to commercial outcomes, not just produce interesting dashboards.


3. Supercharge our AI-led CRM

We already use SuperLeap, an AI-native CRM platform. Your challenge is to unlock more of its potential. Work with our teams and technology partners to connect customer information, understand behaviour, build meaningful segments and develop intelligent customer journeys. Think lifecycle marketing, automated engagement, customer retention, repeat purchases, personalised recommendations and identifying opportunities to grow customer relationships. We don't want a CRM that simply stores customer information. We want one that helps us understand what customers love, why they return and how we can serve them better.


4. Build a connected understanding of our customers

Our customers interact with us through Shopify, restaurant reservations, POS systems, gifting enquiries, customer service, WhatsApp and multiple other channels. Today, much of that information lives in different places. You'll help define the product strategy for a connected customer intelligence platform, working with engineering to establish customer identities, useful profiles and a clearer understanding of behaviour across brands. The ambition is to move beyond transactions and develop a meaningful understanding of our guests, with appropriate consent and privacy protections.


What youll bring

35 years of experience in product management, growth product, consumer technology, e-commerce or a related discipline. A conventional product management background isn't mandatory, but you should have demonstrated ownership of a product or feature that real customers have used.


Required Skills

  • Strong understanding of product discovery, user research, product roadmaps, PRDs, prioritisation and experimentation.
  • Hands-on analytical ability, including SQL, spreadsheets, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, retention metrics and customer segmentation.
  • Experience taking products or features from identifying a problem through launch, adoption and measuring outcomes.
  • Understanding of APIs, customer data architecture and technical integrations sufficient to collaborate effectively with engineers.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, customer journeys, lifecycle marketing and growth experimentation.
  • Practical experience using AI tools for research, analysis, prototyping or product development.
  • Strong written communication and the ability to translate complex ideas into clear requirements.
  • Comfort working directly with operational teams and customers rather than relying entirely on dashboards.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Shopify, SuperLeap or comparable CRM/CDP platforms.
  • Familiarity with Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, Metabase or similar analytics platforms.
  • Experience building loyalty, membership, community or customer retention products.
  • Understanding of customer identity resolution, data privacy and personalisation.
  • Experience in D2C, consumer brands, hospitality, retail or marketplaces.
  • Ability to build functional prototypes using AI-assisted development tools.
  • Experience working in a founder-led business or small cross-functional product team.

What success looks like

You've helped us build a more connected understanding of our customers, unlocked meaningful capabilities within our CRM, and launched customer experiences that improve engagement, retention or repeat behaviour. You can demonstrate what changed, why it changed and what we learned.


What this role is not

This isn't a traditional marketing role where you manage campaigns and content calendars. It isn't a role where you write PRDs, hand them to engineering and move on. And it isn't about launching a loyalty programme simply because every other brand has one. We want someone who takes responsibility for identifying the right problems, building the right experiences and understanding whether they actually worked. 


We're looking for someone who wants to engineer better customer relationships, not just manage customer databases.

Experience with tools like Unicommerce,EasyEcom,Increff,Vinculum,ClickPost,Shiprocket,Shopify,or similar platforms is preferred

Job Description
Role Overview
As the Product Manager for Distribution, you are the "Full-Stack" owner of the value stream connecting our suppliers to our customers. You will move beyond tactical ticket-writing to drive the "Why" and "What" for both customer sales and supplier purchasing capabilities. This role is part of our Functional Product Stream, focused on solving pervasive market problems to drive adoption and revenue.
Core Responsibilities
Your work is structured around the Product Management Lifecycle (PMLC), focusing on outcome-based decision gates rather than feature output.
1. Discovery & Strategy (The "Why")
  • Market Sensing: Conduct biweekly customer and supplier interactions to validate that identified problems are urgent and pervasive.
  • Problem Validation: Use data from Win/Loss reports and Customer Advisory Boards (CAB) to build evidence-based business cases.
  • Opportunity Canvasing: Define the market driver, competitive landscape, and economic impact (ROI) for new distribution initiatives.
2. Solution & Design (The "What")
  • Roadmap Ownership: Maintain a 3-year Now/Next/Later roadmap that balances customer sales features, supplier integration, and technical health.
  • Ruthless Prioritization: Apply the RICE framework (Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort) to the backlog to ensure we focus on "Return on Effort".
  • Constraint Definition: Clearly distinguish between MVP (Technical Prototype) and MLP (Minimum Lovable Product) to prevent scope creep.
3. Delivery & Market Alignment (The "How")
  • Squad Leadership: Act as the strategic lead for a group of Autonomous Squads (Atomic Scrum Units), collaborating with a Tech Lead and Product Designer.
  • GTM Readiness: Partner with Product Marketing to ensure Sales, Support, and Customer Success are operationally ready for new releases.
  • Success Analysis: Post-launch, measure actual adoption and revenue against the original business case metrics to decide whether to Pivot, Persevere, or Kill.
4.Success Metrics (KPIs)
In a product-led organization, you are measured on Outcomes, not outputs:
  • ARR: Supporting growth goals for sales.
  • Customer Retention: Ensuring users get continuous value from the distribution module.
  • Outcome Achievement: Meeting the specific success criteria defined in your Business Cases (e.g., reducing purchasing lead times).
  • Strategic Alignment: Ensuring 100% of your roadmap items are scalable for multiple customers and not bespoke requests. Qualifications

Roles & Responsibilities:

Product ownership: Own the roadmap, prioritization and delivery for the staffing platform, balancing business impact, effort and urgency as priorities change.
AI and workflow architecture: Map the end-to-end staffing workflow, identify where AI and automation add the most value, and define how they are embedded into the platform architecture. Work with engineering on data flow, integrations, accuracy targets, fallbacks and human-in-the-loop checks.

Design collaboration: Brief the in-house designer, review output against the original ask, and use AI design tools for mock-ups when design support is unavailable.

Overview: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced individual to join our team as a Product Manager in the Core HCM domain . In this role, you will be responsible for leading initiatives to streamline and improve Global HR processes, ultim ately enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and employee experience across the organization in line with company policies and compliance.

About this role:

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Product Manager with deep expertise in Workday Core HCM to join the People Platforms team. In this role, you will own the product strategy and continuous improvement of our Core HCM capabilities across the Hire to Retire process (excluding the Hire process, which sits with the Talent Acquisition & Attraction (TAA) team), with particularly strong focus on the Change Job business process, as well as Termination and data management. You will also need working knowledge of Workday security and integrations to understand how changes in this space ripple across the wider Workday landscape. This is a strategic, solution-oriented position where you will collaborate with global leaders and cross-functional teams—including process owners, technology, security, and support functions—to accelerate implementation timelines, manage the product lifecycle, reduce operational issues, apply prioritization frameworks, and build a transparent, high-quality product roadmap.

The role is weighted roughly 50–70% product management and 50–30% process ownership; in practice the two are heavily intertwined, and the successful candidate will move fluidly between defining what we build and defining and standardizing how the underlying HR processes work.

Key responsibilities

Product

Product Strategy & Roadmap

Define and execute a strategic product roadmap for Workday Core HCM aligned with organizational goals and evolving market needs, with a strong emphasis on the Change Job business process, Termination, and data management across the Hire to Retire lifecycle (excluding Hire, owned by TAA).

Feature Prioritization & Backlog Management

Collaborate with process owners, technical teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize features and enhancements based on impact, feasibility, and user feedback; own and groom the product backlog in Jira (or equivalent).

Requirements & Development Oversight

Translate business needs into clear product requirements, well-crafted user stories, and acceptance criteria. Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle using agile methodologies, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

Quality Assurance & Testing

Partner with solution and QA teams to define test strategies—particularly for Change Job, Termination, and other core data change scenarios—and support testing efforts to ensure the reliability and performance of product releases.

Stakeholder Engagement & Product Evangelism

Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for your products. Communicate the product vision, roadmap, and value proposition to stakeholders and end-users.

User-Centric Design & Feedback Loops

Engage with users to gather insights, validate solutions, and drive continuous improvement through iterative feedback and data-driven decision-making.

Training & Change Enablement

Collaborate with change management teams to develop training materials, user guides, and communication plans that support adoption and maximize product value.

Security & Integrations Awareness

Work with security and integration teams to understand the downstream and upstream impact of Core HCM changes (e.g., Change Job, Termination, data changes) on business process security, access, and integrations, ensuring product decisions account for these implications.

Process

Process Design & Documentation

Conduct comprehensive assessments of current Hire to Retire processes (excluding Hire), particularly Change Job, Termination, and related data management workflows, to identify areas for improvement and optimization.

Develop, implement, and maintain process documentation and guidelines, ensuring these are scalable and adaptable across regions and business units, and are clearly reflected in the supporting Workday configuration.

Process Standardization

Develop and maintain global standards for Change Job, Termination, and data management processes to enable consistency and compliance across all regions.

Conduct regular checks to identify variances and areas for optimization, and facilitate the sharing of best practices across regions.

Process Simplification & Automation

Use data-driven insight (including process mining where available) to identify complex, redundant, or unnecessary steps in Change Job, Termination, and data management processes, and redesign them to remove bottlenecks and reduce errors.

Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks and evaluate technology solutions that streamline processes and enhance the employee and HR user experience.

Continuous Improvement

Implement continuous improvement initiatives—drawing on methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen where relevant—and define metrics and KPIs to measure process performance and track progress.

Change Management & Compliance

Lead process change management activities tied to product releases, including training, documentation, and progress monitoring.

Ensure Change Job, Termination, and data management processes comply with relevant data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements; support audits and help implement corrective actions where gaps are identified .

We are looking for a technically strong Manager – AI Product Experience to own the design and delivery of AI-powered product features for the Accounts Receivable and Order-to-Cash domain. The role combines hands-on AI engineering capability with product management ownership, requiring the incumbent to work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and Finance stakeholders to ship intelligent AR automation that reduces DSO, improves cash application accuracy, and enhances collections intelligence.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Design & AI Strategy

Define and manage the AI product roadmap for AR capabilities: cash application automation, deductions management, credit risk scoring, collections prioritization, and dispute resolution.
Translate AR business requirements into AI architectures, orchestration frameworks, and product features that deliver measurable outcomes (DSO reduction, auto-match rate improvement).
Design Generative AI solutions using state-of-the-art models (GPT-4o, Claude, Llama 3) for AR-specific tasks: automated remittance parsing, dispute email generation, and intelligent customer communication.
Architect Agentic AI workflows for autonomous AR operations: cash matching agents, dispute classification agents, and collections prioritization agents using LangChain, AutoGen, and CrewAI.

Technical Leadership

Guide data science and ML engineering teams in building, fine-tuning, and deploying LLMs and ML models for AR use cases: payment prediction, credit risk scoring, and anomaly detection.
Architect scalable AI pipelines on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP); drive adoption of LLM orchestration stacks and MLOps practices for production AR AI systems.
Stay current on advancements in Generative AI, NLP, and ML engineering frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph); proactively incorporate innovations into the AR AI product.
Ensure AI solutions meet compliance, security, and auditability standards applicable to receivables and financial data.

Client Engagement

Collaborate with client Finance technology teams and AR operations leads to identify AI-driven automation opportunities and co-define solution requirements.
Present Generative AI use cases, proof-of-concept demos, and ROI narratives to both technical and non-technical client audiences.
Act as a trusted product and AI advisor to clients on the technical, ethical, and operational considerations of deploying AR AI solutions.
Support Sr. AVP in first-engagement solutioning, client workshops, and RFP/RFI responses for AR transformation engagements.

Product Management & Delivery

Write detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria for AI-powered AR features; manage and prioritize the product backlog.
Conduct user discovery interviews with AR operations teams, controllers, and treasury leads to surface pain points and validate product hypotheses.
Lead sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives with cross-functional Agile engineering teams; manage release readiness across QA, UX, and compliance workstreams.
Define and track product metrics: cash application hit rate, auto-match accuracy, DSO improvement, collector productivity, and AI model performance.
Author product collateral: demo scripts, solution one-pagers, sales enablement decks, and ROI calculators for AR AI solutions.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Experience (9–12 Years)

B.Tech or M.Tech in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
9–12 years of total experience, with at least 4–5 years in AI/ML product engineering and 3+ years of Finance technology experience with strong AR/O2C domain exposure.
3–4 years of hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models: prompt engineering, LLM fine-tuning, and building applications using LangChain, LlamaIndex, or RAGAS.
Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and applying ML models to finance classification, prediction, and anomaly detection use cases.
Working experience with Agentic AI concepts: Autonomous Agents, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph; ability to design and deploy multi-step AI agent workflows for AR automation.
Experience in ML Engineering and MLOps: model deployment, performance monitoring, versioning, and retraining pipelines (MLflow, SageMaker, Azure ML).
Strong software engineering skills in Python; experience building AI-powered APIs, integrations, and cloud-native microservices.
Proven track record of delivering AI product features from ideation through production deployment in an Agile environment; CSPO or equivalent certification preferred.

Skills & Competencies

Solid functional knowledge of Accounts Receivable: cash application, collections, credit management, deductions, billing, and ERP AR modules (SAP FSCM, Oracle Fusion AR, HighRadius, Esker).
Experience with NLP techniques for remittance advice parsing, dispute letter classification, and payment confirmation extraction from unstructured documents.
Understanding of Vector Databases and Graph Databases and their application in AR knowledge retrieval, semantic matching, and customer intelligence.
Familiarity with cloud AI services (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI) for both model inferencing and fine-tuning AR-specific models.
Strong SQL and Python proficiency; experience with BI/analytics tools (Tableau, Power BI) for data-driven product and model performance decisions.
Excellent communication skills: ability to explain Generative AI concepts and product value to non-technical Finance audiences.
Experience working cross-functionally across engineering, data science, UX, and Finance SME teams; comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast-paced product environment.
Participation in RFI/RFP, thought leadership, and client-facing solutioning activities preferred.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About the Role

Harness is looking for a Staff Product Manager to define the future of Agentic Application Security. You will lead our Code Security and AI Security Agents portfolio, spanning static application security testing (SAST), AI-powered vulnerability triage, and autonomous remediation.

As AI coding agents transform how software is built, security must evolve beyond detecting vulnerabilities to autonomously investigating, validating, and fixing them at machine speed.

We are looking for a product leader who can help build autonomous security engineering systems that understand code, reason about security risks, generate secure fixes, and continuously validate outcomes across modern development environments.

What You'll Own
AI-Native Code Security: Own the strategy and roadmap for SAST, code analysis, reachability, exploitability, and AI-powered vulnerability discovery.
Autonomous Security Agents: Build intelligent triage and remediation agents that investigate findings, assess risk, generate fixes, and verify security outcomes.
Agentic Remediation Workflows: Drive autonomous repository analysis, multi-file code changes, dependency upgrades, test generation, regression validation, and pull request creation.
Agentic Developer Ecosystem: Integrate security into AI coding assistants, autonomous development agents, IDEs, SCM, and CI/CD workflows.
Next-Generation Security Testing: Explore LLM-driven security analysis, sandbox execution, exploit validation, and continuous security testing.
Product Strategy & Execution: Own product differentiation, customer engagement, roadmap execution, adoption, and business outcomes while partnering with engineering, security research, and go-to-market teams.
What We're Looking For
8+ years of product management experience in Application Security, AI Developer Tools, DevSecOps, or software engineering platforms.
Strong understanding of application security, SAST, vulnerability management, secure coding, and developer workflows.
Experience or strong technical familiarity with AI coding agents, LLM orchestration, tool calling, and autonomous software development.
Understanding of how agents reason over repositories, plan and execute tasks, modify code, run tests, and iteratively resolve failures.
Ability to translate advances in AI and software engineering into reliable, enterprise-grade products.
Proven experience driving product strategy, technical execution, customer adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
Strong technical judgment and ability to collaborate with engineering, security research, and executive stakeholders.
Nice to Have
Experience building autonomous coding agents, AI-native developer tools, or application security products.
Knowledge of code property graphs, dataflow analysis, reachability, exploitability, and software composition analysis.
Familiarity with multi-agent architectures, MCP, sandbox environments, agent memory, and feedback-driven execution.
Experience with automated vulnerability remediation, secure code generation, and verification workflows.
Background in software engineering, security engineering, or AI/ML.
Why Join Harness?

Help define the next generation of application security, where intelligent agents don't just identify vulnerabilities but autonomously investigate, remediate, and verify them.

At Harness, you'll work at the intersection of AI, application security, and software engineering to build security products designed for a world where humans and AI agents develop software together.

What You Will Have at Harness

Competitive salary
Comprehensive healthcare benefits
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Flexible Time Off and Parental Leave
Quarterly Harness TGIF-Off / 4 days
Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team-building events
Recharge & Reset Program
Monthly internet reimbursement
Commuter benefits

Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

About Refold AI

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

What you'll do:

Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?

You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours?

You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?

You will define what learning looks like at the system level.

How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on

integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.

When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.

You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.

You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.

You write, not deck. Specs, trade-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.

You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made

Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap

The primary objective of this role is to facilitate the effortless creation of Amazon listings by sellers. The role entails the crucial responsibility of empowering selling partners, comprising both sellers and vendors, to efficiently and effectively list their products on the Amazon marketplace. The goal is to ensure that these product listings maintain their buyability for the maximum possible duration, all while simplifying the process and minimizing hurdles for sellers to qualify for Amazon's platform.
The individual in this role will have end-to-end ownership, which includes defining the overall strategy, collaborating with engineering and machine learning teams to develop solutions, and meticulously monitoring metrics to track progress across Amazon's extensive eCommerce pipeline. Furthermore, they must grasp the intricacies of emerging markets and strategize accordingly for sellers within the Amazon ecosystem. This necessitates close collaboration with numerous global teams, often requiring the ability to influence without direct authority. It is also imperative that the role holder stays abreast of the latest technological advancements, including Large Language Models, and present a product strategy that leverages these innovations to simplify the listing process.
This role is highly influential, with significant business impact, and provides visibility to leaders both in India and across the global platform teams. Regular updates to senior leadership are essential, and it requires a high degree of ownership, a bias for taking action, and thinking on a grand scale in an environment where contributions are distributed among multiple stakeholders. Exceptional influencing skills are crucial to drive initiatives forward. Additionally, international connectivity is key, and the individual must be willing to invest in building networks with business and tech teams on a global scale.
A successful candidate for this role should have a proven background in product management, scaling systems with extensive data sets, and a track record of delivering results in a fast-paced setting. Strong development experience, familiarity with software development cycles, and a history of managing large cross-functional projects are essential. Given the inherent ambiguity in the role, analytical thinking and superb problem-solving skills are also prerequisites, as many of the challenges are unique to Amazon's vast scale.

A day in the life
• Manage business and technical requirements, ensuring overall coordination, quality, and acting as the primary contact for global stakeholders of your products and goals.
• Collaborate with scientists, economists, and engineers to deliver scalable ML models and generate customer insights at scale, while building project roadmaps.
• Apply scientific, engineering, and business best practices to drive innovation.
• Create high-quality documents (narratives & PR FAQs) to articulate your vision and report on initiatives to senior leadership.
• Influence feature and priority decisions with tech and platform teams based on overall impact and speed to market.
• Advocate for the needs of Emerging Market customers on a global stage.

About the team
The Emerging Market Seller Experience (EM SX) team envisions Amazon as the preferred marketplace for Selling Partners in Emerging Markets. They strive to simplify the process for any Selling Partner to launch and expand a successful business on Amazon. The Listings team within this group develops tools and products that reduce friction for Amazon sellers when listing their products. Serving as the voice of sellers in Emerging Markets (including IN, MENA, APAC, LATAM), they create user-friendly, scalable solutions to address their unique needs.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Product Development and Operations/Full time/Onsite

Cloud Common Services (CCS) builds the essential cloud infrastructure and platform services that power the Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP). At the heart of this is Atmos, Guidewire's "PaaS within SaaS" layer — built on AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker — that automates the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized core applications, cloud-native services, and associated workloads.

As Platform Product Manager, you'll own the roadmap and delivery for a defined set of platform capabilities within CCS/Atmos that internal engineering teams and external insurer customers rely on every day. Working closely with senior product leaders, engineering, and SRE, you'll help shape how Guidewire delivers infrastructure as a product — with a focus on developer experience, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.

This role is a strong fit for someone with a solid technical foundation in cloud infrastructure who is building their product management career and wants to grow into platform strategy ownership.

Job Description

We are looking for candidates with 6–10 years of overall work experience, including a minimum of 1–2 years in Product Management (or a product-adjacent role such as technical program management, solutions engineering, or platform engineering with product responsibilities).

Own the roadmap and backlog for one or more platform service areas within CCS/Atmos — such as deployment tooling, observability, Kubernetes-based compute, networking, or d platform services — in alignment with the broader CCS product strategy.
Develop a working understanding of the Guidewire Cloud ecosystem, the multi-tenant/hybrid-tenancy architecture, and the needs of both internal developer teams and external customers.
Treat platform infrastructure as a product: identify friction in developer workflows and define capabilities that improve productivity, self-service, and time-to-value.
Partner with Engineering, SRE/Operations, UX, and Enablement to discover, test, refine, and prioritize solutions.
Write clear feature requirements and user stories with well-defined use cases and acceptance criteria.
Contribute to roadmap planning by bringing customer insight, usage data, and operational feedback to prioritization discussions.
Support the launch of new platform services and features; define success metrics, measure adoption and performance, and iterate.
Be a power user of the platform capabilities you build.
Communicate progress, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to engineering teams and stakeholders.
Embrace a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI — using emerging tools and data-driven insights to improve how you and your teams work.

We're looking for someone who
Has experience working on platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing products — as a product manager, or in a technical role (engineering, SRE, DevOps, solutions/technical program management) with a demonstrated interest in moving into product management.
Has a solid understanding of AWS services and cloud-native architectures (AWS Cloud Practitioner certification is a plus).
Understands containerization and container orchestration (Docker & Kubernetes) and the basics of running services at scale.

Experience with load balancing and networking in cloud environments.
AWS Cloud Practitioner (or higher) certification.
Familiarity with Aha! and JIRA.
Prior experience in a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
Ability to travel up to 5% as needed.

Customer Need: Comfortable engaging with internal developer teams and external customers to understand their needs and document use cases.
Product Execution: Ability to turn prioritized needs into well-specified, deliverable increments and see them through to launch.
Collaboration: Works well across cross-functional teams and builds trust with engineering partners.
Results Driven: Tracks adoption and outcomes, learns from data, and iterates.
Communication: Able to explain both the technical detail and business value of platform work to the appropriate audience.
Motivation: A genuine interest in the craft of product management and in platform/infrastructure as a product.

Interested in this position?
About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

*About the Role:*

We're looking for a hands-on Product Manager with 4–8 years of experience building consumer internet products, ideally mobile-first apps where user engagement, retention, and growth are central to the business.

At FOXO, you'll work directly with the founders, designers, engineers, doctors, and business teams to identify consumer problems, shape product direction, and take ideas from discovery to launch. This isn't a role where you'll inherit a mature roadmap. You'll help build one. We're looking for someone with strong product judgment, an analytical mindset, and the ability to execute independently in a fast-moving startup environment.

*What You'll Do:*

* *Drive execution:* Make trade-offs, resolve bottlenecks, coordinate releases, and maintain a high bar for product quality.
* *Collaborate across teams:* Work with doctors and business teams to translate domain expertise into useful consumer experiences.
* *Explore AI opportunities:* Identify where AI can meaningfully improve the user experience or solve a real consumer problem.

*What We're Looking For:*

Must Have

* 4–8 years of hands-on Product Management experience, preferably in B2C or consumer internet.
* Experience at a consumer internet company building products used directly by consumers, where engagement, retention, or growth mattered.
* Strong understanding of mobile app fundamentals, including onboarding, user journeys, navigation, funnels, and repeat usage.
* Demonstrated ownership of product initiatives from discovery through launch and subsequent iteration.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use product data and customer insights to make decisions.
* Ability to break down ambiguous problems into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong product sense and attention to detail, with an understanding of the trade-offs between user experience, business outcomes, and engineering effort.
* Ability to work directly with founders, make decisions with incomplete information, and drive projects independently.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* A bachelor's degree from a Tier-I college or other leading undergraduate institution.

Good to Have

* Experience improving activation, conversion, engagement, retention, or other core consumer product metrics.
* Experience building mobile apps in health, wellness, lifestyle, fintech, commerce, or other consumer-focused categories.
* Familiarity with Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, PostHog, or similar product analytics tools.
* Working knowledge of SQL.
* Familiarity with Figma, Jira, Notion, and AI-powered productivity tools.
* Experience with AI/LLM-powered products. Prior AI experience is not a requirement.

*Location & Work Model:*

* *Location:* Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
* *Work Model:* Full-time, on-site at FOXO's Bengaluru office.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our consumer data platform. We have a modern cloud lakehouse in place and are now building the consumer data foundation on top of it: a canonical data model, a consumer data warehouse, and one trusted source of data for analytics, data science, risk and finance teams.

You’ll own the roadmap from the start. You’ll decide which use cases to deliver first, define how core consumer entities are modeled, and make sure each new use case builds on shared data instead of one-off pipelines. You’ll work closely with data engineering, data architecture, analytics and risk teams.

This is not a dashboard-building role. You’ll own the data, definitions and metrics that dashboards, models and reports are built on.

What you’ll do in your first 12 months

Build a prioritized backlog of consumer data use cases with analytics, data science, risk and finance, and decide which 3–5 to deliver first.
Define canonical consumer entities, such as customer, account, transaction, fee, merchant, country and currency, so they mean the same thing across products.
Decide where products share a common model and where they need their own structures, and document the reasoning.
Define single, governed definitions for core consumer KPIs such as active customers, revenue per user, lifetime value and churn.
Write requirements engineers can build from: source-to-target mappings, grain, keys, history rules and data-quality checks.
Track adoption: which teams have moved to the new models, how much they’re being used, and how many metric discrepancies have been resolved.

Required qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or an MBA, or equivalent practical experience.
6+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years in a data product or risk data role.
Experience starting with many competing data requests, choosing the few to build first, defining an MVP, and explaining the trade-offs to stakeholders.
Experience working with engineering to deliver a data lake/lakehouse, data warehouse or shared data model used by multiple teams.
Experience bringing together inconsistent data from multiple source systems into common entities, keys and definitions.
Hands-on SQL: you can join across tables, profile data for nulls and duplicates, reconcile counts between systems, and check whether data supports a use case without waiting for an analyst.

Preferred qualifications

Experience with consumer payments, digital wallets or fintech.
Experience with payments risk data such as fraud, account takeover, KYC/AML or transaction monitoring signals.
Experience with modern cloud data platforms and tools, such as Snowflake, Databricks, dbt or major cloud providers’ data services.

Job Description

Role Overview

As the Product Manager for Distribution, you are the "Full-Stack" owner of the value stream connecting our suppliers to our customers. You will move beyond tactical ticket-writing to drive the "Why" and "What" for both customer sales and supplier purchasing capabilities. This role is part of our Functional Product Stream, focused on solving pervasive market problems to drive adoption and revenue.

Core Responsibilities

Your work is structured around the Product Management Lifecycle (PMLC), focusing on outcome-based decision gates rather than feature output.

Discovery & Strategy (The "Why")
Market Sensing: Conduct biweekly customer and supplier interactions to validate that identified problems are urgent and pervasive.
Problem Validation: Use data from Win/Loss reports and Customer Advisory Boards (CAB) to build evidence-based business cases.
Opportunity Canvasing: Define the market driver, competitive landscape, and economic impact (ROI) for new distribution initiatives.
Solution & Design (The "What")
Roadmap Ownership: Maintain a 3-year Now/Next/Later roadmap that balances customer sales features, supplier integration, and technical health.
Ruthless Prioritization: Apply the RICE framework (Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort) to the backlog to ensure we focus on "Return on Effort".
Constraint Definition: Clearly distinguish between MVP (Technical Prototype) and MLP (Minimum Lovable Product) to prevent scope creep.
Delivery & Market Alignment (The "How")
Squad Leadership: Act as the strategic lead for a group of Autonomous Squads (Atomic Scrum Units), collaborating with a Tech Lead and Product Designer.
GTM Readiness: Partner with Product Marketing to ensure Sales, Support, and Customer Success are operationally ready for new releases.
Success Analysis: Post-launch, measure actual adoption and revenue against the original business case metrics to decide whether to Pivot, Persevere, or Kill.
Success Metrics (KPIs)

In a product-led organization, you are measured on Outcomes, not outputs:

ARR: Supporting growth goals for sales. 
Customer Retention: Ensuring users get continuous value from the distribution module.
Outcome Achievement: Meeting the specific success criteria defined in your Business Cases (e.g., reducing purchasing lead times).
Strategic Alignment: Ensuring 100% of your roadmap items are scalable for multiple customers and not bespoke requests.

Qualifications

Experience: 5-10 years of experience in Product Management within supply chain, ERP, or distribution software is highly preferred.
Mindset: High tolerance for ambiguity and a natural curiosity for user problems over technical "purity".
Decision Making: Ability to make "Green Light" investment recommendations based on hard data (logs, usage stats) rather than "gut feel".
Tooling: Proficiency in Aha! for strategy/roadmapping and Jira for execution management.

DEX Monitoring & Insights

Automations & Workflow Orchestration

Own the vision and roadmap for the TeamViewer DEX Hub automation library — the centralized, single source of truth for OOTB and custom SCALE instructions, automations, and remediation workflows across the organization.
Lead the strategy for Tia Scripting, enabling IT admins to create automations and scripts through natural language — lowering the barrier to automation creation and eliminating dependence on deep PowerShell or Bash expertise.
Define the end-to-end automation lifecycle: from discovery and creation to testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement — ensuring automation is both powerful and safe for enterprise-scale operations.

Identify and prioritize automation use cases with the highest customer impact, grounded in field data, customer interviews, and win/loss analysis.

Cross-Functional & Strategic

Act as the product domain authority for DEX & Automations — representing roadmap priorities to senior stakeholders, customers, and field teams, and translating strategic goals into actionable, well-scoped requirements.
Partner with GTM, Customer Success, and Sales to develop positioning, enablement materials, and go-to-market strategies that communicate the business value of DEX and automation capabilities to economic buyers (CIOs, DEX Program Owners).
Drive customer discovery through interviews, advisory councils, and field feedback loops — continuously synthesizing market signals into roadmap decisions.
Ensure that all roadmap items ladder to TeamViewer's AEM strategic narrative: the journey from reactive support to proactive, predictive, and ultimately autonomous endpoint management.

Must Have

4+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, preferably in endpoint management, ITSM, IT operations, or adjacent enterprise software.
