The Flex Platform team operates through small, autonomous, cross-functional pods, with each pod accountable for a defined product area and outcome.

As the PM for your pod, you will be the primary product decision-maker, working closely with engineering, design, QA, architecture, and business stakeholders.

We believe PMs should own outcomes rather than simply manage backlogs. You will have the autonomy to determine what problem to solve, why it matters, what to build, and how to measure whether it worked.


Key Position Responsibilities include:
Product Discovery & Strategy
Understand customer, user, and business problems through research, data, and stakeholder insights.
Define problems clearly before committing to solutions.
Develop product hypotheses, evaluate alternatives, and make informed product trade-offs.
Translate business strategy and customer needs into a clear product vision and roadmap for your area.
Identify opportunities to create reusable platform capabilities that can scale across products, customers, and markets.

Product Delivery
Own and prioritize the product backlog in partnership with engineering.
Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
Work closely with engineering, design, QA, and architecture throughout discovery and delivery.
Make day-to-day product decisions and resolve ambiguity quickly.
Balance customer needs, technical complexity, business value, and time-to-market.
Ensure that products are delivered with the right level of quality, usability, and scalability.

Customer & Stakeholder Management
Regularly engage with customers and users to validate problems and solutions.
Partner with business unit leaders, customer success, sales, and other internal stakeholders.
Build alignment across teams and communicate product decisions clearly.
Represent the needs of your product area in quarterly planning and roadmap discussions.

Outcomes & Continuous Improvement
Define measurable outcomes for the products and capabilities you own.
Track adoption, usage, customer value, and business impact after launch.
Use data and customer feedback to continuously improve the product.
Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, automate manual processes, and improve customer productivity.

Cross-Platform Collaboration
Work across Flex Platform pods when your product area has dependencies on integrations, APIs, data, AI, payments, or other shared capabilities.
Identify opportunities to leverage existing platform capabilities rather than building duplicate solutions.
Help shape platform standards and reusable capabilities that benefit multiple Cyncly products.

Go-to-Market & Communication
Partner with GTM, business units, and customer-facing teams to prepare products for launch.
Communicate product changes, value propositions, and release plans clearly.
Support customer and internal enablement for significant product launches.


Required Experience and Qualifications:
3 - 5 years of product management experience, preferably in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
Demonstrated experience owning a product area from discovery through delivery and measurable outcomes.
Strong customer-first mindset and experience conducting customer or user discovery.
Comfortable owning and prioritizing a backlog without relying on a dedicated Product Owner.
Strong product judgment and ability to make trade-offs in ambiguous situations.
Ability to translate complex business problems into simple, intuitive product experiences.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear product requirements, user stories, stakeholder communications, and product narratives.
Comfortable working closely with engineering and understanding technical concepts, APIs, integrations, data, and platform architecture.
Strong collaboration skills and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
Comfortable working across multiple products, business units, geographies, and time zones.
Data-driven mindset with the ability to define and use product metrics to evaluate success.
Ownership mentality, you take responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.


Good to Have:
Experience building platform products, shared services, or reusable capabilities.
Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise applications, or vertical SaaS.
Experience with APIs, integrations, data platforms, analytics, or workflow automation.
Experience working with AI-enabled products or automation.
Experience launching products across multiple markets or geographies.
Experience working in an autonomous, cross-functional product pod or squad model.
Experience with PLG, self-service products, or SaaS growth models.


Working for Us
At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. About The Team And The Role

The Digital Services AI Product team is building the foundation for the next generation of help experiences on eBay. We are focused on making support personalized, effortless, fast, and trusted, providing seamless help where and when customers need it.

With hundreds of millions of listings and a global community of buyers and sellers, eBay’s scale creates a unique opportunity to transform how people find help, resolve issues, and navigate an increasingly complex global commerce and regulatory environment. We are developing an ecosystem of AI Agents and composable AI platforms that enable adaptive, scalable help experiences across every customer touchpoint.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will define and lead the strategy for how we design, build, and scale AI-powered help experiences, including capabilities that help eBay address product regulatory compliance requirements and policies at scale. You will work closely with design, engineering, data science, operations, policy, legal, and compliance teams to turn emerging AI capabilities, customer needs, and regulatory requirements into simple, trusted, and impactful products for customers and the business.

What You Will Accomplish

Define the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for AI Agents, composable AI platforms, and capabilities supporting product regulatory compliance and trusted commerce experiences.
Identify opportunities to use AI, automation, and data to improve how regulatory requirements and product policies are understood, operationalized, and surfaced across customer experiences.
Translate customer, business, policy, and regulatory needs into clear, actionable product direction and requirements.
Partner with Legal, Policy, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Engineering, Design, and Data Science to build scalable solutions that balance customer experience, regulatory obligations, and business objectives.
Use data and experimentation to guide decisions, measure impact, identify emerging risks, and drive continuous improvement.
Bring customer insights, regulatory developments, data, and industry trends together to inform product strategy and improve the product experience.
Develop scalable capabilities that can adapt to evolving product regulations, marketplace policies, and requirements across markets and jurisdictions.
Partner closely with design, engineering, and data science to deliver reliable, explainable, and high-quality AI-powered products at scale.
Build alignment and strong partnerships across teams to stay focused on shared goals and drive execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Keep customer trust, safety, and ease of use at the center of product decisions while enabling eBay to meet its regulatory and policy commitments.


What You Will Bring

6+ years of product management experience, ideally including experience with AI/ML, data-driven products, trust, risk, compliance, policy, or marketplace platforms.
Experience applying AI and automation to improve customer experiences and solve complex customer or business problems, such as conversational AI, decisioning, classification, policy interpretation, or workflow automation.
Experience working on product regulatory compliance, trust, risk, policy, or other regulated product domains is highly valued.
Ability to translate complex regulatory, policy, operational, and technical requirements into scalable product capabilities and intuitive customer experiences.
Skilled at using data and insights to uncover opportunities, drive prioritization, assess risk, and measure success.
Technical fluency and foresight to collaborate effectively with engineers, data scientists, and AI/ML teams.
Strong judgment when working with AI-powered products where accuracy, explainability, customer trust, and regulatory compliance are important.
High ownership mindset with a bias for action and focus on creating customer and business impact.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical teams, including Legal, Compliance, Policy, and Operations.
Experience building 0→1 products and navigating ambiguity, evolving requirements, and complex stakeholder environments with confidence.
Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, customer support, self-service, trust, risk, or regulatory technology is a plus but not required.


Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. About The Team

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.

Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.

Exceptional problem-solving skills based on first principles of thinking
Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

Who You Are

jobs.sourceTitle: Sr. Product Manager I - Data Mesh
jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own DataMesh, one of Smartsheet’s most widely used cross-sheet data capabilities and a critical part of how enterprise customers build and run their solutions today. DataMesh sits at the centre of a multi-year shift in Smartsheet’s data model, as we evolve towards column links and, ultimately, relational data capabilities.

You Will

Own the product strategy and roadmap for DataMesh, balancing near-term stability and customer needs against the longer-term migration strategy
Own the operational stability and serviceability of DataMesh, partnering with engineering and Support to prioritise defects, performance issues, and escalations
Shape and execute the migration path from DataMesh to column links, working closely with the Data Links PM on feature parity, the advanced column links roadmap, and report-as-a-source as a critical dependency
Lead customer and user discovery with enterprise personas (work admins, solution builders, system administrators, and power users) to understand how DataMesh is used in practice, identify migration blockers, and validate decisions before they ship
Partner with Customer Success and GTM to plan communications, enablement, and migration support for enterprise accounts that depend on DataMesh
Work with one or more engineering squads, navigating dependencies and making clear scoping and sequencing decisions across a complex, interconnected backlog
Author clear product briefs, requirements docs, and feature specs that design and engineering can execute on without ambiguity
Define success metrics for everything you ship, including DataMesh usage, migration progress, and quality indicators, and partner with data and analytics teams on instrumentation and reporting
Represent DataMesh in leadership reviews, WBRs, and customer conversations, including enterprise account engagements
Perform other duties as assigned

You Have

4+ years of product management experience delivering features within enterprise SaaS or B2B software products
Experience with data management, data modelling, workflow automation, platform integrations, or cross-sheet data referencing is a strong plus
Experience managing a mature product through sustain, deprecation, or migration phases is a plus
Strong customer instincts: you can run structured discovery, synthesise customer feedback, and turn it into well-scoped, validated product decisions
A track record of writing product briefs, requirements docs, and specs that engineering and design can act on without ambiguity
Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, GTM, and Customer Success
Comfort working with engineering teams across time zones, including stakeholders in North America
A data-driven mindset: you define adoption and quality metrics before you ship and use post-launch data to guide iteration
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including confidence presenting in leadership reviews and speaking directly with enterprise customers
Familiarity with API-driven product development or working alongside platform engineering teams is a plus
Legally eligible to work in India on an ongoing basis
Fluency in English is required

Get To Know Us

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

As a Product Manager in the Product Operating Model (POM), your focus is on defining, prioritizing, and delivering products or capabilities that solve customer problems and deliver measurable business outcomes. You are accountable for the success of your product, partnering closely with design, engineering, and business stakeholders. You balance customer needs, business goals, and technical feasibility to ensure your product creates real value.

In This Role You Will Get To

1. Product Discovery & Strategy

Understand the flight order lifecycle through research, data analysis, and feedback loops
Define the product vision, goals, and outcomes in alignment with the group and portfolio strategy to reduce risk to flights P&L. 
Research, troubleshoot, diagnose, and recommend solutions to complex business and technical problems.
Translate data insights and market trends into product opportunities
Outcome Ownership
Define, track, and deliver against product outcomes, lagging and leading indicators. Focussed on outcomes over output. 
Balance short-term risks, long-term opportunities , technical debt, and enabler work in your product backlog
Continuously evaluate whether product initiatives are driving intended value
Stakeholder Alignment & Communication
Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization, including Commercial Teams, Finance, Technology, Accounting, and Financial Planning & Analysis to bring products to market.
Partner with business sponsors, portfolio managers, and cross-functional teams to align on outcomes
Partner with Data teams to identify insights that drive faster decision making. Act as the voice of the flights business and advocate for value delivery in decision-making.
Planning & Execution
Lead quarterly and sprint planning for your product team with an outcomes focused approach. 
Ensure dependencies are identified, managed, and communicated
Participate in demos, standups, and retrospectives to support delivery progress
Roll up your sleeves. We are a lean team and there is no job either big or too small. Some days you will be planning for the next quarter, and other days you will be diving into database records or inspecting API responses to help the development team troubleshoot an issue. We are very hands-on.

Who You Are

Requires a Bachelor's degree; an MBA is preferred.
4-6 years of experience taking full ownership of product success by defining visions and managing priorities to drive business and customer value.
A strategic thinker capable of connecting business opportunities with technical execution across engineering and design teams.
Strong quantitative skills with a focus on data-driven decision-making; knowledge of SQL, Tableau, and BigQuery is advantageous.
Active practitioner of the Product Operating Model, skilled at making trade-offs and empowering teams to deliver consistent value.
An effective communicator who builds alignment across teams and stakeholders fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer-centricity within the Flights team and throughout the organization
Experienced at translating complex problems into clear product requirements and roadmaps with a strong understanding of technical architecture,
Highly organized, self-directed, and focused on outcomes over output
Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust
The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.

External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Description

The vision for Alexa is to be the world’s best personal assistant. Alexa Smart Properties enables enterprise customers to deploy Alexa in their managed properties like hotels, senior living homes, vacation rentals, hospitals, and more, transforming how businesses engage with their customers and streamline staff processes. We’re leveraging Generative AI to reimagine how hospitality, healthcare, senior living, and other verticals deliver magical experiences to their guests, patients, residents, and staff.

If you’re passionate about building enterprise-grade communication and device management solutions — while applying GenAI to solve hard, complex technical problems — then this role is for you. You will operate at the intersection of large language models, content management systems, third party integrations , and enterprise SaaS platforms to deliver delightful, scalable features for our B2B customers and their end users.

Come join us to invent the future of how millions of enterprise end users communicate and connect through Alexa-powered devices — and how businesses manage those experiences at scale.

Key job responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager — Technical in Alexa Smart Properties, you will own and drive the product vision and execution for our enterprise staff personas to make it easy for staff to manage their content, get real time insights, and engage with their end customers. You will own our enterprise console and integrations with third party systems. You will manage how staff manage content in our enterprise console including menus, events, promotions, alerts, and contacts. You will create features to deliver staff real time insights - through intelligent real time events to analytics. You will also build out capabilities to track tickets, orders, and other tasks directly in our enterprise console.

With Alexa Smart Properties, you can also manage your content and end customer engagement using a third party system such as a property management system or resident engagement system. You will manage the roadmap of integrations we develop as well as improvements to accelerate integration speed and scale.

Across both pillars, you will use all means possible — including AI capabilities — to accelerate development cycles, enable faster learning, make better decisions, and unlock new forms of innovation. You will leverage GenAI to rapidly generate prototypes, specifications, and documentation to validate customer value propositions faster. You will deeply understand your product’s business context — market dynamics, competitive landscape, pricing strategy, and profitability drivers — and articulate how product decisions impact business outcomes.

You will define vision (PR/FAQ), problem statements, tenets, and strategy while owning roadmap and priorities. You will influence without authority, building alignment across teams with different priorities — engineering, science, design, finance, marketing, sales, legal, and operations. You will establish key performance indicators, drive feature adoption, and measure the health of your product and business, distinguishing between output metrics such as adoption and outcome metrics such as customer satisfaction and business impact. You will create buy-in for your vision across the Alexa organization and with external partners, and conduct or commission customer research, usability studies, and competitive analysis to identify best-of-breed benchmarks and understand market opportunities.

A day in the life

As a Sr. PMT in Alexa Smart Properties, rarely are two days the same. You are a business owner, the voice of the customer, and the point person for partner teams across communication and device management experiences.

On a daily basis, you will be working with enterprise customers to understand the needs of the staff persona - including needs to manage content, engagement with end customers, and get real-time insights. Your day could consist of writing PRFAQs and BRDs, building a prioritized roadmap, sprint planning/bug bashing, iterating on product decisions with Engineering teams, evaluating how GenAI and agentic systems can accelerate your roadmap, working with partners in business development, solution architects, legal, privacy, documentation, and more. You will think big to envision what’s next for enterprise communications, and exhibit “Learn and Be Curious” for different technologies — including emerging AI capabilities.

You will make informed trade-offs, build your own mockups and prototypes, define acceptance criteria, and participate in testing and validation. You’ll evaluate technical proposals for strengths and weaknesses — including extensibility, performance, and scalability — asking the right questions to identify risks before commitments are made. You’ll assess how AI capabilities can reshape product architectures, when autonomous agent patterns enhance versus complicate product design, and how to leverage GenAI to accelerate insight generation while applying critical judgment. You will use AI on a daily basis to increase your velocity and scale your impact.

You will meet with customers to understand our core strengths and weaknesses, synthesize feedback with business and service data, and drive decisions using sophisticated judgment when data is incomplete. People will look to you to solve problems, connect them with specialists, and hold the tension between business outcomes and customer value honestly.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience managing technical products or online services
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

Product & Feature Definition
Own discovery and detailed definition of platform capabilities, including:
Document ingestion, storage, retrieval and lifecycle operations
Document workflows, routing, approvals and exception handling
Automated Document Recognition (ADR) and classification
OCR and Intelligent Document Processing
Data and metadata extraction, validation and enrichment
AI-assisted search, summarization and document intelligence
Document fraud, tampering and anomaly detection
Human-in-the-loop review and confidence management
Auditability, lineage, access controls and governance
APIs, integrations and extensibility
Convert business problems into product requirements, user journeys, epics, features, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
User Experience
Define UX journeys for enterprise users, administrators, operations and developers.
Simplify document and AI workflows while ensuring usability, accessibility and explainability.
Embed human oversight and responsible-AI principles in AI-driven decisions and recommendations.
Global & Regulatory Product Design
Incorporate privacy, security, compliance, data sovereignty/residency, retention, consent, auditability and localization into product requirements.
Apply privacy-by-design and security-by-design with legal and compliance teams.
Preferred Credentials
7–10 years of experience in product management/ownership or platform strategy related to document management.
Experience in product vision, roadmaps, prioritization, UX and requirements.
Exposure to AI/ML, GenAI, ECM, Intelligent Document Processing, OCR, workflows or enterprise data platforms.
Knowledge of privacy, security, regulatory compliance, data residency, governance and auditability.
Experience in market/competitive analysis, business cases, investment proposals and GTM recommendations.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business or related discipline; MBA desirable.

Key Responsibilities

Own the delivery plan for the Hospital Management Information System across all three phases — sequence, dependencies, and the critical path to the first hospital go-live
Drive the product roadmap for the modules hospitals actually use, and hold the line between what a customer asks for and what belongs in the product
Collaborate across engineering, design, domain and clinical advisors to define success measures, priorities and implementation plans; manage each module from concept through to go-live
Own scope and change control with the customer, using the later phases as the pressure valve when scope grows
Develop the implementation plans, processes and workflows that make a rollout repeatable from the second hospital onwards
Be the single point of accountability for whether the programme ships, when, and whether the customer knows

Voice of Customer

Translate what doctors, nurses, billing staff and hospital management need into user stories, through continuous discovery — floor visits, interviews, and time spent watching the work as it is actually done
Use both usage data and direct feedback to judge whether a feature is working, and to inform what comes next
Analyse trade-offs across customer value, clinical benefit, cost and effort
Run regular demos with the hospital and bring the reaction back to the team the same week
Carry the relationship day to day: the standing update, the escalation, and the uncomfortable conversation about scope or dates

Delivery Oversight

Prioritise work through an ordered backlog of user stories with clear timelines, and keep two sprints of ready, unambiguous work in front of the team
Define and communicate acceptance criteria drawn from business and customer needs
Run planning, stand-up, review and retrospective — short, decided, and worth attending
Track progress against the plan honestly, and report slippage the week it becomes likely rather than the month it becomes certain
Own the risk log, and the closing of the items on it
Own the go-live and hypercare plan with the customer: cutover sequence, training schedule, who is on the floor on day one, and what the rollback looks like
Keep the decision log — decisions taken in a corridor and never written down get re-litigated a month later

Team Enablement

Engage with the team regularly to give feedback on work in progress and to clarify requirements
Coordinate with the founder and the technical leads on resourcing, sequencing and where specialist expertise is needed
Remove blockers — chase the decision, get the access, find the missing answer, clear the dependency
Provide performance management feedback for team members
Protect the team from mid-sprint interruption, and say no on their behalf

What You'll Bring

Bachelor's degree in any discipline, or equivalent work experience — this role is not a technical position and no engineering background is required
Six or more years running software delivery in teams of eight or more, with clear personal ownership of dates and commitments, as a product manager, delivery manager, programme manager or scrum master who did more than facilitate
Proven experience driving and scaling high-performing teams without being their technical leader
Strong communication skills, with the ability to hold a room containing a hospital's medical superintendent and a room containing engineers on the same day, and to explain each to the other
Customer-first mindset, with the judgement to say no to a customer and yes to the product
Comfortable saying "this will be late" early, and to whoever needs to hear it
Experience facilitating requirement discovery sessions to understand business context, user intent and solution objectives
Experience taking a product from concept to launch in front of real users
Experience collaborating with development teams on feasibility assessment and change management
Able to follow a technical discussion well enough to know what is being decided and what it costs, without making the call yourself
Highly organised, with proactive resource and dependency management
Experience with JIRA or similar backlog and project management tools
Willing to travel to the pilot hospital regularly and to be on site through go-live
Preferred experience in hospital, healthcare or another regulated environment where a bad release has consequences beyond a refund
Preferred experience of an enterprise implementation involving data migration, staff training and a hard cutover date
Preferred exposure to Artificial Intelligence (AI) enabled products

Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The Team

Partner Relationship Management (PRM) is one of the newest products inside ServiceNow’s Sales CRM organization, built to help companies run their entire partner ecosystem, from deal registration through MDF to partner facing commerce, natively on the Now Platform. The product is just over a year old. This is a genuine zero to one opportunity: the foundational architecture exists, the first design partners are live, and the roadmap for the next phase is still being written by the people building it today.

What You Get To Do In This Role

Own product strategy and roadmap for a defined slice of PRM, from discovery through launch and adoption
Work directly with design partner customers to validate problems before committing engineering investment, and translate their feedback into clear, buildable requirements
Partner with engineering scrum teams in India day to day to break down epics, sequence releases, and make tradeoffs under real delivery constraints
Define and document detailed specs, acceptance criteria, and data models for complex partner ecosystem workflows (partner hierarchies, deal registration, approvals, MDF, catalog driven quoting)
Collaborate with design and research to shape partner facing and internal facing experiences, from early concepts through usability validation
Represent PRM in cross functional forums across GTM, design, research, and other stakeholder groups, and build consensus on shared priorities
Contribute to competitive positioning and help the team understand how PRM should be differentiated against established players in the partner management space
Mentor and influence product thinking across the broader team, given the staff level scope of this role

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
12+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product area end to end in a B2B SaaS environment
Experience building or scaling products in the partner ecosystem, channel, or partner relationship management space
Strong technical fluency, comfortable going deep with engineering on data models, workflow logic, and system architecture
Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguity and build structure where none exists, this is a zero to one environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience influencing stakeholders across geographies and time zones
Comfortable working with distributed, India based engineering and global product peers across North America

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience with partner relationship management, channel management, or partner ecosystem platforms such as Impartner, PartnerStack, ZINFI, Salesforce Partner Cloud/Community Cloud, SAP, Oracle, or Conga/Apttus
Experience with CRM, CPQ, quote to cash, or order management systems
Experience partnering with researchers and designers in a product trio model
Prior experience at a company with a strong platform or ecosystem play

About the Role:

GSK’s Enterprise AI team, a highly skilled applied AI group, translates the promise of AI into measurable impact across every major group at GSK — R&D, Medical, Commercial, Supply Chain, HR, Legal, Finance, and beyond. Bionic pods — AI product managers, forward deployed engineers, full-stack engineers, data engineers, and digital workers — embed directly with scientific and business teams to build AI products that change outcomes.

We are hiring a Staff, AI Product Manager (Director level equivalent role) to own a major slice of our Global Functions portfolio and act as the strategic counterpart to the engineers and digital workers in your pod, setting the forward deployed strategy they execute against. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can identify and shape high-value AI opportunities across the key areas of Global Functions - HR, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, or Finance, build the case to fund and deploy against them, and ensure FDEs are working on what matters most. You will not manage engineers; you will shape what they build in your domain and how we measure whether it worked.

Why This Role Exists:

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. Enterprise AI has no separate strategy layer: the AI Product Manager sets the forward deployed strategy, and the pod executes it. This role closes that gap at this level by ensuring the engineers we deploy are working on the right things.

In this role you will be the person who:

Owns a clear domain or capability area within the Enterprise AI opportunity portfolio.
Identifies, sizes, and shapes the highest-value AI opportunities in that domain.
Partners daily with forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads to scope and steer engagements end-to-end.
Builds the business and executive alignment the pod needs to land and scale.

How This Differs from Traditional Product Management:

This is not a traditional enterprise product role managing a source system’s roadmap, releases, and backlog. As an AI Product Manager in Enterprise AI, you:

Build new AI products from ambiguous, unsolved business problems rather than evolving an established platform.
Work with probabilistic systems — defining evaluations, acceptable error, and human oversight instead of fixed functional requirements.
Help lead a bionic pod, deciding which work goes to engineers and which to digital workers, and how they hand off.
Prototype hands on and are measured on business outcomes, not features shipped or system uptime.

Key Responsibilities:

Opportunity Identification & Value Sizing:

Hunt for high-value AI opportunities within your assigned domain at GSK; develop a structured pipeline of opportunities ranked by impact, feasibility, and time-to-value.
Quantify value rigorously. Build credible business cases that survive finance and senior business unit scrutiny — cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, cost avoided, scientific productivity gained.
Develop deep domain pattern recognition so you can spot AI-shaped problems in workflows the business itself hasn’t yet articulated.

Strategic Prioritization & Portfolio Shaping:

Shape the opportunity portfolio in your domain. Maintain a living view of in-flight, queued, and de-prioritized opportunities, with the rationale for each decision, and feed it into the broader Enterprise AI portfolio.
Make trade-off recommendations. When two business sponsors both want an FDE pod, defines the success metrics, run the analysis and recommend where engineers go.
Protect engineering focus. Push back — with evidence — on opportunities that won’t move scalable outcomes. 

Engineering Partnership & Enablement

Be the strategic counterpart to forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads in your domain. Translate ambiguous business problems into crisp problem statements, prototypes, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can build against.
Shape engagements end-to-end. Define scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways before kick-off, then stay close as engineers execute.
Surface re-use and platform leverage when a one-off solution should become a reusable capability.
Design the human–digital split. Decide which tasks the pod’s digital workers own, where engineers and business users stay in the loop, and how evaluation and oversight make that safe.

Stakeholder Alignment & Communication

Operate fluently with VP-level business and scientific leaders. Run conversations that turn fuzzy ambitions into concrete, fundable AI engagements.
Build sponsor coalitions that secure data access, change-management commitment, and air cover for your engagements.
Communicate impact clearly in language that connects AI work to patients, science, and enterprise outcomes.

Measurement, Learning & Iteration

Apply Enterprise AI’s value-realization framework to every engagement in your domain and improve it with what you learn.
Run honest post-mortems and feed lessons back into how your domain selects opportunities.

Required Functional Experience:

18+ years of progressive experience spanning some combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML product strategy, and senior product management or strategy roles in technology-led organisations.
Demonstrated track record of identifying, scoping, prototyping, and shepherding high-value technology or AI initiatives from problem framing through funding into delivery.
Strong working knowledge of at least one part of the pharma value chain — R&D, clinical, medical, manufacturing, commercial, or an enterprise function — including the data, decisions, and constraints inside it.
Solid technical fluency in modern AI/ML — LLMs, agentic systems, and digital workers, ML lifecycle, data and evaluation patterns — sufficient to leverage evidence from rapid prototyping to challenge engineers, scope realistically, and avoid hype-driven choices.
Experience operating as a senior individual contributor — leading through influence, frameworks, and quality of thinking rather than headcount.
A product management or product-strategy heritage: discovery, opportunity sizing, roadmap shaping, prototyping, and stakeholder alignment — ideally on products whose core behaviour is AI rather than conventional software.

Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Job Purpose

The Product Owner owns the backlog and roadmap for GSK's network capabilities such as DNS, DHCP and IP address management product, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output.

The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering.

Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.

About The Team

Purplle’s Product Management team builds the technology products that power a comprehensive e-commerce platform. About The Role

We are looking for an Associate Product Manager who will own the product charter for B2B logistics, covering how we move goods to retailers, distributors, modern trade, marketplaces, and institutional buyers, as well as stock movement between our plants and warehouses. You will work at the intersection of product, logistics operations, and finance systems, turning the needs of operations and business stakeholders into reliable, well-built features. This is an individual contributor role with end to end ownership of the B2B logistics roadmap and its business impact. You will work closely with backend engineering, the SAP team, operations, and logistics partners to deliver it.

Key Responsibilities

B2B Logistics Product Ownership

Own the product roadmap for B2B logistics flows, including customer orders, stock transfers between locations, and B2B returns, prioritised by business impact.
Translate operational problems into clear Product Requirement Documents, use cases, and acceptance criteria for engineering and QA.
Lead initiatives such as automatic carrier enablement for B2B shipments and the CPG forward and returns flow, from problem definition to rollout and adoption.
Partner with backend engineering to design, build, and roll out new features, and drive adoption with operations teams.
Maintain a separate B2B layer for carrier and logistics partner integrations, and coordinate with the B2C logistics owner on anything shared.

Delivery Reliability and Network Performance

Own delivery promise reliability for B2B orders, defining and tracking the metrics that show whether commitments to customers are met.
Improve network cost, capacity, and delivery performance across carriers and lanes through structured product changes.
Identify workflow gaps and inefficiencies on the ground and define improvements that scale.

Compliance and ERP (SAP)

Own B2B compliance flows such as e-way bills and invoicing, and keep them aligned with SAP.
Support integration and data consistency between the warehouse systems, logistics partners, and SAP for sales, stock movement, and returns.
Work with engineering, finance, and operations to debug system-level discrepancies and drive root causes to closure.

Governance, Analytics, and Stakeholders

Drive operations governance and risk reduction by defining clear processes, escalation paths, and checks that prevent repeat failures.
Use logistics data and dashboards to track performance, surface insights, and drive data-informed product decisions.
Delegate and escalate effectively, and push repeatable manual work toward automation.
Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to operations, business, and engineering stakeholders.

Must-Have Skills And Requirements

1+ years of experience in a product, analytics, or supply-chain technology role.
BE / B.Tech from a reputed institute. MBA is a plus but not mandatory.
Strong product fundamentals, including the ability to write clear PRDs and use cases, prioritise by impact, and work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
Working understanding of ERP systems such as SAP and how sales, invoicing, and compliance data flow through them.
Solid data analysis fundamentals and the ability to understand discrepancies across systems.
Strong verbal and written communication and stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, operations, and finance teams.
High ownership mindset with the ability to drive a problem from identification to resolution.

Good-to-Have Skills

Exposure to logistics, 3PL, carrier management, or B2B supply chain operations.
Working knowledge of SQL and comfort querying datasets in a cloud warehouse such as BigQuery.
Hands-on experience with BI or data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Metabase.
Familiarity with e-way bill and GST compliance in the Indian supply chain context.
Exposure to Warehouse Management Systems or quick-commerce operations.

What You Will Gain

End to end ownership of the B2B logistics charter, from roadmap to measurable impact.
A role at the intersection of product, supply chain, and technology, with real influence on the roadmap.
Deep exposure to carrier integrations, compliance flows, and SAP across a high-volume e-commerce supply chain.
A clear growth path from Associate Product Manager toward a full Product Manager role.

DrinkPrime runs a subscription business built on physical hardware. Our internal operations span finance, hardware production, inventory, procurement, warehousing, and field deployment. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager for Internal Business Systems to map how these workflows run today, design better ways of working, and convert them into clear system requirements that engineering can build against.
This is an internal systems and process role, not a consumer product role. You do not need to be a finance or hardware expert, but you do need to be exceptional at process thinking, data discipline, stakeholder management, and execution.

What You Will Do
Map current-state workflows across finance, hardware production, inventory, procurement, warehouse, and operations.
Identify the gaps causing data mismatch, manual work, delays, duplication, and unclear ownership.
Design improved workflows — including draft business rules, approval flows, and exception handling. Drive stakeholders toward a clear recommendation and decision
Define source-of-truth logic for key business data: inventory, hardware units, vendors, invoices, production batches, stock movement, and deployment.
Own the roadmap for internal business systems, and convert workflow design into clear, stable, well-prioritised product requirements.
Produce clear documentation like SOPs, process flows, and requirement specs, and monitor enforcement.

Requirements

DrinkPrime is a Bengaluru-based consumer technology company making clean drinking water more accessible through IoT-enabled water purifiers offered on subscription. We serve over one lakh customers across Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, and Hyderabad.
Our business combines consumer technology, connected hardware, field operations, supply chain, and subscription economics at scale. As we grow, we are investing in stronger internal systems and processes that give teams reliable data, clear ownership, and scalable ways of working.
4+ years in product management, business systems, internal tools, business analysis, ERP or systems implementation, operations systems, or B2B workflow products.
Hands-on ownership of at least one internal business system end-to-end. You have implemented, migrated, or significantly extended a named system — ERP, WMS, inventory, procurement, invoicing, or equivalent. Having used such a system does not qualify.
Direct experience with operational or physical-goods workflows — production, inventory, warehouse, logistics, supply chain, or finance operations.

What We Also Expect
Strong process-mapping and structured problem-solving skills.

We're Osome - an international fintech startup making the lives of entrepreneurs easier. We help thousands of businesses kick admin, accounting and bookkeeping out of their day-to-day, so they can spend more time on what's important to them. We've developed a unique solution that combines SaaS with a human-in-the-loop approach to provide full-fledged services in real-time.
We’re experiencing rapid growth in both client base and team, which now comprises around 500 people across our offices worldwide. As we continue to scale, we’re looking for more bright minds who are excited to make a real impact by solving complex problems.

What To Expect
Intelligence builds the AI capabilities no single team at Osome should carry alone, and helps every other team ship AI well. It works in three modes. It owns cross-cutting capability. It enables product teams by pairing with their engineers, so the pattern transfers and the team runs it afterwards. It incubates only by exception: building inside another team's area when that team has no capacity, always with a written hand-back plan.

This is a hands-on PM role. You'll find problems by talking to end users, dig into the data in BigQuery and Postgres to prioritise, prototype cheaply before committing engineering effort, and ship small fixes yourself. You'll also be the team's main liaison with Operations.

What You'll Do
Own the Intelligence roadmap, OKRs and delivery, with two or three big bets each quarter. You make the prioritisation calls, own the business outcome behind the backlog, and write the release notes when things ship.
Set the evaluation bar for AI across Osome: eval datasets, confidence thresholds, human-review sampling and go/no-go gates.
With our Security team, set the safety and data-handling bar for AI across Osome: escalation rules, pre-action checks on agents, fail-open vs fail-closed behaviour, privacy and retention, client data isolation, and provider governance (e.g. zero data retention agreements).
Define the success metrics for each AI product before it ships, then keep checking the data yourself after launch to see whether it's working. Brief the analyst on what to build, and review the result. Use that evidence to make model and provider calls, e.g. benchmark a new model against our own labelled documents before switching.
Break epics into clear stories and tasks that engineers can pick up without a meeting. Pair with product teams' engineers to build AI features, and define what "successfully handed over" means.
Be the team's liaison with Operations: run training and feedback rounds, collect baseline data, and drive adoption until the AI version beats the manual process.
Run a small research track: test new techniques and approaches (e.g. retrieval, memory or agent patterns) on our own problems, and write up what we should adopt and what we should skip.
Represent this team's priorities to senior stakeholders.
As the team grows, mentor other PMs and help manage them.

Who You Are
Evaluated against our PM capability framework. At the Senior PM level, that means:
Strategic impact: you can define and drive a strategy spanning 12 months or more for a platform-style team whose customers are other teams, tied to a company-level goal such as gross margin.
Domain ownership: you own the OKRs, roadmap and business outcome of a complex, ambiguous, cross-functional area. You understand applied LLM/ML products deeply (evaluation, retrieval, memory, agent safety), and can become credible in our accounting and operations domain within two quarters.
Collaboration: you drive high adoption of new tools with operations teams, including the processes needed to run them. You build consensus among senior leaders with conflicting goals, and you can say no while leaving the stakeholder feeling heard.
Problem-solving: you map ambiguous, system-level problems, and know when a rule, a classifier or an LLM is the right tool.
Execution: you reliably ship complex, cross-functional launches involving Operations and other product teams. You prototype to de-risk before committing engineering time, and you spot risks early.
AI-literacy: hands-on well beyond prompting. You build prototypes and ship small PRs with AI coding tools, build eval datasets and run model experiments, read traces, and judge where models fail.
Leadership: you shape direction across teams you don't manage, improve how the team works, and are ready to mentor at least one other PM as a player-coach.

What you bring
AI/ML features shipped to production, with quality measured after launch (accuracy, coverage, deflection).
Experience building evaluation datasets and running model experiments: thresholds, go/no-go gates, human-in-the-loop decisions, and reading traces in an observability tool (we use Langfuse) to see where models fail.
Experience shipping AI features that handle sensitive or financial data, and deciding when they should escalate to a human or stop.
Daily use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to read code and ship small changes.
Strong SQL. You can pick the right metrics for a product and explain what you need to an analyst. Data modelling is not required.
Experience working directly with operations teams: running training, collecting feedback, and proving time saved against a manual baseline.
A track record of good calls under ambiguity, and of checking afterwards whether they were right.
(Nice to have) Setting company-wide safety and data-handling rules for AI: fail-open vs fail-closed policies, privacy and retention, and client data isolation, including knowing when a new AI vendor needs a security review before it sees any data.
(Nice to have) Bookkeeping or accounting literacy: enough double-entry, chart-of-accounts and GST/VAT knowledge to judge whether an AI accounts review or document check is right. Either a qualification or hands-on bookkeeping experience counts.
(Nice to have) Document AI/OCR in production: classifying or extracting invoices, bank statements and receipts, and the trade-offs between coverage, accuracy, confidence thresholds and cost.
(Nice to have) Agentic systems or MCP in production: agents or tools that take real actions, with permissions, human approval steps and multi-step evaluation.

Our Benefits
Multi-cultural environment to enhance your global perspective.
Learning opportunities and mentorship from peers and leaders.
Remote working arrangement.
An agile working model focused on goals and performance.

Equal Opportunity Statement
At OSOME, creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable really matters. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment. We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying. We want to ensure that we represent the diversity of talent in the society we live in today.

If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the application and interview process, please let us know so that we can support you.
We believe that entrepreneurs are society's problem solvers. They see opportunities in complexities and drive us towards progress. Osome doesn't want entrepreneurs to be distracted from the important task of searching for the best solutions. The Product Owner owns the backlog and roadmap for GSK's wireless and local area network product, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. About the Role:
We help e-commerce brands ship millions of orders through many delivery partners. Behind every order are a few simple questions. Which delivery partners can reach this customer? Which one is the best choice for this order? When will it actually arrive? And what happens when something goes wrong?
You'll own the products that answer those questions, along with the AI agents we're building on top of them.

We're looking for an AI-native PM. You'll own AI products, and you'll also use AI for most of your own work. You'll use AI coding tools like Claude Code or Cursor to analyze data, build simulations, prototype agent workflows, investigate issues, and turn your repeated tasks into reusable tools.
Something that takes a traditional PM a week with an analyst and an engineer should take you an afternoon.

What you will do:

1.Delivery coverage
How brands set up which delivery partners can serve which locations.
Making setup faster for new brands and reducing configuration errors and support tickets.
Outcome: Brands go live faster, and fewer orders fail because no suitable delivery partner was available.

2. Delivery partner selection and recommendations
The rules and rankings that decide which delivery partner handles each order.
Balancing cost, speed, delivery success, returns and partner capacity for each brand.
Outcome: Lower cost per delivered order, higher delivery success, and brands that can see why each partner was chosen.

3. Simulation
Running what-if simulations before anything changes in production, like "what happens to cost and delivery time if we move 15% of orders from one partner to another?"
Turning the results into clear recommendations that brands can act on.
Outcome: Every major change is backed by a simulation before it goes live.

4. Delivery date promise
How accurate the delivery date shown to shoppers is, how often we miss it, and how that affects the brand's sales and customer experience.
Outcome: Shoppers see delivery dates they can trust, and brands see fewer complaints about late orders.

5. AI agents
Defining and shipping AI agents that recommend strategies, explain performance changes, and answer customer questions on their own.
Owning the evaluation: when the agent is right, when it's wrong, and how we know which.
Outcome: Agents that resolve a measurable share of questions end to end, with answers people can trust and act on

6. Data analysis and customer issue resolution
Digging into large datasets to answer questions like "why did this partner's share of orders jump last week?" or "why did delivery success drop in this region?"
Owning customer escalations from the moment they're reported until they're closed, and turning the patterns you see into product fixes.
Outcome: Faster answers for customers, and fewer of the same issues coming back.

How you'll work:
You build things yourself. Use AI coding tools to write SQL, Python scripts and simulations, and build working prototypes without waiting for engineering bandwidth.
You automate what you repeat. If you investigate the same type of issue twice, the third time it should be a reusable script, tool or agent workflow.
You turn your knowledge into something AI can use. Write the guides, knowledge bases and prompts that our AI agents and internal teams rely on.
You test AI properly. Define evaluations, test against real cases, find the failure modes, and know when an agent is confidently wrong.
You prototype before you write the spec. Show engineering a working prototype instead of a 10-page document whenever you can.
You own outcomes end-to-end. Write clear PRDs, then stay involved through build, testing, rollout and adoption. Track your products' metrics every week and act when they drift.
You work across teams. Work directly with Engineering, Data Science, Customer Success, Sales and customers.

What success looks like: First 90 Days
First 30 days: You understand how our core products work end-to-end, you've investigated real customer cases, and you've resolved your first few escalations on your own.
By 90 days: You own one or two product areas outright, you've shipped at least one meaningful improvement, and you've delivered at least one simulation-backed recommendation to a customer.
By 6 months: Your products' metrics (delivery date accuracy, recommendation quality, escalation volume, agent accuracy) have measurably improved, and you've automated a meaningful share of your own recurring work.

Strong with data. SQL and Excel at scale, plus enough Python, with AI assistance, to run your own analysis and simulations.

About the Role

PubMatic is building the next generation of AI-powered products for digital advertising, including intelligent agents that help customers monitor marketplace performance, identify new opportunities, troubleshoot issues, make recommendations, and take action. We are also evolving our data visualization, reporting, and analytics platform that publishers and partners rely on to understand their performance.

We are looking for a highly technical, customer-oriented Product Manager to lead our Agentic Platform and AI strategy while driving the roadmap for our analytics and reporting platform. This role owns the foundational capabilities that enable teams across PubMatic to build, evaluate, deploy, and operate production-grade AI agents, and leads strategic customer-facing AI and analytics experiences that turn complex marketplace data into actionable intelligence.

You will work at the intersection of Generative AI, agentic systems, advertising technology, data, and product experience. You will partner closely with engineering (onshore and offshore), design, and commercial teams, and with DSPs, ad networks, agency trading desks, exchanges, publishers, and audience/data providers, to turn emerging AI capabilities into scalable products that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Do

          AI and Agentic Platform

  • Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for PubMatic's shared AI and Agentic Platform, enabling teams company-wide to build and operate production-grade AI agents.
  • Own platform capabilities including agent orchestration, model and tool integration, context and knowledge management, evaluation frameworks, observability, governance, and reusable agent infrastructure.
  • Lead the strategy and development of publisher- and marketplace-facing AI experiences that transform complex marketplace data into actionable intelligence.
  • Build rigorous evaluation methodologies combining offline evaluation, golden datasets, LLM-based evaluation, human review, experimentation, and production telemetry.
  • Define success metrics across AI quality, customer adoption, task completion, business impact, latency, reliability, and cost.

    Data Visualization, Reporting & Analytics

  • Define, develop, and execute the vision, roadmap, and requirements for PubMatic's data visualization, reporting, and analytics platform.
  • Develop clear, compelling PRDs and user stories for new initiatives and enhancements, including business justification, revenue potential, and operational impact.
  • Monitor product adoption, proactively identify opportunities, and make actionable recommendations to drive uptake and effectiveness.

    Common Responsibilities

  • Validate product direction through customer and internal stakeholder interaction and by analyzing market and product trends.
  • Create and maintain a prioritized product backlog.
  • Work closely with UX and engineering teams to guide development and testing.
  • Partner with Sales, Services, and Product Marketing on training, collateral, and product rollout, and evangelize PubMatic offerings internally and to prospects and the installed base.
  • Own the full product lifecycle, from opportunity identification and strategy through requirements, experimentation, launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.

We'd Love for You to Have

          Required Qualifications

  • 6-8+ years of Product Management experience, including 1-2 years of hands-on experience leading technically complex agentic platforms and building AI agents in production, and experience in data visualization, analytics, or business intelligence.
  • Strong understanding of modern AI application architecture, including LLMs and reasoning models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation and knowledge systems, agent orchestration and tool use, AI evaluation and experimentation, prompt and context engineering, and observability and production monitoring.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify business problems and strategic, revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner deeply with engineering and AI teams, making thoughtful product and technical tradeoffs.
  • Experience taking ambiguous, zero-to-one products from concept through production and measurable adoption.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to define metrics and evaluation frameworks for probabilistic AI systems.
  • Firm sense of accountability and ownership for the end-to-end product lifecycle.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical teams, customers, and senior leadership.

          Preferred Qualifications

  • 2-5 years of experience in the online advertising industry, including ad tech, programmatic advertising, and marketplaces.
  • Experience building enterprise AI products where reliability, governance, privacy, security, and explainability are critical.
  • Familiarity with agent interoperability standards and architectures, such as MCP, agent-to-agent communication, structured tool calling, and multi-agent systems.

Hyperproof is on a mission to transform the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) world with a powerful new software platform. With Hyperproof, companies can save time and money while also operating their programs at a much higher level of effectiveness and accountability. About the role

We're hiring an Associate Product Manager to help own US Payroll. You'll work on the features that make sure every US employee and contractor is paid accurately and on time, and that taxes, deductions and benefits are handled correctly. It's a role for someone early in their product career who wants to go deep into a hard, high-stakes domain and grow fast.

What you'll do

Own features across the US payroll run: pay schedules, regular and off-cycle payrolls, approvals, payroll funding and data checks that keep payroll on time.

Help improve integrations with benefits providers (such as 401(k) and health insurance) and accounting tools (such as QuickBooks).

Talk to US payroll admins and customers. Understand their workflows and pain points and turn them into clear product priorities.
Work with CX, Implementation and Support to understand escalations, find root causes, and fix recurring themes for good.
Work with partner teams to understand their APIs and behaviour, and raise and track issues that affect our customers.
Define success metrics for what you ship, track adoption and correctness, and improve based on data.

Engineering partnership

Collaborate with Engineering, Design and other teams to guide product development from concept through to launch, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
Define product requirements for AI-driven features (ML forecasting models, conversational AI modules) with the same rigour as deterministic features, including clear scoping of what the AI is and is not responsible for.
Engage internal and external stakeholders, including customers, to gather feedback, understand requirements and ensure product success.

7+ years of experience in product management, with a proven track record of leading successful product initiatives.

Strong customer orientation with a passion for creating products that deliver exceptional value and user experience.

Desirable
Experience as a visionary, analytical and collaborative product leader who thrives on solving complex problems.

Direct experience shipping AI or ML-powered features, including forecasting models, anomaly detection or conversational/LLM-based assistants, and communicating their capabilities and limits honestly to clients.
