Place of Posting - Bengaluru

Team : Economic Inclusion Program

About The/Nudge

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.

Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.

Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.

What are we solving for?

We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.

At The/Nudge Institute, We Have Been Piloting This Program For The Past 3 Years And Are Now Scaling It Across Multiple States. Our Purpose Is To Enable The Most Excluded Individuals To Become Contributing Members Of The Economy. We Will

Enable government to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
Continue to iterate on the program design to create impact at scale through our own implementations
Support more NGOs in adopting graduation approach by offering technical expertise and capacity building
Build evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Develop technology solutions that enable NGOs and governments to adopt and implement the program at scale & with quality

Position Overview

What are some of the principles/ approaches we use?

First principles thinking
Human centered design (thoughtful, action oriented, experimental & iterative process) with a gender lens (unbiased and reflective approach) 
Systems thinking (analytical, stakeholder oriented and holistic)
Strategic planning (result oriented, logical & coherent with clearly defined outcomes, grounded in current realities)

What will you do?

We are hiring an Associate Manager, Product Planning Feedback and Adoption to independently own planning, adoption and feedback workstreams across multiple state programs. The person will translate program priorities into measurable plans, ensure that product interventions and tools are used effectively, and build feedback loops that turn field experience into product and operating improvements.

This role combines hands-on program management with analytical and strategic ownership. The Associate Manager will work closely with State Operations, Product, Technology, Insights, Livelihood, Learning and Development, and program leadership. The role requires the ability to facilitate decisions, identify risks early and drive actions to closure with limited supervision.

Key Responsibilities

Planning and program visibility
Strengthen governance. Design weekly, fortnightly and monthly review rhythms that result in clear decisions, owners and next steps.
Strengthen collaboration between State Operation teams and Central Product teams through a regular cadence.
Adoption and data driven action
Own adoption across states. Lead the adoption of product interventions and tools from rollout through sustained and meaningful use.
Define meaningful metrics. Establish metric definitions, data sources, reporting frequency and data quality checks.
Interpret performance. Analyse trackers and dashboards, segment gaps by state, block, cohort or tool, and distinguish process, product and data issues.
Convert insights into action. Develop state-specific recommendations, align owners and timelines, and monitor whether interventions improve adoption.
Feedback systems and product improvement
Design end to end feedback cycles. Define the milestone, respondents, sampling approach, questions, scoring logic and success measures.
Ensure reliable data collection. Coordinate with state teams, monitor response quality and resolve collection gaps without compromising timelines.
Synthesize field evidence. Combine quantitative and qualitative inputs into clear product and process recommendations prioritised by impact, urgency and feasibility.
Close the feedback loop. Track accepted actions with owners and timelines, communicate decisions to stakeholders and verify closure.
Stakeholder leadership and communication
Anchor cross-functional forums. Set the agenda, prepare concise pre-reads, facilitate the discussion and keep reviews focused on decisions and actions.
Influence without authority. Build alignment across State Operations, Product, Technology, Insights and domain teams, and escalate dependencies with context and options.
Create leadership visibility. Prepare scorecards, reviews and written updates that explain progress, risks, underlying causes and specific asks.
Raise execution standards. Guide team members and partners on data discipline, meeting preparation, documentation and follow-through.
What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means that program plans and adoption metrics are trusted and used in reviews; risks are surfaced early with clear recovery plans; state and product teams receive recommendations that improve adoption; and field feedback leads to prioritised, tracked and communicated product or process improvements.

Who are we looking for in this role?

Experience and education
Relevant experience. 6+ years in program management, product operations, strategy and operations, implementation consulting or large-scale operations.
Independent ownership. Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional, multi-location or multi-state workstreams from planning through closure.
Education. A postgraduate degree or MBA is preferred. Candidates with a bachelor's degree and strong relevant experience will also be considered.
Core capabilities:
Analytical fluency. Can define and interpret metrics, question data quality, identify patterns and translate analysis into practical recommendations.
Structured problem solving. Can break down ambiguous problems, identify root causes, evaluate options and make sound recommendations.
Stakeholder management. Can build credibility, navigate differing priorities and influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.
Executive communication. Can facilitate effective meetings and communicate complex information clearly in written and verbal formats.
Execution discipline. Is organized, detail-oriented and proactive about follow-ups, risks and escalation while managing multiple priorities.
Tools. Is proficient in Excel or Google Sheets and comfortable working with dashboards and presentation tools.
Language and travel. Has strong written and spoken English and Hindi, and is willing to travel to and stay in rural program locations when required.
Good to have:
Sector experience. Exposure to livelihoods, social impact programs, government systems or large-scale field implementation.
Product adoption. Experience driving adoption of digital tools or process interventions across distributed teams.
Research and feedback. Experience with survey design, qualitative research, feedback synthesis or user research.
We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.

Are you passionate about harnessing the power of data, AI, and analytics to shape the future of underwriting? Do you thrive in collaborative environments where your insights drive real business impact? If you're ready to bring your expertise in data science and portfolio management to a global stage, we'd love to hear from you. Join our Actuarial Portfolio Management, Credit and Surety team at Swiss Re and be part of something truly transformative.

About The Role

In this role, you will be at the heart of analysing and steering the Credit and Surety portfolio, leveraging advanced internal and external data to drive both risk and profitability outcomes. You will work at the intersection of data science, actuarial thinking, and business strategy — collaborating with underwriting, finance, operations, claims, risk management, and actuarial teams across Swiss Re.

This is a rare opportunity to apply cutting-edge data science to real-world portfolios, connect macroeconomic trends to market performance, and bridge the gap between insurance and banking through credit portfolio management.

Key Responsibilities

Translate business needs into solutions by working closely with stakeholders to understand problem statements and business context, converting them into well-defined analytical requirements
Build and deploy analytics solutions for the Credit and Surety line of business, contributing to portfolio steering and monitoring in alignment with strategic objectives
Drive data-driven transformation by collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop innovative solutions that enhance risk management and underwriting efficiency
Design and maintain large-scale data pipelines using PySpark and Python, ensuring robust, optimised, and scalable data transformation processes
Develop interactive dashboards and visualisations that deliver strategic insights to business stakeholders, enabling informed decision-making
Lead project delivery and provide guidance to junior colleagues, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence
Investigate portfolio patterns and trends, connecting economic indicators to performance outcomes to support long-term profitability

About The Team

We are a friendly, collaborative, and client-focused team within Swiss Re Corporate Solutions. The Actuarial Portfolio Management Credit and Surety (APM C&S) team reports directly to the Head of Underwriting Excellence and partners with portfolio owners to provide a robust framework for portfolio steering and strategic insights.

We are passionate about data-driven outcomes and constantly explore new ways to tackle complex challenges through quantitative models and data transformation. Our team brings together diverse expertise — from data science and actuarial science to credit and risk management — creating an environment where curiosity, innovation, and collaboration thrive. Whether you're solving a complex modelling problem or presenting insights to senior leadership, you'll always have the support of a team that genuinely cares about each other's success and the impact we create together.

About You

You are a curious, driven, and collaborative professional who thrives on turning complex data into meaningful business insights. You bring strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build effective working relationships across disciplines and cultures. You are organised, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Your ability to blend quantitative rigour with clear communication — through compelling visualisations and presentations — sets you apart.

We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements

5+ years of analytical experience with hands-on expertise in PySpark and Python, particularly in building and optimising large-scale data transformation pipelines
3+ years of SQL experience, with the ability to write and optimise complex queries confidently
Extensive experience in data visualisation and developing interactive dashboards tailored to business stakeholders, with a focus on delivering strategic insights
Proven track record of applying analytical skills to real business data to develop actionable insights and practical solutions
Solid academic background (university degree or higher) in Data Science, IT, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, or an equivalent field

These Are Additional Nice To Haves

Experience with Palantir Foundry or other big data platforms
Background in credit quantitative models, credit portfolio management, or risk management in banking or insurance
Experience working in an Agile environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver business outcomes
Knowledge of credit aggregation, global macroeconomics, financial markets, and credit-related products; experience in Trade Finance and Surety sectors is a plus
Experience leading project delivery and mentoring junior colleagues
Advanced English communication skills, both written and verbal
Proven ability to work independently, solve complex problems, and drive business impact through data-driven strategies

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

About Swiss Re

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. Microsoft 365 powers some of the world’s most critical productivity experiences at massive global scale. The M365 Core organization builds the foundational platforms that enable Microsoft 365 services to deploy, operate, scale, and evolve safely and efficiently.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the M365 Core team in Noida and help shape the future of our cloud infrastructure and safe deployment platforms.

This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, deployment and release management, reliability, developer experience, and AI. You will work closely with engineering teams and partner organizations to simplify complex infrastructure problems, build scalable platform capabilities, and rethink how AI can transform the way large-scale cloud services are developed and operated.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager, you will:

Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for foundational cloud infrastructure, deployment, and service-management capabilities. 
Partner deeply with engineering teams to solve complex problems in deployment, release safety, service reliability, infrastructure management, and developer productivity. 
Understand the needs of service engineering teams and translate them into scalable platform capabilities rather than point solutions. 
Build experiences that make it easier and safer for developers to deploy and operate services at cloud scale. 
Use product telemetry, customer feedback, operational signals, and engineering insights to identify opportunities and measure impact. 
Drive adoption of platform capabilities across multiple services and engineering teams. 
Simplify complex technical concepts into clear product priorities, requirements, and executive-level narratives. 
Work across organizational boundaries to align stakeholders, make thoughtful trade-offs, and drive results. 

AI-Forward Product Leadership

We are specifically looking for a PM who believes AI and agents can fundamentally change how cloud infrastructure is built and operated. 

You Will Explore Opportunities Such As

Applying AI to operational signals, deployment data, incidents, logs, and engineering knowledge to surface actionable insights. 
Creating intelligent and agentic experiences that help engineers diagnose problems and make better operational decisions. 
Automating repetitive operational and deployment workflows while maintaining appropriate safety and governance. 
Using AI to improve developer productivity and reduce the cognitive load associated with operating complex distributed systems. 
Rapidly prototyping AI-powered experiences with engineering teams and validating them with real users. 
Understanding the strengths and limitations of LLMs, agents, retrieval systems, and emerging AI technologies and translating them into practical product opportunities. 
We are looking for someone who uses AI as an integral part of their own product management workflow, not simply someone who manages an AI feature. 

Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product management .

Additional Or Preferred Qualifications

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 

Preferred Qualifications

Solid product management experience delivering technically complex products or platforms. 
Demonstrated ability to work closely with engineering teams on cloud services, infrastructure platforms, developer platforms, distributed systems, reliability, or related areas. 
Solid product thinking with the ability to move between customer problems, technical architecture, product strategy, and execution. 
Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous problem spaces and create clarity and direction. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior engineering and product stakeholders. 
Solid analytical skills and a track record of using data to inform product decisions. 
Experience with large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform products. 
Understanding of CI/CD, deployment systems, service reliability, observability, incident management, or infrastructure automation. 
Hands-on familiarity with modern AI tools and AI-assisted product development. 
Understanding of LLMs, AI agents, retrieval-based systems, evaluation, and modern AI application architectures. 
Experience building products for developers or technical users. 
Ability to prototype ideas using AI-assisted development tools, scripting, data analysis, or lightweight application development. 
Experience driving platform adoption across multiple engineering organizations. 

What Success Looks Like

Platform Thinker You think beyond individual features and identify reusable capabilities that can solve classes of problems across a large cloud ecosystem. 
Technical Product Leader You are comfortable going deep with engineers on infrastructure, deployment, reliability, and architecture while maintaining a solid customer and product perspective. 
AI-Forward Builder You actively experiment with AI, understand where it genuinely changes the product experience, and push beyond simply adding AI features to existing workflows. 
Customer-Obsessed PM You understand the engineers and service teams using your platform, deeply investigate their friction points, and turn those insights into simple, scalable product experiences. 

Why This Role

This is an opportunity to work on foundational technologies that influence how some of Microsoft’s largest cloud services are deployed, operated, and protected at global scale. 
You will tackle problems where cloud infrastructure, safe deployment, reliability, developer productivity, and AI converge, with the opportunity to build capabilities that can benefit a broad set of services and engineering teams. 
We are looking for a PM who is comfortable with complexity, passionate about platforms, and excited to help define what an AI-native operating model for cloud services should look like.

Our Company 

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

What You’ll Do 

In this role, you will serve as a product leader driving Teradata’s data protection product management strategy and execution across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata delivers resilient data protection for the world’s most sensitive enterprise data; spanning backup and recovery, replication, disaster recovery, business continuity, and cyber resilience. 

Your impact will be shaping how customers meet aggressive RTO and RPO targets at Petabyte scale ensuring reliable backup, rapid recovery, and continuous data availability across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. You will accelerate the delivery of the Enterprise data protection and resilience roadmap, balancing innovation with performance, reliability, and compliance. 

Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise-grade data protection and resilience solutions for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, differentiating Teradata and unlocking measurable customer value while preserving scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency. 

Who You Will Work With

On our team, we collaborate with customers, engineering, cloud infrastructure, security operations, governance, field teams, and UX functions to bring next-generation data protection and resilience capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of backup, recovery, and resilience initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives. 

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field. 
12+ years of product management experience, including 6+ years leading data protection, backup and recovery, or disaster recovery products at enterprise scale, including Managed Service Providers 
Deep technical expertise across the data protection stack: backup software and storage platforms, deduplication and compression, snapshot management, replication topologies, immutable and air-gapped storage, ransomware recovery, DR orchestration, and RPO/RTO optimization across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. 
Proven success embedding backup, recovery, and resilience capabilities into enterprise data platforms at petabyte scale, with measurable improvements to customer SLA attainment and recovery confidence. 
Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud architectures and their impact on backup strategy, data residency, sovereignty, storage tiering, and cost optimization. 
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate data protection product strategy to both technical and executive audiences. 
Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking against leading backup and data protection vendors and native cloud provider capabilities. 

What You Will Bring

Expertise architecting enterprise backup topologies, cyber resiliency and Agentic AI data protection strategies across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, with a focus on minimizing recovery time 
Hands-on knowledge of leading backup and recovery platforms (e. g. , Rubrik, Veeam, Cohesity, Commvault, Zerto, NetBackup) and cloud-native backup services (AWS Backup, Azure Backup, Google Cloud Backup and DR). 
Ability to connect backup and recovery strategy to modern AI/ML and analytics workloads, including protecting training datasets, model checkpoints, feature stores, and data pipelines against corruption, accidental deletion, and ransomware. 
A strong understanding of backup retention policy design, covering lifecycle management, legal hold, eDiscovery readiness, and compliance-driven retention schedules for regulated data classes (PII, PHI, PCI) across tiered and archival storage. 
Vision to anticipate industry trends, next-generation backup architectures, AI-driven anomaly detection for data corruption, and data sovereignty mandates and position Teradata’s data protection offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready. 



Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

We're hiring an Associate Product Manager to help own US Payroll. Own features across the US payroll run: pay schedules, regular and off-cycle payrolls, approvals, payroll funding and data checks that keep payroll on time.

Engineering partnership

A good partner to Engineering: you work through disagreements with evidence and customer outcomes, and you're open to changing your mind.

Uses AI tools to learn faster, research, and work more efficiently.
Open to working with US customers and partners, including some calls in US hours when needed.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.
Own the Identity and Access Management product roadmap and deliver enterprise-grade authentication features that secure every connection between Appian and the enterprise.
ABOUT THE TEAM
The IAM Product team is on a mission to secure every identity, authentication flow, and access point that connects Appian to the enterprise. This team operates with high autonomy and directly influences how global enterprises trust and deploy AI-Powered Process Automation at scale. Your work will define how millions of users authenticate securely across mission-critical workflows.
THE OPPORTUNITY
As enterprises accelerate digital transformation, identity security has become the frontline of platform trust. This role exists because Appian is scaling its authentication and authorization capabilities to meet zero trust demands from the world's most security-conscious organizations. You will shape how the platform handles federated identity, modern protocols, and seamless user experiences in highly regulated environments.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Lead the end-to-end IAM product roadmap, defining priorities that balance enterprise security requirements with developer and end-user experience
Partner with Engineering to evaluate, design, and enhance authentication and authorization capabilities including native authentication and support for SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and federated identity frameworks
Execute discovery and requirements gathering with enterprise customers to understand identity provider integrations, compliance needs, and zero trust adoption patterns
Architect product specifications and user stories that translate complex identity protocols into intuitive, scalable platform features
Drive cross-functional alignment with Security, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver authentication features that accelerate enterprise adoption
Analyze product performance metrics, customer feedback, and competitive positioning to continuously improve IAM capabilities and reduce friction in authentication flows
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field
4+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager with a proven track record of successfully managing products that involve identity and access management
Deep experience with identity and access management, user authentication, or identity provider software in enterprise environments
Strong technical proficiency with authentication protocols including SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and federated identity architectures
Demonstrated ability to collaborate with engineering teams to define technical requirements and deliver secure, scalable authentication solutions
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Knowledge of zero trust architecture principles and implementation strategies
Experience working with cloud identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, Ping Identity, or Auth0
Background in cybersecurity, compliance frameworks, or enterprise security product management
We value experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce or ServiceNow, as these skills translate well into our Enterprise-Grade Orchestration environment.
This role is based at our Chennai office in DLF Downtown Chennai. Appian was built on a culture of in-person collaboration, which we believe is a key driver of our mission to be the best. Employees hired for this position are expected to be in the office 5 days a week to foster that culture and ensure we continue to thrive through shared ideas and teamwork. We believe being in the office provides more opportunities to come together and celebrate working with the exceptional people across Appian. 
Tools and Resources 
Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires. 
Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.
Benefits
Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.
About Appian
Appian provides AI automation for the most important business processes at the world’s largest organizations. Our platform is known for its unique power, reliability, and scale. We’ve been automating processes for more than 25 years and have proven expertise in enterprise operations. For more information, visit appian.com. 
Follow Appian: LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, and X. 
Appian is an equal opportunity employer that strives to attract and retain the best talent. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. 
Appian provides reasonable accommodations to applicants in accordance with all applicable laws. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at ReasonableAccommodations@appian.com. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.

About Bluevine

Bluevine is the largest small business banking platform in the U.S., redefining how entrepreneurs manage their money. We create modern financial solutions, from checking and lending to payments and beyond, designed to help small business owners grow, thrive, and take control of their financial future. Our best-in-class technology, advanced security, and deep understanding of the small business community give our customers the confidence to focus on what they do best.

Since 2013, we’ve supported more than 750,000 small businesses nationwide. Backed by leading investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Menlo Ventures, 83North, and Citi Ventures, our 500+ person global team shares one mission: to give small businesses the financial tools they need to succeed.

We’re innovators driven by big ideas, collaboration, and real impact. Here, you’ll have the freedom to take ownership, grow your career, and make a difference for small business owners across America. Ready to shape what’s next?

ABOUT:

Bluevine is looking for an experienced Product Manager who will own and drive the roadmap for payments, collections, capital markets, accounting & finance for the lending business unit. The platform and systems used in this domain are mission-critical and impact the experience for our clients and serves as the backbone for internal stakeholders’ workflows.

This person will be responsible for articulating the business case for and delivering new features as well as enhancing our existing solutions, based on customer and stakeholder feedback and data driven analyses. This role will require collaboration with a broad set of technical and non- technical stakeholders, including R&D, risk and back-office operations, support, business operations, accounting and finance teams, and legal & compliance.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Own and drive the product roadmap for payments, collections, capital markets, and accounting & finance within the lending business unit — aligning features and initiatives to company strategy, OKRs, and KPIs through close collaboration with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
Conduct business discovery and gather requirements from a broad set of internal stakeholders, including risk, back-office operations, accounting, finance, and legal & compliance teams
Define detailed technical specifications for new features and projects, outlining business requirements, acceptance criteria, and system design considerations — serving as a precise guide for engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle
Partner closely with R&D and QA teams through sprint planning and execution, conducting UAT before production deployments and driving issues and bugs to resolution
Monitor and maintain mission-critical systems across payments, accounting, and capital markets — ensuring data accuracy, integrating with banks and vendors, and enhancing internal operational tools for efficiency and scalability
Identify the business case for new products and enhancements through data analysis, SQL-based querying, customer feedback, and stakeholder input — prioritizing work for highest business impact
Facilitate smooth communication between R&D teams and business stakeholders, providing regular project updates, managing expectations, and proactively identifying and mitigating risks
Conduct demo sessions for new features prior to launch and develop training materials and reports for stakeholders and partners

WHAT WE LOOK FOR:

5+ years experience as a Product Manager in a fast-paced technology company
Fintech lending experience is a plus but not mandatory.
A self-starter with a bias to action who is able to move projects forward and lead a cross- functional team towards product solutions
Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with the ability to interact with a diverse group of technical and non-technical stakeholders
Advanced analytical skills, including experience with data analysis and SQL
Demonstrated track record of launching successful products and features
Experience managing complex projects with limited resources and competing priorities
Experience with using AI tools such as Gemini, ChatGPT and Claude for research, automation and prototyping.
B.A. or B.S. in physics, computer science, engineering, or related field
Previous work experience in a technical role is a plus
Masters, PhD, or MBA will be considered when evaluating work experience

Benefits & Perks

Excellent group health coverage and life insurance
Meal allowance
Transportation assistance (terms and conditions apply)
Generous paid time off plan, Holidays
Company-sponsored mental health benefits
Financial advisory services for both short- and long-term goals
Learning and development opportunities to support career growth
Community-based volunteering opportunities

Who We Are

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role

We are seeking a Connectivity Product Manager to own and evolve strategic connectivity platforms within Vodafone Cloud & Infrastructure. The role focuses on driving the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle management of FlowDB and GIANT, ensuring alignment with connectivity strategy, customer requirements and technology priorities. Working closely with architecture, engineering, operations and delivery teams, you will translate business and technical needs into prioritised product outcomes, support investment decisions, and help deliver scalable, automated and customer-centric platform capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to influence product direction across an international environment while driving adoption, value realisation and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Do

Collaborate with product owners, network architects, engineering, operations and delivery teams to define and enhance product capabilities 
Support business case creation, funding approvals, go-to-market activities and communication plans for product initiatives. 
Drive simplification, standardisation and automation initiatives across the product lifecycle 
Monitor product performance, adoption, customer feedback and value delivery through measurable business and technical KPIs. 
Manage product risks, dependencies and lifecycle decisions while supporting Agile and SAFe ways of working 


Who You Are

Experience working within Product Management in connectivity, telecommunications, network infrastructure, cloud infrastructure or technology platform environments. 
Strong knowledge of product roadmap development, demand management, prioritisation and portfolio management. 
Experience working in Agile environments, including Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) practices
Good understanding of telecom and network services, cloud technologies and supporting infrastructure platforms

Opportunity to shape the future direction of strategic connectivity platforms used across a global telecommunications environment

Experience improving activation, retention, repeat usage, and conversion through product interventions.

About Rupeek
Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Bangalore, Rupeek is an asset-backed digital lending fintech making credit more accessible by helping Indians unlock the value of their gold. We combine technology, customer-focused design, and on-ground execution to make borrowing simpler and more convenient.
Rupeek is backed by leading investors including Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & Southeast Asia), Accel, Bertelsmann India Investments, and Elevation Capital.
Join us to solve meaningful challenges at the intersection of consumer experience, technology, and financial services—with ownership to shape products and see their impact on customers and the business.

Experience: 3–5 years in product management

The opportunity
Help more customers discover Rupeek, take their first loan, and choose us again.
As Product Manager for Consumer Growth, you’ll own growth opportunities across our app and web journeys—from initial discovery and onboarding to conversion, repeat borrowing, and referrals.
You’ll combine customer research, product analytics, and experimentation to make borrowing simpler and more intuitive. Your mandate is to deliver measurable, sustainable growth while building customer confidence at every step.

Activation and conversion: Identify where customers hesitate or drop off, and improve the journey from first visit to a successfully disbursed loan.

About Kulfi

Kulfi is where couples in India spend time together, even when they can't be in the same place.

About 100 million unmarried Indian couples don't get to be together most nights. Different cities, different homes, parents around. A phone is all they have. So they join a class just to be near each other, or stay on a one-way call, or watch a movie over video. They do all this for love, and nothing was built for them.

We are building that. Kulfi is a digital experiences app for couples, and close to a million people already use it. We did not get here by spending. Daily users grew 4x in 30 days this summer. We added 100,000 users in the first 20 days of August without paying for a single ad. 80% of all play happens between 9pm and midnight. That is bedtime, and we own it. We are backed by South Park Commons and by founders and CEOs from Swiggy, Mosaic Wellness, Snitch and Moonshot.

Next is an AI personalization engine for games. Every couple gets a new game every day, made for them on the spot from what they like. Our team already ships a new game in about two days. No couple should run out of things to do together.

India has more couples than any other country. We want every one of them on Kulfi.

We are a small, high-intensity team. Your work will reach real users quickly, and you will be expected to notice what is broken—not wait for someone else to notice it for you.

What you will do

App-Level Product Management

Own the Core Funnel: Optimize app-level surfaces end-to-end—onboarding, couple-pairing/invite flows, home tab navigation, and permission prompts (push notifications, mic, media).
Drive Retention & Notification Loops: Architect the lifecycle messaging engine (push, in-app nudges) tailored around couples' bedtime usage (9 PM–midnight).
Monitor App Health & Friction: Track app-level hygiene metrics (app cold-start time, crash-free sessions, ANRs, session length) and systematically eliminate UX friction points across Android and iOS devices.

A/B Testing & Experimentation

Run a High-Velocity Experimentation Engine: Formulate crisp, hypothesis-driven test designs across onboarding variants, invite copy, game discovery feeds, and engagement triggers.
Define Metrics & Guardrails: Establish clear primary success metrics (e.g., D1/D7 retention, couple-activation rate) alongside explicit guardrail metrics (e.g., unsubscribe rates, session abandonment) for every test.
Own Telemetry & Instrument Events: Define and audit exact tracking schemas (clicks, impressions, state changes) in tools like PostHog, Mixpanel, etc. to ensure clean event telemetry before launching variants.
Analyze & Iterate: Interpret experiment results using sound statistical principles (statistical significance, minimum detectable effect, sample size calculations), document post-test readouts, and scale winners while killing losers fast.

Discovery & Execution

PRDs: Write concise, zero-fluff specs with explicit edge cases, state diagrams, and variant logic that engineers (and Claude) understand in one-shot.

What we are looking for

Super Curiosity (The "Why" Driver)
First-Principles Breakdown: You constantly dissect consumer apps—deconstructing why an onboarding flow converts, why a specific push copy gets opened, or why an experiment produced counter-intuitive data.
Obsession with Human Behavior: You care deeply about relationship psychology and bedtime rituals, spending time understanding what motivates couples to return every night.
Hunger for Data Nuance: You do not accept surface-level dashboard summaries; you segment cohorts (OS, network speed, partner presence) to uncover hidden patterns.
High Agency (The "Make It Happen" Driver)
Proof of Unprompted Building: You have designed, shipped, or operated something from scratch—a campus product, a micro-SaaS, or an automated tool.
Zero Learned Helplessness: If tracking is broken, you read the documentation and debug the payload. If copy is missing, you write five variants. You never wait for someone to unblock you.
Extreme Ownership
Experimentation & Analytical Rigor
Statistical Common Sense: Solid grasp of sample sizing, confidence intervals, p-values, and false positives. You understand why declaring an A/B test winner after 12 hours is misleading.
Funnel Literacy: Deep familiarity with conversion mechanics, cohort retention curves, and leading vs. lagging indicators.
Communication Clarity: Exceptional structured writing—capable of summarizing complex experiment results and trade-offs in three concise bullet points.
Working knowledge of SQL

Bonus points (helpful, not required)

Hands-on experience with experimentation platforms or feature flagging.
Familiarity with modern AI prototyping stacks (Cursor, Lovable, v0) to demonstrate functional product flows.

Interview process

Application Screen: Focused strictly on proof-of-work, clarity of thought, and personal projects.
15-Minute Intro Screen: Evaluates agency, pace, and core motivation.
60-Minute Live Product & Experimentation Jam
45-Minute Founder Chat: Deep dive into ambition, work ethic, self-direction, and cultural alignment.
Reference Checks: Concrete verification of agency, grit, and speed of execution.

Calling anyone at Kulfi directly or contacting them on WhatsApp will result in immediate rejection of your application.

About Aerchain (Why Us?)

We’re rewriting the rules of procurement with an AI-first platform that powers $20B+ in enterprise spend.

From $4M ARR today to $25M ARR and beyond, our mission is to build enterprise-grade, AI-first procurement software for global enterprises across manufacturing, FMCG, and services.

Role Snapshot

You’ll own one or more high-complexity modules and be accountable for the outcomes they drive across customers. You’ll work with enterprise clients to ensure they realise value from the product, lead solutioning for complex accounts, define what your modules build and why, and ensure they deliver measurable customer value. You’ll work across business, engineering, and leadership, and mentor PMs / Builders. You build the solution yourself, prototyped in AI, and engineering builds forward from what you’ve made rather than from a blank page.

What You’ll Drive

Problem Discovery & Research

Drive discovery for your modules: understand customer problems, workflows, and success criteria at the deepest level.
Diagnose and size problems to a standard others can follow. Pressure-test recommendations, including your own.
Zero escalations without a fully formed recommendation and reasoning.

Customer Ownership

Own Tier A or Tier B customer engagements end-to-end, from understanding their problems to ensuring they realise value from the product.
Solution enterprise clients independently, coordinating with PMs / Builders where modules overlap.
Be the single point of contact for Tier A or Tier B customers through delivery, adoption, and outcome validation.

Solutioning & Prototyping

Own the roadmap for your modules: what gets built, deferred, and killed, with reasoning tied to customer outcomes.
Write the PRDs and build the prototypes for your modules: scenarios, edge cases, and acceptance criteria all present before grooming. Review PM / Builder work and find what’s missing.
Build your prototypes in AI and hand them to engineering as the foundation they build forward from.
Backend, hardening, and refinement of functionality all start from your prototype, not a blank page.
Use AI across every step: research, problem framing, drafting, prototyping, validation. Set the standard for your modules.

Execution & Delivery
Own delivery for your modules. Coordinate across engineering and business teams and unblock issues before they become delays.
Own the quality bar for your modules. A delivery failure in your modules is your failure.

Release & Adoption

Define and track the customer-value metrics for your modules, metrics that answer: is this module making procurement measurably better?
Own post-release outcomes for Tier A or Tier B customers. Stay in the loop until value is confirmed.
Mentor PMs / Builders: show them what good looks like.

You’ll thrive here if

6–9 years in product roles with clear progression from feature ownership to module ownership.
You diagnose complex, ambiguous problems and make high-stakes calls with confidence.
You use AI as a core part of how you work and raise the bar for those around you, and you build with it, prototyping solutions engineering carries forward.
You develop people by doing: you show PMs / Builders what good looks like, not just tell them.
You own outcomes, not activities. You stay in the loop until value is confirmed, not until the feature ships.
Bonus: exposure to enterprise SaaS, complex B2B environments, or procurement tech.

What’s In It For You

Module-level ownership with full authority over what gets built and why.
Work with enterprise clients on problems that matter, and stay accountable until value is confirmed.
A direct line to a Principal PM / Lead Builder, with no bureaucracy between your judgment and the decisions that matter.
A culture where problem solving, ownership, and action are rewarded, and the opposite is called out.

Ready to build Aerchain’s future?

If reimagining business engines with AI and solving problems at scale excites you, let’s talk.

Apply now and help us build the most agile enterprise SaaS story in the world.

About HRS

Your Role

Enterprise customers and hospitality partners both depend on seamless, reliable digital experiences to get things done accurately, in real time, and at scale. As a Senior Product Manager at HRS, you will take ownership of a product area within our platform ecosystem, driving the roadmap, continuous discovery, and measurable business outcomes as an accountable member of a cross functional Product team.

This is not a maintenance role. We are looking for a PM who combines execution discipline with strong domain judgment, applies AI as a default part of their own workflow, and is energized by building products that make hospitality, meetings, and travel experiences simpler, smarter, and more reliable.

Your Key Responsibilities

Own the product vision, roadmap, and prioritization for your product area, working as a genuine peer with your product and engineering stakeholders.
Apply Working Backwards thinking to every initiative: start from the desired customer and business outcome, define the right problem precisely, and validate assumptions before committing to solutions.
Drive continuous discovery into customer, partner, and operational pain points, translating findings into a prioritized, evidence based roadmap.
Own and evolve a clear KPI framework for your area (such as reliability, conversion, onboarding time, data accuracy, or partner and customer satisfaction) and run structured experiments to improve it.
Drive adoption of AI and agentic automation across core workflows, including onboarding, monitoring, issue resolution, and partner or customer support.
Use AI tools as the default across your own PM workflow: discovery synthesis, PRD drafting, competitive analysis, stakeholder communication, and roadmap prioritization.
Build strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including technology and hospitality partners, business operations, customer success, and engineering.

What You Bring

8+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in TravelTech, HospitalityTech or B2B SaaS and marketplace or platform businesses.
Demonstrated, hands on experience shipping AI powered or AI augmented product features, not just familiarity with AI tools; you can speak concretely to problems you have solved using AI, ML, or GenAI in a product context.

About BiteSpeed

Hey there! We are a Sequoia-backed SaaS startup building an AI-native Marketing, Support & Sales suite for e-commerce brands.

We're currently working with 3000+ e-commerce brands globally across 50+ countries and are fortunate to have raised $5.5M+ along the journey with marquee investors like Sequoia Capital India, Kunal Shah, Gaurav Munjal & more backing us.

About The Role

Enterprise customers rarely come to us with neatly packaged problems. They come with a business goal, a messy process, a bunch of systems that don't talk to each other and a question: "Can AI solve this?"

We’re looking for an AI Product Manager who can sit with our enterprise customers, understand these problems deeply and turn them into AI-powered solutions. You’ll operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, operations and customer conversations, working closely with our product and engineering teams to take solutions from an idea to something that actually works.

This isn't a traditional PM role where you'll spend your days writing PRDs and moving tickets around. You'll be expected to get into the weeds, understand how things work, figure out what can be automated or solved with AI, and work backwards from the business outcome. You’ll have a front-row seat to some of the most interesting AI use cases emerging in commerce.

What You'll Do

Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their business processes, pain points and goals, and identify opportunities where AI can create meaningful impact.
Translate ambiguous business problems into AI-led solution strategies, figuring out what should be automated, augmented or redesigned.
Own the solutioning process from problem discovery to implementation, working closely with engineering, product and customer-facing teams.
Design workflows and solutions using LLMs, AI agents, automation and BiteSpeed's product capabilities to solve real customer problems.
Work with enterprise stakeholders to build business cases, define success metrics and communicate the expected impact of proposed solutions.
Get hands-on with the details when required, whether that's understanding APIs, data flows, system architecture or experimenting with AI tools and prototypes.
Identify patterns across customer problems and feed those insights back into the product roadmap, helping us decide what should become a scalable product rather than a one-off solution.
Build repeatable solutioning playbooks, processes and operating mechanisms that help us solve enterprise problems faster as we scale.
Partner with Sales and Customer Success on strategic accounts, helping them win, onboard and grow enterprise customers through better technical and AI-led solutioning.
Stay close to the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem and continuously experiment with new models, tools and approaches that could unlock better solutions for our customers.

What Makes You a Good Fit

You enjoy sitting with a messy problem and figuring out "how would we actually solve this?" rather than waiting for someone to hand you a requirements document.
You have a strong technical foundation and are comfortable understanding APIs, integrations, data flows and software systems. You don't necessarily need to be a full-time engineer, but you should be technical enough to go deep when the problem demands it.
You have 3+ years of experience in product, solutions engineering, consulting, technology, strategy & operations or a similar role where you've solved complex business problems.
You are genuinely curious about AI and LLMs and have experimented with AI tools, agents, workflows or applications beyond simply using ChatGPT to write emails.
You are comfortable speaking to enterprise customers and senior stakeholders, understanding their problems and explaining technical solutions in simple business language.
You have strong business judgment and can distinguish between a problem that needs a fancy AI solution and one that just needs a better process.
You are comfortable operating with ambiguity and high ownership. There won't always be a playbook, and that's kind of the point.
You care about outcomes more than job titles and enjoy moving between strategy, customer conversations and getting your hands dirty with execution.

Salary and Location

Location: Bangalore

Expected CTC: We pay top of market for the right folks and also offer generous equity (ESOP) to the team

Our Purpose

At BiteSpeed, work is personal. You could blame this on us being existential, but most of us are spending the best years of our lives doing this and we want to be purposeful about the kind of workplace we’re trying to create.

Our purpose is about why we’re here and what we care about:-

Personal Transformation
Wealth Creation
Winning Together

Our Values

Our values are about how we do what we do. Values define the right thing to do. We hire, reward and sometimes have to let go based on our values.

We have 5 core values:-

Go Above And Beyond
Making Things Happen
Say It Like It Is
Progress Over Perfection
Don’t Take Yourself Seriously, Take Your Work Seriously

Perks & Benefits

Small things we’ve done to ensure we take care of our wellness, learning & keep things fun:-

Health Insurance - Health insurance cover and accident coverage for extra cushion and mental peace when rainy days hit us.
Quarterly Off-sites - Quarterly off-sites are a core part of the BiteSpeed culture. Our off-sites range from intense quarter planning sessions to crazy mafia nights and competitive cricket matches (with a lot of trash talking).
Cult Fitness Membership - All work and no play makes jack a dull boy. Cult Fit and Cult Play passes to make sure we hit the gym more often.
Personal Development - We sponsor courses, conference tickets, books on a case to case basis to ensure we’re constantly growing.
Salary In Advance - Trust first, by default. We pay out salaries in the first week of the month.

About Us

As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com

Alter Domus Intelligence (ADI) is our next-generation, AI-native platform: a single, cross-asset front end for our clients and their investors that replaces fragmented legacy portals with one coherent, trusted experience. ADI’s first use cases go live in October 2026, and the platform is now building toward a much broader product vision across the entire client and investor journey.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own two foundational layers of ADI: the ADI Platform — the technical and product foundation on which every ADI squad builds — and the Global Master Data Management (GMDM) / Entity Master capability, which is the single mastered entity layer that every squad in the programme depends on.

ADI is a micro front-end (MFE) architecture: a common shell (authentication, navigation, notifications, search, component library, home and admin pages) into which independent squads — Investor, Payments, Fund of Funds, Reporting and others — plug their surfaces. GMDM sits beneath all of them: it is the single canonical source of truth for Clients, Investors, Funds, Vendors and related parties across the entire enterprise — the foundation without which no squad can correctly identify, secure, or display its data.

You are not building features for end users directly — you are building the products that enable every other product team. Your customers are internal squads and their engineers, and your success is measured by their velocity, consistency, and ability to ship. At the same time, you own capabilities that are end-user facing and mission-critical: authentication and access control, the home experience, notifications, universal search, the shared component library, and the Entity Master admin experience. You must hold both platforms to the same rigour as any customer-facing product — with performance, availability, security, data quality and developer experience treated as first-class requirements.

You will work hands-on: authoring executable PRDs, building the first prototypes yourself, and partnering tightly with engineering, architecture, and the other product managers across the ADI programme.

Your Responsibilities

Platform vision, strategy & roadmap

Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for the ADI Platform — the MFE shell, authentication and authorisation layer, shared component library, notifications engine, universal search, and all cross-cutting platform capabilities.
Define and maintain a clear boundary between what the Platform owns and what belongs to feature squads — resolving ambiguity at pace and with authority, so no squad is ever blocked by an unclear ownership question.
Prioritise the platform backlog against squad-enablement velocity, non-functional requirements, technical debt, and programme-level delivery commitments.
Act as the product authority for the platform, making the decisions that trade off between feature-squad needs and platform coherence.

Developer experience & internal product

Treat the other ADI squads as your primary customers — understand their dependency needs, pain points and roadmap commitments, and design the platform to enable them rather than constrain them.
Own the golden-path developer experience: template projects, the shared NPM component library (Photon), CI/CD patterns, MFE composition standards, and deployment infrastructure — ensuring every squad has a well-lit path to building and shipping.
Establish and govern the standards and contracts between the platform and squad microsites — import maps, API standards, component versioning, and token enrichment — so the platform can evolve without breaking consumers.
Work alongside the other product managers to help their teams onboard to, and correctly consume, platform capabilities.

Authentication, authorisation & multi-tenancy

Own the end-to-end authentication and authorisation product: integration with CIAM and GSP, role-based access control (RBAC), UI component-level authorisation patterns, token enrichment, and the multi-tenancy and client-isolation model.
Define the access model clearly — who can see what, in which context, for which client or fund — and ensure it is implemented consistently across every squad’s surface.
Own org context switching, user account management (/account), and the admin experience (/admin).

Core platform experiences

Own the ADI home page — including the customisable widget framework (calendar views, user-based preferences) — and ensure it serves as a coherent, high-value landing experience for all user personas.
Own universal search across ADI — defining scope, relevance, and the integration model with squad-specific content — in alignment with the AI-unified search strategy.
Own the notifications engine — defining the notification taxonomy, routing logic, SLA and priority model, and the interfaces through which feature squads publish notifications — and partner with the squads (e.g. Fund of Funds, Payments) who consume it.
Own the cross-team calendar service, the feature-flagging framework, and user-analytics instrumentation.

Global Master Data Management (GMDM) / Entity Master

Own the product vision, roadmap and backlog for GMDM — ADI's single mastered entity layer covering Clients, Investors, Fund Structures, Vendors and related parties, each with a unique enterprise ID, cross-reference registry, relationship model, and full audit trail.
Define what GMDM must expose to each consuming squad — the canonical data contracts, API interfaces, field ownership model, and change-event choreography — and ensure every squad can consume entity data without building their own shadow copies.
Own the boundary between GMDM (enterprise identity and organisational mastering) and GSP (resource-level authorisation) — resolving the integration model with the Platform squad and ensuring tenant isolation and security are production-grade.
Own the Entity Master admin experience — the UI through which data stewards and operations teams create, manage, merge, soft-delete and audit entity records — and drive adoption of clean, governed data entry practices across the business.
Act as the product interface between GMDM and the 10+ squads that depend on it (Investor, Payments, Fund of Funds, Waterfall, Private Credit, Reporting, I3C and others) — managing their inbound requirements, triaging competing demands, and making clear prioritisation decisions so the squad is not swamped by reactive asks.
Partner with operations, client delivery and data stewardship teams to ensure production entity data is owned, populated and maintained — closing the gap between a live API and an empty or brittle data set.
Own the data quality and governance model for entity master data: field-level ownership, source-system ingestion pipelines (Salesforce, Fenergo, SAP, Investran, eFront), and the cross-reference and deduplication standards that underpin every downstream squad's data reliability.

Non-functional requirements & operational readiness

Own platform-level non-functional requirements — performance, availability, scalability, security (including penetration testing), accessibility and observability — as first-class product requirements, not afterthoughts.

Job Description:


DeeVita is seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to own the vision, roadmap and delivery of our regulatory compliance software products and services for the pharmaceutical industry, spanning digital labelling, serialization and track-and-trace, and supply chain traceability. You will work directly with global pharma clients, translating complex regulatory requirements and industry standards such as GS1, DSCSA, EU FMD, ePI and GxP into validated, scalable products. You will partner closely with engineering, QA and validation teams, and with client stakeholders in regulatory affairs, quality and supply chain, from discovery through release.


We are a team of talented, collaborative engineers who are passionate about making a difference in the healthcare and pharmaceutical industry.   • Monitor evolving global regulations and guidance from health authorities (US FDA, EMA, CDSCO and others) and convert them into product requirements and roadmap priorities.
  • Influence stakeholders across the organization through effective communication, excellence in subject matter expertise and systems knowledge to plan, design and deliver programs and systems objectives that create greater impact for clients
  • Act as the primary product contact for global pharma clients (US, EU and other regions), leading requirement workshops, product demos and roadmap reviews.

About the Role
Delhivery moves millions of shipments a day across one of the most complex physical networks: pickups, line-haul, sorting, last-mile, returns, and cross-border. Every one of those steps generates data, decisions, and money on the table. We believe the next decade of logistics will be won by whoever applies AI most intelligently to the physical world.
We are building a team of Product Managers who will reimagine logistics with an Agentic first approach. You won't be bolting a chatbot on a dashboard. You will own problems where a better model or a smarter agent changes unit economics, customer experience, or network reliability at national scale.
.What You’ll Do
Find the right problems. Spend time in hubs, with riders, ops leaders, and merchants. Translate messy operational pain into opportunities for creating a seamless flow that scales.
Own outcomes, not outputs. Define success metrics tied to cost per shipment, delivery success, NPS, or revenue, and be accountable for moving them.
Ship AI products that real operators use. Design human-in-the-loop workflows, fallbacks, and feedback loops so models earn trust on the ground and keep improving after launch.
Drive adoption across the org. Work with Operations, Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience to embed AI into how teams actually work.
Partner deeply with data science and engineering. Shape problem formulation, data requirements, evaluation methodology, and model-versus-rules trade-offs. Understand precision/recall, drift, latency, and cost well enough to challenge and be challenged.
Run rigorous experimentation. A/B tests, shadow deployments, and phased rollouts across geographies and hubs, with clear go/no-go criteria.
Stay at the frontier. Evaluate new LLM, agentic, and vision capabilities, and decide pragmatically what to build, buy, or fine-tune.
The kind of problems you could own
Network intelligence: demand forecasting, capacity planning, dynamic routing, and ETA prediction across the network
Last-mile optimization: address intelligence and geocoding, delivery-attempt prediction, route and slot optimization, rider productivity
Computer vision on the ground: shipment damage detection, automated weighing and dimensioning, sort-center throughput, proof-of-delivery verification
Generative AI and agents: autonomous customer support, ops copilots for hub managers, document and invoice automation, internal knowledge assistants
Risk and trust: fraud, RTO (return-to-origin) prediction, NDR resolution, and merchant risk scoring
Pricing and commercial intelligence: dynamic pricing, serviceability, and yield optimization
You will be matched to problem statements based on impact, your strengths, and the stage of each problem. Expect to work across more than one.

What We’re Looking For
Experience
2–5 years in product management, ideally with at least 1–2 years shipping ML or AI-driven products (or a strong data science, ML engineering, or analytics background that you have transitioned into product)
A track record of taking a product from ambiguous problem to measurable business impact
Strong academic grounding; engineering degree from a top-tier institution preferred, MBA a plus but not required
Skills
Working fluency in ML concepts: model evaluation, training data quality, feedback loops, and the practical differences between classical ML, deep learning, and LLM-based systems
Hands-on comfort with data: SQL is a must, Python or notebooks a plus. You pull your own numbers.
Experience with, or sharp point of view on, GenAI product design: prompt and eval design, RAG, agents, guardrails, and cost/latency trade-offs
Excellent structured thinking and the ability to communicate with engineers, data scientists, and frontline ops leaders equally well
Bias to action, ownership, and comfort operating in complex, high-volume, real-world environments
Pedigree signals we value
Prior experience at product-led or AI-forward companies (marketplaces, e-commerce, mobility, fintech, SaaS, or AI-native startups)
Evidence of impact: shipped models or AI features with quantifiable results, side projects, or published work
Curiosity about the physical world: supply chains, operations, and hardware-meets-software problems
