About The Role

The SBU Connectivity Product Management Lead is the portfolio-level owner for product management, product evolution, go-to-market orchestration, and lifecycle value realization across SBU Connectivity. The role consolidates the former product-specific Business Lead responsibilities into one Product Management organization while maintaining distinct product lines for telematics and connectivity offerings and clear interfaces with the Global Business Lead for overall commercial/business ownership.

You will translate market, customer, technology, and RFQ signals into a coherent portfolio roadmap, investment priorities, differentiated product propositions, and executable business cases. Drive a product-first operating model that increases reuse, reduces bespoke development, improves R&D return, and strengthens global market adoption through close partnership with NPI, Systems/Solution Architecture, Product Engineering, Global RFQ/Early Engagement, Global Delivery, Finance, Sales, and the Global Business Lead.

You will lead a globally distributed team of product managers and regional GTM product managers and influences a broad matrix spanning engineering, architecture, delivery, finance, sales, marketing, and customer teams. Success requires enterprise-level judgment across multiple product lines, regions, customers, investment horizons, and technology generations.

Manage the global Product Management organization spanning telematics/connectivity product lines and regional GTM product management in the Americas, Europe, Japan, India/APAC and other priority markets. You

will build a strong product management discipline with common methods for roadmaps, business cases, product requirements, lifecycle governance, GTM readiness and portfolio decision making.

What You Will Do

Own Portfolio Product Management: Drive product evolution, 3–5-year roadmaps and lifecycle decisions across Connectivity, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, and profitability. 
Lead GTM & Regional Product Management: Convert market and Voice-of-Customer signals into product priorities, positioning, value propositions, sales enablement and launch readiness. 
Partner for Growth: Work with Global Business Lead, Sales and RFQ/Early Engagement to shape opportunities around scalable products and derivatives rather than bespoke solutions. 
Own Product Business Cases & Value Realization: Establish product investment logic across market potential, pricing, revenue, margin, R&D, lifecycle cost, reuse and ROI in partnership with Finance. 
Manage Product Performance: Track adoption, pipeline fit, reuse, financial contribution, roadmap execution and customer feedback, taking corrective action when expected value is not realized. 
Connect NPI to Product Ownership: Partner with NPI to mature new concepts and technology opportunities into validated product propositions with disciplined transition into portfolio ownership. 
Drive Cross-Functional Product Realization: Partner with Architecture, Engineering and Global Delivery to translate market needs into scalable platforms, executable roadmaps and reusable production-ready releases. 
Establish Product Management Excellence: Standardize MRD/PRD, roadmap, business case, launch, lifecycle and decision frameworks while resolving cross-product priorities at portfolio level. 
Build Global Product Leadership: Develop a high-performing global Product Management and GTM organization with strong accountability, a customer-centric, data-driven, product-first culture. 

What You Need To Be Successful

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business or a related field; advanced technical or business degree preferred. 
20+ years of progressive experience in automotive, connectivity, technology or adjacent industries, including significant leadership responsibility across product management, business development, GTM and product commercialization. 
10+ years leading senior, globally distributed teams and complex matrix organizations across multiple regions, customers and product lines. 
Demonstrated ownership of multi-product roadmaps, product lifecycle decisions, business cases, pricing/value propositions, investment prioritization and go-to-market execution. 
Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to balance revenue, margin, R&D investment, product reuse, time-to-market and long-term portfolio value. 
Broad understanding of automotive connectivity and telematics technologies including cellular/5G, V2X, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/GNSS, cloud/edge services, cybersecurity, OTA and automotive-grade hardware/software platforms. 
Proven ability to convert customer and market needs into differentiated, scalable product propositions while resisting unnecessary bespoke complexity. 
Executive communication and influencing skills with credibility across customers, senior leadership, engineering, sales, finance, partners and globally distributed teams. 
Ability to make high-quality decisions under ambiguity and lead transformation across organizational boundaries without relying solely on direct authority. 

Bonus Points if You Have

MBA or advanced degree paired with a technical undergraduate degree. 
Experience leading telematics/connectivity portfolios spanning mobility segments. 
Experience with ecosystem partnerships, new business models, software/services monetization and global OEM commercialization. 

What Makes You Eligible

You are willing to travel up to 30% domestic and 15% international travel. 
Due to the nature of global teams and customer base, you understand that flexibility in working hours is required. 

What We Offer

Flexible work environment, allowing for full-time remote work globally for positions that can be performed outside a HARMAN or customer location. 
Access to employee discounts on world-class Harman and Samsung products (JBL, HARMAN Kardon, AKG, etc.). 
Extensive training opportunities through our own HARMAN University. 
Competitive wellness benefits. 
Tuition reimbursement. 
“Be Brilliant” employee recognition and rewards program.

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. About The Role

Cornerstone is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead a core area of our Learning product line. This is a senior product leadership role that combines product vision and strategy, people leadership, and disciplined execution. You will own the strategy and roadmap for your area, lead and grow a team of product managers, and be accountable for delivering learning experiences that drive measurable adoption, learner and administrator value, and commercial impact.

You will partner across engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, sales, and marketing to move capabilities from customer need through discovery, launch, adoption, and outcome realization. In this role you will... 

Set vision & strategy

Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for your area of the Learning portfolio, grounded in market trends, customer needs, and Cornerstone's strategy.
Make and defend prioritization decisions with clear rationale, translating strategy into a sequenced roadmap and well-formed bets.
Frame the business case for major investments — market sizing, opportunity, and expected outcomes — and align leadership and cross-functional partners behind it.
Champion AI and skills-based innovation where it creates real learner and administrator value, integrating intelligent capabilities responsibly into the learning experience.

Lead & grow the team

Hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers, setting a high bar for product craft, customer empathy, and accountability.
Establish product standards and operating cadences for discovery, planning, release, and outcome review across your team.
Create clarity and alignment across product, engineering, and design leadership, and represent your area to executives and customers.

Discover, experiment & measure

Drive rigorous customer discovery, engaging directly with enterprise customers, learners, and administrators to validate problems and use cases before committing to solutions.
Run a hypothesis-driven practice — define success metrics, instrument products, and use experimentation and A/B testing to learn quickly and de-risk decisions.
Define and own the success metrics and North Star for your area (adoption, engagement, retention, time-to-value, and business outcomes), and use them to guide investment.
Translate customer, field, and market feedback into clear requirements, prioritized backlogs, and release plans.

Deliver with rigor

Drive cross-functional delivery across product, engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, and go-to-market teams.
Establish strong operating cadences for milestone reviews, dependency management, risk tracking, and outcome measurement, surfacing risks early.
Partner with go-to-market and customer-facing teams on rollout planning, launch enablement, implementation readiness, and feedback loops.
Ensure capabilities are scalable, secure, compliant, and practical for adoption in enterprise environments, meeting expectations for security, privacy, and data governance.

A clear, well-communicated vision and roadmap that leadership, customers, and the team understand and rally behind.

We are seeking a senior sustainability professional with 15+ years of commercial-building domain experience to lead customer sustainability transformation through smart building technologies, digital platforms and Agentic AI-enabled operating models. Responsibilities

Sustainability Strategy & Advisory

Lead sustainability assessments and strategic roadmaps for commercial buildings, real estate portfolios, campuses and critical infrastructure.
Advise customers on decarbonization pathways, energy optimization, net-zero programs, ESG reporting and sustainability best practices.
Identify opportunities to improve building performance, occupant experience, operational resilience and environmental impact.
Provide solution consulting across discovery, assessment, solution definition, implementation support and value realization.

Agentic AI for Intelligent Building Operations

Define and scale Agentic AI applications that autonomously monitor, analyze, recommend and optimize commercial-building operations.
Develop use cases across energy optimization, carbon reduction, predictive maintenance, fault detection, space utilization, comfort control and ESG performance monitoring.

Translate customer sustainability challenges into AI-enabled solution architectures using digital twins, IoT data, BMS/EMS integration, OT systems, analytics and autonomous decision workflows.

Customer Engagement & Value Communication

Engage C-level executives, sustainability leaders, facility managers, operations teams and engineering stakeholders as a trusted advisor.
Develop compelling business cases covering ROI, energy savings, carbon abatement, productivity gains, asset uptime and reduced manual operational effort.
Facilitate workshops, executive briefings and strategy sessions that align sustainability ambition with practical implementation roadmaps.
Present recommendations, deployment plans and realized outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Solution Development, Delivery & Measurement

Partner with sales, product management, engineering, consulting and services teams to create customer-centric sustainability and AI solutions.
Support solution architecture and implementation planning to ensure proposed capabilities deliver measurable environmental, operational and financial outcomes.
Define KPIs, baselines and measurement frameworks for energy intensity, carbon emissions, comfort, uptime, issue resolution and adoption.
Establish repeatable playbooks and frameworks for AI-driven sustainability consulting and autonomous building optimization.

Innovation & Thought Leadership

Track emerging sustainability regulations, market needs, smart-building technologies, AI/ML innovation, GenAI, Agentic AI frameworks and digital transformation trends.
Contribute to new offerings, solution accelerators, service models and scalable frameworks for intelligent building operations.
Represent the organization in industry forums, customer events, executive briefings and sustainability-focused engagements.
Mentor teams and foster a culture of innovation, customer centricity, responsible AI adoption and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Sustainability, Energy Management, Environmental Engineering or a related discipline; master's degree preferred.
15+ years of experience in sustainability consulting, energy management, commercial building operations, building automation, smart buildings, facility management or related industries.
Deep knowledge of Building Management Systems (BMS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), building automation, IoT architectures and operational technology environments.
Practical experience in sustainability assessments, energy audits, carbon accounting, building-performance optimization and decarbonization programs.

Demonstrate business value from autonomous decision-making, predictive optimization and intelligent building operations.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Product-Led Growth based in India.

As Director of Product-Led Growth, you will lead the strategy and execution of a scalable, revenue-generating product-led growth engine for a global cloud technology business. You will own product-led annual recurring revenue (ARR), driving customer acquisition, freemium conversion, expansion, and retention. Working at the intersection of Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Sales, you will translate complex cloud and developer platform capabilities into intuitive, high-impact user experiences. You will establish data-driven growth strategies, optimize the entire customer journey, and identify new monetization opportunities. Your leadership will help accelerate international expansion, strengthen customer engagement, and deliver measurable commercial results. Join a collaborative, remote-first environment that values innovation, autonomy, diversity, and continuous learning while shaping the future of cloud platforms and AI-assisted development.

Accountabilities

Own product-led revenue growth: Define and execute the product-led growth strategy, taking full accountability for ARR generated through self-service experiences, from initial signup to paid conversion, expansion, and retention.
Drive acquisition and commercial performance: Develop scalable growth programs, establish measurable revenue and user acquisition targets, and accelerate adoption across key international markets.
Align cross-functional teams: Partner with Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, and Sales to translate product strategy into measurable customer outcomes and sustainable business growth.
Optimize conversion and monetization: Identify and implement in-product monetization opportunities, improve onboarding and self-service conversion funnels, and strengthen product-led sales handoffs for enterprise customers.
Improve customer engagement and retention: Use behavioral analytics, customer intent data, churn indicators, and customer satisfaction metrics to refine the user experience, increase lifetime value, and improve retention.
Build a data-driven growth culture: Establish performance metrics, test growth hypotheses, analyze results, and continuously improve acquisition, activation, conversion, and expansion strategies.
Support product innovation: Collaborate with product leaders to align platform capabilities with customer needs, developer workflows, and emerging opportunities in AI-assisted software development.

Requirements

Proven product-led growth leadership: Significant experience as a Senior Product Manager, Director, or in a comparable leadership role within a SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or developer-focused technology business operating primarily through a product-led model.
Direct revenue accountability: Demonstrated ownership of revenue targets and commercial outcomes, including ARR growth, customer acquisition, freemium-to-paid conversion, and retention.
Strategic and commercial expertise: Ability to translate complex technical products into accessible self-service experiences that deliver measurable customer and business value.
Cross-functional leadership: A strong track record of leading growth initiatives across Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Sales, with the ability to align diverse stakeholders around shared objectives.
Advanced growth analytics skills: Hands-on experience with funnel optimization, user activation, conversion analysis, experimentation, monetization strategies, and customer retention metrics.
Technical fluency: Practical understanding of developer workflows, cloud infrastructure, and modern software development environments, including the evolving role of AI-assisted development tools.
Strong communication and leadership: Excellent analytical thinking, strategic judgment, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence teams in a distributed, international environment.
Additional advantages: Experience managing both product-led growth (PLG) and product-led sales (PLS), familiarity with PaaS, IaaS, DevOps, or developer platforms, and a proven ability to scale product-led revenue across global, remote-first teams.
Remote-work readiness: Ability to work effectively in a multicultural, distributed environment and collaborate across functions, time zones, and geographic markets.

Benefits

Flexible paid time off: Take time away from work to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance.
Healthcare coverage: Comprehensive healthcare benefits in eligible locations, including the UK, Canada, France, Spain, and the United States.
Equity participation: Company stock options that provide an opportunity to share in the company's long-term success.
Professional development: Dedicated budget for learning, training, and career growth.
Home office support: Equipment budget to create a productive and comfortable remote workspace.
Wellness benefits: Dedicated wellness budget to support personal well-being.
Global team gatherings: Annual opportunities to connect, collaborate, and build relationships with colleagues worldwide.
Inclusive parental leave: Parental leave designed to support employees and their families.
Remote work travel program: Opportunities to combine remote work with travel.
Flexible and inclusive culture: Work in a diverse, international environment that encourages autonomy, open communication, new ideas, and professional growth.
Purpose-driven workplace: Contribute to technology designed to simplify cloud application development and operations while supporting responsible business practices.

Company Description
endurace.pro is a digital platform dedicated to connecting endurance athletes with their next challenge and supporting race organisers in bringing those events to life. The company focuses on simplifying event discovery, registration, and participation for athletes across a variety of endurance sports. For organisers, endurace.pro offers CRM tools and services that streamline planning, promotion, and end-to-end management of races. The team values innovation, reliability, and collaboration to create a seamless experience for all users. Joining endurace.pro means contributing to a product that directly supports the global endurance sports community.

Role Description
We are looking for a product-minded generalist who can understand user problems, translate them into product improvements, and help deliver a simple, effective experience for both athletes and race organizers.

As an early team member, you will work closely with the founding team to shape the product roadmap, research user needs, design workflows, and prioritize improvements based on business impact.

This is a hands-on role combining product thinking, UX research, wireframing, and execution.

Key Responsibilities 
Understand the needs of athletes, race organizers, and other platform users.
Conduct user interviews, competitor research, and product discovery.
Identify friction points in race discovery, event listing, onboarding, and registration.
Create user journeys, wireframes, prototypes, and product specifications.
Translate business goals into clear requirements and actionable tasks.
Maintain and prioritize the product backlog based on user value, urgency, and business impact.
Work with engineers to clarify requirements and validate delivered features.
Analyze user behavior, conversion funnels, and feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
Coordinate product testing and user acceptance testing before releases.
Establish a continuous feedback loop with users and stakeholders.

Required Skills
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Understanding of product development, user experience, and digital products.
Ability to create wireframes and prototypes using tools such as Figma.
Ability to write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation.
Comfort working with engineers and translating business requirements into product specifications.
A structured approach to prioritization, experimentation, and decision-making.

Good to Have
Experience working with a startup, marketplace, SaaS product, or consumer application.
Familiarity with analytics tools and product metrics.
Experience conducting usability testing or user research.
Interest in sports, fitness, endurance events, or community-driven platforms.

What We Expect From You
You focus on solving user problems rather than simply adding features.
You can make decisions with incomplete information and validate assumptions quickly.
You take ownership of product outcomes from discovery to release.
You balance user needs, technical constraints, and business priorities.
You are comfortable working in a lean team without extensive processes.

Who Should Apply: Product generalists who enjoy turning ambiguous problems into clear, useful product experiences.

About Us

HEAD OF PRODUCT BUSINESS UNIT

Anchanto | Pune, India | Reports to the Chief Executive Officer | Unit of 12 to 45 people

About Anchanto

Anchanto is an e-commerce and supply chain technology company headquartered in Singapore, with offices in twelve countries across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Europe and its largest engineering center in Pune. Brands, retailers and logistics service providers use our purpose built SaaS products to run and scale their e-commerce and omnichannel operations: Order Management, Warehouse Management, Anchanto Grid with more than 200 ready integrations to marketplaces, carriers and enterprise systems, Parcel Tracking, Control Tower and Operations Experience, with Vantage AI as the data and insights layer across all of them. Our AI enabled agentic services, launching soon, help customers run their commerce operations with less manual work and faster decisions. More than 360 enterprise customers, including L'OrÃ©al, Panasonic, EstÃ©e Lauder, DKSH, Toll and Bosch, process over 200 million orders a year through Anchanto across more than 700 warehouses. Anchanto is an Asendia portfolio company.

THE ROLE

A Product Business Unit (PBU) is Product Management and Engineering for one product, brought together as a single threaded organization with one head, one backlog and one set of priorities. The head owns the product's market position, strategy, roadmap, engineering, quality, reliability and business results, and leads the engineers who build it. This is how the leading software companies are organized today: Amazon's single threaded leaders and two pizza teams, the autonomous product units at Spotify and Atlassian, the product clouds at Salesforce and Adobe each run as a business. It removes the handoffs, competing priorities and diffused accountability of separate product and engineering functions, and puts one leader in charge who decides and answers for the result.

This is not a pure product management role. You lead the engineering team as well as the product team, you own the technical quality of what ships, and you are measured on outcomes, not activities. It is the role of building a product business that leads its category: you set where the product goes, build it with your own engineering team, put it in front of the market with the revenue teams, and answer for what it earns and how customers experience it.

WHAT YOU OWN: PRODUCT STRATEGY, ROADMAP, ENGINEERING, DECISIONS AND RESULTS

Product strategy. You know your market and competitors better than anyone in the company, set the product strategy and the positioning ambition with the industry research leaders, keep the product's gaps against the Gartner, Forrester and IDC criteria on your roadmap with dates, and give the CROs your input on pricing and packaging. 
Roadmap and priorities. One backlog covering the roadmap, customer commitments, innovation and tech debt, with the trade offs made by you within the portfolio allocation the CEO sets. Customer priorities and asks come to you from the Delivery team, your internal customer; you deliver against them and do not overwrite them. 
Decisions. What gets built, in what order and how; technical design within the architecture and security standards the CTO sets; release decisions; and whether your product can meet a scope and a date. No scope or date is committed on your product without your confirmation, and once committed you deliver it. 
The way we build. Specs based, AI assisted engineering is the standard way of working in every unit. You own the spec standard for your product and the readiness gate that stops work starting before decisions, credentials and test windows are in place. Quality is owned by the people who build. 
Results. Product P&L, growth, margin and contribution; reliability, incident response and customer satisfaction for your product; and the people: unit structure, hiring, promotions and a standing innovation and AI sub pod that explores adjacent capabilities. 
Ecosystem. Alignment with the other PBUs on the shared roadmap, the blueprint and joint commitments, and working in step with Product Marketing. 

COMMERCIAL INVOLVEMENT

This is not a sales role and carries no quota. The CROs set market priorities, the go to market and what and how your product is sold; the revenue teams (existing customers, Global Strategic Accounts, Key Account Management) own the customer connect. You help them sell: you step into strategic, complex or at risk deals when asked, and you are the final word on what your product can commit to and when. You do not override or bypass them to reach customers directly.

How You Manage Your People

Every person in the unit has written objectives and two or three KPIs for the quarter, reviewed monthly; nobody is without them thirty days after joining. 
Feedback is direct, factual and given within the week, in writing when it matters. 
You represent the company to your team, not the team to the company. Management debt, wrong decisions, undelivered feedback and unaddressed interpersonal issues, is fixed within thirty days of knowing about it. 
Performance is measured against objectives, not effort or tenure. An underperformer gets a written plan and a date; if it passes you take the decision yourself, including exit. Interns are confirmed and people are promoted only after a documented assessment and a direct conversation. 
The unit reports in numbers, weekly in writing and monthly in the outcome review. 
You talk to your N-1, your N-2 and every individual contributor, with skip level one to ones at least quarterly; you do the final interview of every person joining the unit; and the unit runs on a written meeting cadence you publish in your first thirty days and keep. 

OWNING CUSTOMER ESCALATIONS

An escalation on your product is yours from the moment it is raised until the customer confirms it is closed. You do not trivialize it, and you do not expect the CEO or the CROs to lead it. You own the fix and the communication: first written update within the hour, a fixed written cadence until closed, root cause and corrective action within five working days after. You put proactive monitoring in place so the unit knows before the customer does.

Who Decides What

Decision: Roadmap, prioritization, trade offs, what gets built and how, technical design within architecture guardrails, release decisions within standards.

Decides: You 

Decision: Whether your product can meet a scope and a date; unit structure, hiring and promotions within policy; spend within the approved budget.

Decides: You 

Decision: Customer priority, customer asks, revenue delivery and the external customer commitment and timeline.

Decides: Delivery, with your confirmation on scope and date 

Decision: Pricing and packaging; market priorities; go to market; what and how your product is sold; customer connect.

Decides: CROs and revenue teams, with your input on pricing 

Decision: Portfolio allocation, the blueprint, headcount and total investment, cross PBU priority collisions.

Decides: CEO 

Decision: Technology standards, security and compliance, architecture guardrails, CICD, infrastructure, data and AI platform.

Decides: CTO 

How You Are Measured

You own outcomes, not activities. Story points, releases and features shipped are not on this scorecard. You are judged on the outputs below, and you run the unit on five to eight controllable input metrics that you propose, prove move the outputs, and review every week. Numbers are baselined in your first month and verified by Finance.

Product led revenue enablement

What we look at: Adoption and usage depth of the modules we sell, share of customers on the current version, deals unblocked or lost on product capability, referenceable customers, time to go live 

Retention and unit margin

What we look at: Net revenue retention for your product, churn and its reasons, and the unit's contribution margin after people, infrastructure and del

Dreaming big is in our DNA. It’s who we are as a company. It’s our culture. It’s our heritage. And more than ever, it’s our future. A future where we’re always looking forward. Always serving up new ways to meet life’s moments. A future where we keep dreaming bigger. We look for people with passion, talent, and curiosity, and provide them with the teammates, resources and opportunities to unleash their full potential. The power we create together – when we combine your strengths with ours – is unstoppable. Are you ready to join a team that dreams as big as you do?

Zuddl is the unified event platform that B2B marketing teams at companies like CrowdStrike, Figma, Stripe, TikTok, Checkpoint, and Iterable use to run their most important conferences, field events, and webinars, all from one system. Were backed by Y Combinator, Alpha Wave, and Qualcomm Ventures, and were going after every legacy player in a market thats being rebuilt from scratch.
About the Role
Were looking for a Senior Product Manager who has owned a product end to end before, ideally as a founder, and who works largely on their own.
Youll own a major domain of the Zuddl platform that spans several modules. Examples are the full event workflow from registration through production and check-in, or the data and integration layer that connects events to a customers CRM and marketing stack. You own the roadmap, the technical direction with engineering, and the outcomes for that domain. Leadership will challenge your thinking and add context when you ask for it, but wont set direction for you. You are expected to frame ambiguous problems, make hard tradeoffs, and drive complex cross-functional work without much intervention.
You should also be truly AI-native. At Zuddl, product work runs on AI: research, specs, data analysis, and prototypes that go from problem to something clickable in days. This is how you already work, and you think about where AI creates leverage in the product itself.
What Youll Own Working with people
  • Be the primary driver for complex, high-impact initiatives that cut across modules
  • Lead cross-functional work across engineering, design, PMM, CS, Support, and Sales. Resolve disagreements and keep everyone aligned through ambiguity
  • Make difficult decisions under ambiguity, with strong independent product judgment
Building the roadmap
  • Form your own view of where Zuddl wins, loses, and should differentiate. Spot market changes that should change direction
  • Look past individual requests to find the systemic problems underneath, and decide which gaps deserve real investment
  • Understand not just what competitors built, but why, and where theyre heading. Decide where we match, differentiate, or ignore
  • Prioritize major investments on your own and make the hard tradeoffs
  • Own your OKRs and the roadmap behind them, including how modules fit together as one platform
Building the feature
  • Bring strong customer intuition from repeated exposure to users and workflows. Form a sharp initial view, then use research to validate or challenge it
  • Frame complex, ambiguous problems well. Challenge the premise and reframe before the team commits to a solution
  • Write PRDs with clear justification for every call
  • Have strong judgment on where to match the market, where to differentiate, and where not to invest
  • Find the abstractions and platform investments that unlock multiple future features, without over-generalizing
  • Break complex initiatives into stages that reduce product, customer, and technical risk
  • Say no to low-leverage work, even under customer or internal pressure
  • Hold a very high bar for end-to-end workflows. Catch the subtle friction and inconsistency others miss
  • See second- and third-order consequences before they become customer or engineering problems
Shipping the feature
  • Own the release plan for complex or high-risk launches: feature flags, rollout cohorts, backwards compatibility, and first-time user experience
  • Anticipate what Sales, CS, Support, and Implementation will need, and drive enablement
  • Shape positioning for complex or strategic launches, grounded in customer, market, and competitive understanding
  • Work out why a launch is or isnt working, and decide the right response: product, UX, GTM, or enablement
  • Assess partnership and integration opportunities with external third parties
What Were Looking For
  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product end to end, from roadmap to execution
  • Founder or founder-like experience strongly preferred: youve built and owned a product with that level of ownership and speed
  • B2B SaaS experience is a must
  • Startup experience is required. Youre comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and fast iteration
  • Experience at a marketing- or design-led company is a strong plus. So is event tech or martech
  • Truly AI-native: AI is your default for research, specs, data analysis, and prototyping, and you can show us how
  • You love technology and can hold detailed conversations with your engineering team. An engineering background is a bonus
  • You go deep on data and turn it into decisions
  • Excellent communicator and stakeholder manager. You tell the story well, listen to other views, and still drive the decision thats best for the customer and the business
  • Equally comfortable on the long-term vision, next weeks release, and what went wrong with last months launch
How You Operate
  • High agency: you turn business goals into execution plans without detailed direction
  • First-principles thinker, willing to challenge "how weve always done it"
  • Bias to action: you ship and iterate instead of waiting for perfect information
  • You surface risks early
  • Accountable: you own the wins and the misses
What Success Looks Like
  • Your domain has a clear roadmap the company trusts and a track record of shipping against it
  • Launches land well with customers, and Sales, CS, and Support are ready for them
  • Your decisions hold up, and the team needs little leadership intervention to move
Why You Want To Work Here
  • Competitive compensation
  • ESOPs
  • Remote working, with an option to rent coworking spaces
  • Flexible leave program
  • Home workstation setup allowance
  • A culture built on trust, transparency, and integrity
  • Ground floor opportunity at a fast-growing Series A startup

This includes defining what gets built and the first versions scope and acceptance criteria. The role also owns prioritization, business cases and measured value, so solutions move from pilot to production and are used every day.

General Responsibilities

- Develop product strategy and optimize product portfolio, providing planning and project prioritization
- Contributes to the pricing strategy through the product life cycle.
- Drives the development and execution of the product roadmap to improvement
- Provide support for operational issues associated with quality, delivery and production.
- Anticipating and communicating issues, recommending corrective action, and taking independent remedial actions and reporting outcomes

 What will you bring:

We Are:

At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.

You Are:

You are a leader who builds trust with product teams, engineers, and the analysts you manage. You listen first, write in clear language, and take ownership of results. You work well with people in different disciplines and locations, and you help others do their best work without needing to be the loudest person in the room.

You are practical when information is incomplete. You explain complex topics in simple terms, stay calm when the design changes, and challenge unclear choices in a respectful way. You care about teamwork, growing people, and leaving work that others can use.

This is a full-time role.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Lead a team of cybersecurity analysts who support semiconductor IP products: set priorities, assign analysts to product teams, and balance workload across the portfolio.
Set the direction for threat analysis of semiconductor IP and associated firmware, including assets, access points, threat scenarios, attack paths, and controls in the IP versus requirements for the integrator.
Guide the team in running security analysis as part of the cybersecurity lifecycle, from planning through design, implementation, verification, and release.
Review the team’s analysis, requirements, and integration guidance for quality, consistency, and clear assumptions before they reach product teams and customers.
Advise product leaders and architects on cybersecurity requirements, architecture, and verification so security work is built into the existing development flow.
Oversee customer-facing security integration guidance that describes the threat landscape, implemented controls, and how customers should integrate the IP.
Guide the team’s support for in-field cybersecurity activities, including vulnerability assessment, incident analysis, and security advisories, working with cybersecurity architects and corporate vulnerability response.
Coach and develop analysts: set clear goals, give regular feedback, and plan career growth.
Facilitate working sessions with cybersecurity architects and design and verification leads; keep analysis consistent across similar IP classes.
Plan the team’s work with product teams in agile sprints: align security work with the product backlog, adjust scope when the design changes, and keep evidence current at each milestone.
Promote the use of Python and agentic workflows (AI agents, structured prompts, and human-in-the-loop review) so the team works faster while analysts keep ownership of their findings.
Run team work in Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab: track work and capacity, keep documentation current, and report status to leadership.

The Impact You Will Have:

Give product teams threat analysis they can trust and act on without re-deriving the work.
Build a team of analysts who grow in skill, own their conclusions, and deliver steady quality.
Improve consistency of analysis, risk language, and guidance across similar IP classes.
Leave cybersecurity requirements and verification objectives that design and verification teams can execute.
Strengthen the cybersecurity lifecycle for IP products so security work stays current as the design changes.
Help customers integrate Synopsys IP with guidance they can follow without a security specialist in the room.
Help the organization respond to in-field issues with clear assessment and practical advisories.
Raise team throughput with Python and agentic workflows without lowering the quality of technical conclusions.

What You’ll Need:

Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome, not required.
Ten or more years in product cybersecurity, embedded security, digital design, digital verification, or a closely related engineering role, including four or more years leading people or technical teams. Stronger evidence on the required capabilities can offset fewer years.
Experience managing or leading analysts or engineers: setting priorities, giving feedback, coaching, hiring, and growing people.
Practical experience performing or reviewing threat modeling, threat analysis, and risk assessment on real products, not only training exercises.
Ability to judge whether threat-analysis work identifies assets, attackers, attack surfaces, and attack paths, and maps each path to a mitigation (in-product control or integration requirement).
Comfort working without a single known end-system: analysis must cover representative integration scenarios and state assumptions clearly.
Experience ing a cybersecurity lifecycle across planning, requirements, design, implementation, verification, and release.
Ability to turn threat-analysis results into requirements, design guidance, verification objectives, and release evidence.
Hands-on understanding of embedded systems: SoC or MCU integration, firmware, hardware/software interfaces, memory-mapped registers, boot and debug, and on-chip interconnects.
Background as a digital designer or a digital verification engineer, with the ability to read and discuss RTL (Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL), architecture, interfaces, and register maps with designers and verification leads.
Ability to judge whether a claimed cybersecurity control is implemented in the design and whether it is verifiable.
Experience delivering work inside agile product teams, including re-scoping when product content changes.
Working ability to read and review Python used for analysis and automation, and to guide analysts on readable, reusable scripts.
Practical experience using AI agents and agentic workflows to speed research, drafting, and repetitive analysis, while keeping the human as owner of technical conclusions.
Hands-on use of Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab (or an equivalent Git forge) for tickets, documentation, and review.
Clear written and spoken English; able to lead technical sessions and communicate with leaders across geographically distributed teams.
Familiarity with digital design and verification languages and methods, such as SystemVerilog, UVM (Universal Verification Methodology), and SystemC, and how verification teams use them to test security controls.
Working knowledge of ISO/SAE 21434 or a comparable product-cybersecurity standard is helpful, as is analog or mixed-signal background, semiconductor IP product experience, vulnerability handling, or applied embedded cryptography.

Who You Are:

You build trust with product teams, design teams, and your own analysts, and you keep working relationships strong when the discussion is difficult.
You grow people. You give honest feedback,

Responsibilities

Job Title: Senior Product Manager – Enterprise DevOps Platforms

GCL: E

Introduction to role:

Are you ready to build and scale a comprehensive DevOps infrastructure that 20,000–30,000 users depend on to move life-changing science to patients faster! This is your opportunity to set the strategy for tools and services that power developer productivity, accelerate delivery, and raise the quality of decision-making across the company. You will feel the sponsorship behind the mission and see the impact of your choices recognized at the highest levels.

You will lead with both vision and execution—bridging business priorities, user experience, engineering capability, oversight, and organizational standards to build a cohesive platform backbone. Working with guides in software development, cybersecurity, system build, and data, you will align Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Copilot and adjacent services into a secure, scalable, AI-enabled ecosystem. Do you thrive on connecting strategic direction with pragmatic delivery to unlock productivity at scale?

Portfolio Product Strategy and Vision: Define and drive the product strategy, vision, and roadmap across the enterprise DevOps platform portfolio, aligning business priorities, engineering needs, platform evolution, and enterprise architecture standards to deliver measurable outcomes.
Team Leadership and Development: Lead and develop Product Owners across multiple products; set direction, clarify accountabilities, set objectives, coach, handle performance, and build a high-performing, outcome-focused culture.

The successful candidate will demonstrate significant experience in a product management leadership role such as Senior Product Manager, Lead Product Manager, Product Lead, or a similar position within a technical, platform, or enterprise tooling environment.

They should be comfortable operating independently, crafting direction, and combining critical thinking with pragmatic execution.

This position demands demonstrated capability to drive adoption across large user populations, ideally in environments with 10,000+ users. It also requires improving effective usage through product thinking, change enablement, and engaging collaborators.
Strong communication, leadership, and influencing skills are critical. If you are able to independently persuade internal and external collaborators, often where priorities conflict, and build alignment around roadmap direction, investment decisions, and product out

Who We Are

Finance leaders choose Billtrust to get paid faster, control costs, and maximize customer satisfaction. As the leader in B2B accounts receivable workflow and payment software, we provide the world's leading brands with AI-powered solutions across the full AR lifecycle—from invoice presentment and payment processing to cash application and collections. With over 2,600 global customers, more than $1 trillion in invoice dollars processed, and a proprietary network of 13 million buyers, Billtrust delivers business value through deep industry expertise and a culture relentlessly focused on meaningful customer outcomes.

We're an AI-first company, not just in what we build for our customers, but in how we work. Across every function, our teams use AI tools daily to work faster, make better decisions, and deliver higher-quality outcomes. We hire exceptional people, give them cutting-edge AI capabilities, and measure success by the impact they create. If you want to do the best work of your career at the frontier of AI and fintech, Billtrust is the place to do it.

Our Values

Customers

We relentlessly increase value for customer and do the right thing for them.

Action

We make 'thoughtfully fast' decisions, act quickly, cut through red tape, deliver progress not perfection, take ownership and accountability.

Team Spirit

We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together.

Innovation

We challenge the status quo, experiment thoughtfully, and are novel and brilliant in what we create.

Excellence

We love to win, but we hate losing even more. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger.

About the Role:

The VP, Applied Intelligence is a Senior leadership role accountable for setting the AI vision that defines Billtrust's next chapter. You will harness AI tools, co-worker agents, and frontier intelligence capabilities to architect a product strategy that reshapes how 2,600+ global customers experience the future of B2B finance — bringing the irreplaceable human judgment required to turn transformative technology into durable competitive advantage.

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer and operating as a key member of the Product leadership team, you will own Billtrust's Applied Intelligence agenda end-to-end: setting the multi-year roadmap, building and inspiring a world-class organization, and serving as the company's most senior external voice on AI-powered B2B finance. This role demands more than AI expertise alone. It requires a genuine understanding of how

money moves through complex B2B relationships, and what it takes to replace manual, error-prone financial workflows with intelligent automation that customers trust with their cash. This is an executive mandate to define what an AI-first AR platform looks like, and to make it real at scale.

What You'll Do:

AI Strategy & Executive Leadership

• Set Billtrust's Applied Intelligence vision and multi-year product roadmap, establishing the strategic framework that guides how AI shapes every layer of the AR lifecycle.

• Serve as a member of the Product leadership team, shaping company-wide product strategy and influencing investment priorities at the executive level.

• Define the operating model for how Applied Intelligence is built, deployed, and continuously improved — including governance, evaluation standards, and responsible AI principles.

• Other duties as assigned.

Product Development & AI Innovation

• Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Billtrust's AI-powered capabilities — from opportunity identification and experimentation through scaled delivery and ongoing iteration — leveraging co-worker agents and AI tooling to compress timelines and raise quality.

• Establish rigorous frameworks for evaluating AI product performance, accuracy, reliability, and customer safety before and after deployment.

• Drive a culture of bold experimentation: define hypotheses, design tests, interpret results, and champion the learnings that most accelerate product-market fit.

• Partner with Engineering, Data Science, and Design to translate frontier AI capabilities into intuitive, production-grade customer experiences.

Organization Building & Talent

• Recruit, develop, and retain a high-caliber team of product managers and applied AI practitioners, building one of the most sought-after AI product organizations in B2B fintech.

• Champion AI-first ways of working across the entire Product organization, setting the standard for how leaders and ICs leverage AI tools to amplify impact.

• Create clear career pathways and a coaching culture that elevates team members into future leaders of AI product development.

Market Presence & Commercial Impact

• Serve as Billtrust's most senior external voice on Applied Intelligence — representing the company at industry events, in analyst conversations, and in strategic customer and partner engagements.

• Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure AI differentiation is clearly communicated and consistently converted into pipeline and retention.

• Engage directly with key customers to co-create AI solutions, gather strategic insight, and validate roadmap direction against real-world complexity.

What You'll Bring:

Required Skills:

• 12+ years of experience in product management, applied AI, or a related field, with significant tenure in executive or senior VP-level product leadership.

• Demonstrated experience setting AI strategy and driving AI-first transformation at scale across a product organization or business unit.

• Deep understanding of machine learning, large language models, agentic AI frameworks, and how these capabilities translate into production-grade B2B product experiences.

• Proven track record of building and scaling high-performing applied AI product teams in a fast-moving enterprise SaaS or fintech environment.

• Fluency in FinTech data: how financial data is structured, how it flows across ERP systems, payment networks, and AR workflows, and why data quality and latency matter differently in financial contexts than in general SaaS.

• Executive presence and communication skills that inspire confidence across the C-suite, board, customers, partners, and external audiences.

• Strong commercial acumen — able to connect AI product investment directly to revenue growth, retention, and competitive differentiation.

Preferred Skills:

• Direct experience in Order to Cash, accounts receivable, cash application, collections, or B2B payments — either building products in this space or operating within it at enterprise scale.

• Familiarity with the data structures and integration patterns common in AR automation: ERP connectors, remittance data, invoice line-item detail, payment status feeds, and buyer identity resolution.

• Hands-on familiarity with agentic AI architectures, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or multi-model orchestration in enterprise production environments.

• Track record of representing product vision externally — at conferences, in analyst briefings, or in strategic customer advisory settings.

• Experience co-creating AI solutions with enterprise customers and translating those partnerships into roadmap impact and revenue.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile & Digital Marketing | Enterprise AI | Customer Care AI & Technology | Enterprise Technology Modernization

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location & Flexibility
India Hybrid: Bengaluru

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from our office in Bengaluru(2 to 3 times/ week). Our office culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members, local and visiting, from other global offices.

The Opportunity

Robotics foundation models need millions of hours of dense, real-world data—and simulation alone won't cut it. TELUS Digital is solving the Physical AI bottleneck, capturing highly calibrated, real-world data at scale across hundreds of devices to power the world's leading hyperscalers.

We are hiring a Group Product Manager for the Physical AI Robotics product team. You will own the tooling this runs on: capture applications, operator workflows, session management, review and QA, and customer delivery. You will work with the researchers consuming the data and the operators producing it, and the standards you set will carry into how the industry does this.

Your application will stand out if you are demonstrably curious and have side work projects to showcase.

Responsibilities:

8-12 years in product management, including at least 2 in robotics, physical AI, AR/VR, autonomous systems, or data collection at scale.

Own the roadmap for robotics data collection, setting direction and driving execution across engineering, design, operations, quality, and solutions.

Assess demand for new capture modalities, then define the collection model, hardware, and tooling.

Work with engineering and design on the operator experience: onboarding, task guidance, in-session feedback, error states, review workflows. Operators work one-handed, in motion, wearing a headset, or against a clock.

Build prototypes and write the specs. Requirements and user stories that hold up under engineering review.

Translate customer model requirements into collection designs, and evolving research into quality standards for egocentric data: pose accuracy, sync tolerance, occlusion handling, annotation schema, acceptance criteria.

Spend time with collectors, session leads, and reviewers. When data underperforms in training, trace it back to the capture design or the tooling that produced it.

Represent the product directly to hyperscaler and robotics foundation model teams, and bring their constraints back into the roadmap.

Optimize for yield per session, rejection rate, cost per usable hour, capture-to-delivery time, and operator retention.

Champion pilots as the default way to test a change. Small cohort, clear hypothesis, fixed window. Scale what works and stop what does not.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems) or equivalent experience..

Technical depth to hold a real conversation with a research team.

Direct experience with one or more of: egocentric or wearable data capture, teleoperation systems, robot data pipelines, multi-sensor collection rigs or similar setups

Experience defining product vision and roadmaps in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

Hands-on robotics background. Robotics, ML engineer on embodied models, teleoperation engineer, or similar.

Familiarity with imitation learning, VLA models, or manipulation policy training, and the data those methods need.

Experience managing distributed human operations, including crowd or contractor workforces.

You have shipped something physical and understand calibration, sensor sync, and coordinate frames, and how they fail.

Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What You’ll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you'll be responsible for

You will own product areas within Managed Payments, Circle’s regulated payments infrastructure that enables PSPs, financial institutions, banks, and enterprises to use stablecoin-powered payment rails without operating crypto infrastructure themselves. You will define and evolve product capabilities that support managed pay-ins, payouts, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management across stablecoin and fiat endpoints. Working closely with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will translate complex customer and business needs into clear product priorities, lead cross-functional execution, and deliver measurable improvements to how customers move money across geographies and payment rails.

What you'll work on

Own the roadmap for product areas across managed pay-ins, payouts, fiat endpoints, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management, aligning priorities with customer needs and Circle’s goals.
Define and launch capabilities that expand Managed Payments across Circle’s regulated hubs, including new entities, corridors, payout methods, and geographic coverage.
Shape simple, reliable customer experiences for accepting funds, converting value, and disbursing globally across stablecoin and fiat rails, including integrations with CPN and other Circle systems.
Improve customer and operator workflows across onboarding, account setup, transaction visibility, reporting, exception handling, reconciliation, refunds, RFIs, and bulk payments.
Use customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify friction, prioritize investments, and measure improvements in reliability, efficiency, adoption, and customer experience.
Evaluate opportunities to support new payment rails, payout use cases, and digital assets based on customer demand, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and business priorities.
Lead complex cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, BD, and Product, navigating technical and business trade-offs and driving alignment from definition through launch.

What you'll bring to Circle

Core requirements

4+ years of relevant experience, including product management experience building payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, or similarly complex B2B products.
Experience owning product vision, roadmaps, and execution for B2B capabilities such as payments, pay-ins, payouts, settlement, treasury infrastructure, APIs, or financial operations.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex cross-functional initiatives spanning Engineering and partners such as Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, or commercial teams.
Strong analytical and technical fluency, with experience using customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.
Track record of delivering measurable improvements to customer experience, product adoption, operational efficiency, reliability, or business performance.
Ability to evaluate technical and business trade-offs, resolve ambiguity, and translate complex requirements into clear product priorities and execution plans.

Preferred Requirements

Knowledge of cross-border payments, PSP infrastructure, settlement systems, correspondent banking, or other payment network concepts.
Familiarity with stablecoins, blockchain-based financial infrastructure, or crypto-enabled payment systems.
Experience with enterprise APIs, payment networks, or compliance-forward systems involving payment lifecycle states, reconciliation, exception handling, sanctions screening, RFIs, or SLAs.

Why this role matters

Managed Payments is a core part of Circle’s strategy to make stablecoin-powered payments accessible to businesses beyond crypto-native customers. Customers increasingly need complete payment programs that allow them to accept funds, manage balances, convert across assets, and disburse globally without assembling wallets, banking partners, liquidity providers, compliance systems, and payout networks themselves. As Senior Product Manager, you will help turn that complexity into an integrated customer experience and scale Managed Payments into a reliable, global, enterprise-grade product.

We are WisdomAI.

We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.

WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.

About WisdomAI

Join our rapidly growing team and be a part of a company that is shaping the future of enterprise data. We are a fast-paced, early-stage startup, currently ~30 people and growing.

The Role: A Builder, An Empath, and An Executor

This is not a traditional Product Manager position; it is a dynamic, hands-on function built for the age of AI-native product development. We are a build-first company that values execution and rapid iteration over lengthy documentation.

At WisdomAI, the Product Manager acts as a catalyst for collective intelligence, empowering engineers and designers to propose and build, keenly capture customer feedback, and continuously strive for improvement. This role requires a minimum of 4+ years of relevant experience and a deep balance of technical understanding and customer empathy.

Core Responsibilities

The PM role serves as the glue that connects the customer's needs, the market's demands, and our team's creative and technical capabilities.

Customer Empathy and Data Mastery
Cultivate deep customer empathy by spending time with prospects and users, observing workflows, and understanding their business context. 
Translate customer pain points into clear and actionable problem statements for the development team. 
Leverage your technical and data understanding to evaluate product performance, interpret complex analytics, and inform strategic decisions. 
Proactively track qualitative and quantitative feedback by monitoring support channels, listening to sales calls, and checking in with customer-facing teams. 
Technical Depth and Execution Orientation
Guide the team in choosing the right development approach for the task at hand (PM-first, Design-first, or Dev-first), relying on your technical understanding of our platform. 
Define the problem and its constraints, allowing engineers to write robust solution proposals. 
Maintain a relentless execution oriented focus, seeing yourself as an extension of the development team, unblocking them and consistently following through on commitments to drive features to launch. 
Work effectively in our fast-paced environment, balancing immediate user needs with long-term strategic goals. 
Strategic Communication
Facilitate discussions, lead brainstorms, and articulate a compelling product vision to align the entire organization. 
Act as a product evangelist, collaborating with sales, marketing, and customer success to clearly articulate the product’s value. 
Proactively close the feedback loop, ensuring insights from users and the market are constantly flowing back into the development process. 

What You'll Bring: Qualifications

4+ years of experience in Product Management, specifically within B2B SaaS, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related AI-native platforms. 
Proven track record of successful product delivery and strategic execution in a fast-paced environment. 
Demonstrated technical and data understanding—you must be comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, model performance, and architectural trade-offs with customers and engineers. 
Deeply rooted customer empathy and proficiency in interpreting user analytics and business metrics to guide product strategy. 
Strong collaborative and stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

Our CRAFT

CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.

C — Customer trust. Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.

R — Relentless on outcomes. We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.

A — Authenticity. We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.

F — First principles, grounded in reality. We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.

T — Transparency. We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.

Equal opportunity employer

WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

The Pitch

As Product Owner for Workday HELP, you’ll own how our employees get answers and resolve HR issues: the cases, the knowledge, and the agents that make both smarter. You’ll implement, break things in sandbox, decide what ships, and turn Workday’s newest AI features into something employees actually use. This is a hands-on IC role. You will configure, test, and launch, not manage a backlog from a distance. And the exciting part: you will continue your consulting journey as we roll the implementation to our portfolio companies across the globe. Also, Workday is shipping AI faster than most teams can evaluate it. We want someone who gets excited about that, not overwhelmed by it.

What You’ll Do

Own and implement Workday HELP

Lead end-to-end implementation of Case Management: case categories, case types, routing, SLAs, escalation paths, security, and integrations
Build and run Knowledge Management: article structure, authoring and approval workflows, audience targeting, and content lifecycle
Own the HELP product roadmap, backlog, and release readiness, including triaging each Workday bi-annual release for what matters to us

Experiment With What’s Next

Evaluate and pilot new Workday AI capabilities as they arrive, including Illuminate and self-service agents
Run structured experiments: define the hypothesis, configure in sandbox, test with real scenarios, and measure results
Make clear, evidence-backed recommendations on what to adopt, defer, or skip
Help shape our agent-led self-service approach, from deflection to guided resolution

Make it measurable

Define the metrics for HR service delivery: case volume, resolution time, deflection, knowledge usage, and employee satisfaction
Build case analytics and dashboards that show leaders what is working and where to act next

Work across the Workday ecosystem

Partner with Core HCM, Talent, Recruiting, and Payroll teams so HELP works smoothly with the rest of the platform
Work with People Operations, HR Centers of Excellence, and IT on process design, content ownership, and change management
Coordinate with Workday and implementation partners on features, defects, and early-adopter programs

What You Bring

Must-haves

Hands-on Workday HELP implementation experience. This is non-negotiable. You have taken Case Management and/or Knowledge Management from design to go-live
Strong Core HCM background. You understand worker data, business processes, security, organizations, and how HELP depends on all of it
Experience as a product owner, functional lead, or senior consultant who owns configuration, not just requirements
Ability to translate HR service needs into clear user stories, configuration designs, and test plans
Strong stakeholder communication across HR, IT, and business teams

Strong plus

Experience implementing or piloting Workday self-service agents or Illuminate AI features
Case management analytics experience (Workday reporting, people analytics, or dashboards on case data)

What Makes You a Top Candidate

Experience in Peakon, Learning, or Journeys. We want someone who sees how HELP connects to the wider employee experience, such as a Journey that triggers a case or Peakon feedback that reshapes knowledge content
Workday certifications in HCM or related modules
Prior experience in a shared services or global HR environment

You’ll Thrive Here If You

Treat every new Workday release like a gift basket and open it immediately
Are comfortable saying “that didn’t work, here’s why, here’s what we do instead”
Prefer building and testing over writing 40-page decks
Care about the employee on the other end of the case, not just the configuration
Can make a judgment call with 80% of the information

Why This Role

To bring HELP to life, hands on. 
Early access to evaluating Workday’s AI roadmap, with real influence on what we adopt
A role built around experimentation, not maintenance
Visible impact: every employee touches HELP
Opportunity to grow into broader People Technology and AI-in-HR leadership as our platform scope expands

The Role
As Director, Product – Operations, you will own product outcomes across the post-booking execution engine — from order management and project coordination through permit flows, EMI and financing execution, installation, commissioning, and supply chain operations.
This is a senior, hands-on leadership role in a highly execution-driven environment, where product decisions directly affect throughput, cost efficiency, on-ground reliability, and predictability of delivery at scale.
You will operate across multiple PODs and large business units, working closely with PMs, SPMs, engineering, design, and business leaders to frame complex problems, shape scalable solutions, and close cross-functional trade-offs.
While the role has significant scope and leverage, it also requires depth — stepping in to help teams think through workflows, system design, and PRDs when ambiguity, scale, or risk is high.
Scope of Responsibility
Own product outcomes across the post-booking operations backbone — order management, project coordination, permits, supply chain execution, financing journeys, and installation & commissioning.
Be accountable for the reliability, throughput, and cost efficiency of the delivery engine, with a mandate to shift real workflow execution into the system and eliminate offline coordination that constrains predictability and scale.
Own the product surface connecting operational systems to supply chain and ERP infrastructure, ensuring reliable and comprehensive information flows.
Identify and address structural bottlenecks and failure modes across complex, interdependent systems using operational data, ground signals, and business context.
Set clear product direction and priorities across multiple PM and SPM-owned areas, focusing on reliability, throughput, cost efficiency, and exception reduction.
Work hands-on with PMs and SPMs to frame complex, ambiguous problems, shape solution approaches, and raise the quality of PRDs and solution design.
Drive alignment and close trade-offs across operations, engineering, finance, and business stakeholders, especially where ownership is unclear or incentives conflict.
Balance short-term execution pressure with long-term system robustness, maintainability, scalability, and resilience.

10–14+ years of product management experience, with meaningful exposure to operations, supply chain, logistics, construction, or similarly complex execution-heavy domains.
Proven ability to exercise system-level judgment in workflow-heavy, execution-critical environments where product decisions have immediate business and operational consequences.
Experience owning or shaping large, interdependent systems with real throughput constraints, failure modes, and on-ground complexity.
Exposure to supply chain, procurement, or ERP-adjacent product contexts is a plus.
Experience managing multi-party workflows with external dependencies — permits, financing partners, third-party vendors, or regulatory bodies.
Comfort operating across multiple PODs and business units while maintaining depth where decisions are irreversible or high-risk.
Strong data fluency applied to operational outcomes — understanding bottlenecks, exceptions, unit economics, and second-order effects.
Hands-on leadership style — willing and able to engage deeply in problem framing, solution design, and PRDs when leverage is highest.
High credibility with senior operations and engineering leaders, built through judgment and follow-through rather than authority.
Demonstrated capability to lead, coach, and hold a high bar for PMs and cross-functional teams.
A collaborative, low-ego working style that reinforces trust, accountability, and a non-toxic execution culture at scale.

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate.
