Role Overview

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.
We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.
With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

Key Responsibilities
Product Vision and Strategy
Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.

Product Execution and Delivery
Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.

Using AI in How You Work
We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.
Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.

Team Leadership
Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.

Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.

Cross-Functional Alignment
Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.

What you will do

You will join the Data Platform & Products Team and serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the engineering team, acting as the product owner for Data Engineering deliverables and owning requirements, governance, and the quality of what we deliver.

In practice, that means you will translate business intent into clear priorities, acceptance criteria, and delivery expectations so the team can build governed data products that are both technically sound and genuinely useful.

Gather and translate business requirements

Engage with stakeholders across Marketing Analytics, Product, Regulatory, Support, and Business teams to gather, analyse, and document analytical and compliance requirements.
Translate business needs into precise data product requirements and functional specifications that Data Engineers and the Data Architect can act on.
Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, and review meetings to ensure alignment between business intent and technical delivery.

Define and govern data products and KPIs

Define and maintain business KPIs and metric definitions — specifying calculation logic, business context, and interpretation guidance — and ensure they are consistently applied across the organisation.
Support the creation and certification of data products and analytical datasets, ensuring they meet quality, lineage, and governance standards before being published for consumption.
Maintain business glossaries and data dictionaries that make data assets discoverable and understandable to non-technical users.
Promote standardisation of business metrics across teams, reducing conflicting definitions and improving trust in shared data.

Lead data governance and compliance activities

Support the implementation of data governance policies, standards, and practices across the data platform.
Maintain metadata, data lineage, and business classifications — working with tooling such as Microsoft Purview to ensure the data catalogue is accurate and up to date.
Assist with regulatory reporting requirements and compliance obligations, and support audit readiness activities.
Champion data stewardship across the organisation — helping data owners understand and fulfil their responsibilities.

Validate data quality and support adoption

Participate in data validation and acceptance testing for new and updated data products, ensuring delivered assets meet the requirements defined.
Support investigation of data quality issues reported by consumers, working with Data Engineers to diagnose and resolve them.
Drive adoption of certified data products and datasets across business teams — helping users understand what is available, how to use it, and why it is trustworthy.

Collaborate across functions

Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the technical Data Platform team — keeping both sides aligned on priorities, requirements, and delivery progress.
Work closely with the Data Architect on data modelling decisions to ensure physical models reflect business semantics correctly.
Support the Lead Data Analyst and Analyst team by ensuring the data products they consume are well-documented, governed, and fit for purpose.

What you bring

Experience

5+ years of experience in Systems Analysis, Product Owner, Business Analysis, Data Analysis, or Data Governance.
BE/B.Tech degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Experience working with analytics, reporting, or data platforms in a cross-functional environment.
Experience engaging with multiple business stakeholders — facilitating requirements sessions, managing expectations, and translating ambiguity into clear specifications.
Exposure to data governance programmes, metadata management, or compliance reporting environments.

Technical skills

SQL for data validation, exploration, and requirements verification
Data contracts (YAML-based) — authoring and maintaining data-contract.yml including schema definitions, KPI descriptions, column metadata, and governance attributes that feed Unity Catalog and downstream consumers
Unity Catalog — managing table and column descriptions, understanding catalog/schema/table hierarchy, and working with certified data product objects
Microsoft Purview — data cataloguing, metadata management, lineage tracking, and business classification
Power BI concepts — understanding how Gold layer data products are consumed in BI tools
Azure Monitor and Log Analytics (awareness) — understanding observability outputs for data quality and pipeline health discussions
Databricks notebooks (basic awareness) — ability to navigate and validate notebook outputs during data product acceptance testing
Data Warehousing concepts and dimensional modelling basics
Familiarity with data quality frameworks and lineage concepts

Personal competencies

You are a natural connector — you build trust with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and keep them aligned.
You are precise with definitions — you know that a poorly defined metric causes more damage than a missing one, and you push for clarity.
You are thorough in documentation — you treat well-written specs, glossaries, and governance records as deliverables, not afterthoughts.
You advocate for the data consumer — you think about how data products will be used and ensure they are discoverable, trustworthy, and well-explained.
You manage ambiguity well — you can take a loosely defined business question and turn it into a structured, actionable requirement.

Who we are

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.

Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for a Product Owner - Change Governance to join us in developing ways for IKEA to stay relevant for our customers and co-workers. In this role, you will help ensure that new digital products, services and improvements are successfully adopted, embedded into everyday ways of working and translated into measurable business value across the Digital Area. 

Our diverse team is growing, and we would love to talk with you if you recognize yourself in some of the following: 
You are passionate about helping people and organisations adopt change and realise value from digital products and services. 
You enjoy creating clarity around priorities and helping teams understand what successful adoption looks like. 
You understand how product, delivery, release, communication and business readiness need to work together. 
You have experience with organisational change, adoption, business readiness, product management, transformation or related disciplines. 
You can turn complex needs into practical guidance and simple, reusable ways of working. 
You take ownership and help move initiatives from discovery and planning through rollout, adoption and continuous improvement. 
You build strong relationships and collaborate confidently with stakeholders across product, engineering, service and business teams. 
You are comfortable using feedback, data and insights to understand adoption and guide improvements. 
You are curious, inclusive and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a complex, global environment. 
This is our wish list! If you do not recognize yourself in all these points, you might still be an excellent candidate for the role. 

The must-haves we see for this role are: 
Experience in product ownership, change management, business transformation, adoption or a related role. 
Experience helping teams introduce practical and consistent ways of working. 
Ability to collaborate across business, product and technology and build alignment among different stakeholders. 
An outcome-oriented approach and an interest in using feedback and data to understand adoption and value.

A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US

As Product Owner for Change Governance, you will help shape how the Digital Area prepares for and adopts change. Your focus will be to support teams in turning delivered products, services and improvements into sustained use, measurable value and lasting improvements in the way people work. 

This means that you will: 
Help shape and communicate the direction, roadmap and success measures for adoption, business readiness and value realisation. 
Develop and improve practical approaches, playbooks and ways of working that help teams prepare for, adopt and benefit from change. 
Help create clarity around roles, responsibilities and collaboration so that teams can deliver change effectively and consistently. 
Align business readiness and adoption plans with product roadmaps, release plans and delivery cycles. 
Enable consistent approaches to stakeholder engagement, communication, training, rollout and the embedding of new products, services and ways of working. 
Partner with product, engineering, service, communication and business teams to identify change impacts, dependencies, risks and readiness needs. 
Maintain and prioritise the work needed to strengthen adoption, supporting initiatives from discovery through implementation and sustained use. 
Contribute to objectives and key results, using evidence to track adoption, outcomes and areas for improvement. 
Support teams in applying common ways of working pragmatically while considering local business needs. 
Capture learning, share reusable practices and continuously improve how change is prepared for, introduced and embedded.

TOGETHER AS A TEAM

You will work in the Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area - Group Functions is built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across Group Functions and Global Business Operations. We develop and deliver digital products and services across areas such as Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, and Business Risk & Compliance. 

You will be part of the Standards & Governance team, which works across the Digital Area to create clarity, consistency and scalable ways of working. We help teams use practical common approaches that support high-quality delivery, speed and innovation. 

Within this team, your focus will be to help people and the organisation get value from change. This means strengthening business readiness, supporting adoption and ensuring that new products, services and ways of working become part of everyday operations. Product Communication helps people understand what is changing. This role helps ensure that the change is embraced, adopted and delivers lasting value for the business. 

We can offer you: 
The opportunity to shape how IKEA prepares for change, supports adoption and realises value across a global digital area. 
Meaningful problems with impact across multiple functions, platforms and user groups. 
A role that connects strategy, product delivery and business outcomes. 
A team of great colleagues to learn with and from. 
A flexible and friendly working environment with opportunities to have a global impact.

The role

At Axelerant, we believe the traditional handoff model , research to design to product to delivery , is no longer fit for purpose. AI tooling has collapsed the time between concept and working prototype, and the bottleneck has shifted from production to ownership. We are building for that reality. 

This is a new kind of role: the UX Product Owner, or UXPO. You are the single continuous thread connecting user intent to shipped value. You hold the story, the system, the design, and the sprint together , not as a coordinator, but as the person who owns all of it. You are not a designer who attends standups, and you are not a product owner who appreciates good UX. You are someone who does both, deeply, without losing fidelity in between. 

The work lives in overlapping loops , plan, prototype, calibrate, validate, ship, measure , and discovery feeds the backlog on a weekly cadence, not once at project kickoff. You will use AI tools to compress the concept-to-tested loop significantly, while knowing precisely where human judgment is irreplaceable. 

If you read a brief like this and think "that is already how I work," this seat is worth a conversation.

What you will own

Run end-to-end user research and translate insights directly into prioritized backlog items , no wall to throw them over 
Own the product narrative from discovery through deployment, maintaining context and continuity across every loop 
Design and iterate on systems thinking artifacts: user journeys, object models, and pattern libraries 
Write clear acceptance criteria and work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers throughout the sprint 
Build and test coded or high-fidelity prototypes rapidly using AI-assisted tooling
Manage and groom the product backlog, balancing user needs, business goals, and delivery constraints 
Establish a continuous discovery rhythm so research informs the backlog weekly rather than at project kickoff 
Identify where AI tooling accelerates the work and where human judgment must remain the deciding factor

What you bring

Proven experience spanning both UX design and product ownership , not adjacent exposure, but genuine depth in each 
Strong research practice: you can design, conduct, and synthesize user research, then act on it without an intermediary 
Fluency in systems-level thinking, including journey mapping, object modeling, and design system architecture 
Comfortable and credible in agile delivery contexts , backlog management, sprint ceremonies, and direct collaboration with engineering teams 
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping tools to accelerate the concept-to-tested loop 
Ability to write precise acceptance criteria that bridge design intent and development implementation
Track record of maintaining product coherence across fast-moving, iterative delivery cycles 
Clear communicator who can align stakeholders, advocate for users, and make prioritization trade-offs transparently

What you get

A role that is genuinely new , space to define and shape what great UXPO practice looks like 
Collaborative, supportive team environment at Axelerant 
Work at the frontier of AI-assisted product development with real ownership over outcomes

About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on, data-fluent Technical Product Owner – Product Analytics & Telemetry to serve as the single source of truth for our product performance, user adoption, and platform utilization.

In this role, you won't just manage a backlog, you will dig directly into complex datasets across Databricks, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, WalkMe, and Datadog to quantify the real-world impact of our Jira initiatives. You will bridge the gap between engineering telemetry, product instrumentation, and business strategy, building the dashboards and executive narratives that dictate our roadmap investments.

Core Responsibilities

Multi-Source Telemetry Extraction: Query, blend, and analyze data across diverse infrastructure layers—including Databricks Delta Lake, Snowflake, relational databases (PostgreSQL), in-app workflow telemetry (WalkMe), and operational logs (Datadog).
Lakehouse Dashboards & Visualization: Architect and maintain high-performance Databricks SQL dashboards and visualizations to track cohort adoption, funnel drop-offs, feature utilization, and user retention.
Initiative Quantification & ROI: Map downstream user telemetry directly back to Jira initiatives and epics. Measure feature rollout velocity against actual adoption metrics to validate product bets.
Executive Storytelling & Roadmapping: Synthesize raw analytical outputs into structured, executive-level presentations that highlight adoption bottlenecks, quantify platform usage, and drive prioritization.
Telemetry Governance & Instrumentation: Partner with core engineering and data platform teams to define event taxonomies, tracking specifications, and governance standards, ensuring features launch with production-ready telemetry.
Exploratory Data Discovery: Conduct proactive cohort and behavioral analyses to discover untapped user behavior, navigation friction, and platform optimization opportunities.

Required Experience & Skills

3–6+ years of hands-on experience in Senior Product Analyst, Product Analytics, or Analytics Engineering within a modern SaaS/cloud environment.
Advanced SQL: Proven mastery of complex SQL (window functions, recursive CTEs, query optimization, handling semi-structured JSON payloads) across relational (PostgreSQL) and distributed data lakehouses (Databricks, Snowflake).
Cross-System Data Fluency: Practical experience pulling or stitching disparate product data from application logs, clickstream tools, guidance software (WalkMe), and cloud storage (e.g., Azure Blob, S3).
Databricks Expertise: Strong familiarity working natively within the Databricks ecosystem (Databricks SQL, Lakeview dashboards, Delta tables).
Product Acumen & Agile Delivery: Solid understanding of modern product management frameworks, Jira project/initiative hierarchies, and KPI definitions (DAU/MAU, activation rates, cohort retention).
Executive Communication: Exceptional ability to build clean, persuasive decks and clearly present technical findings to non-technical leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Educational or applied background in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or Analytics Engineering.
Working knowledge of PySpark, Python for data manipulation, or dbt.
Experience operating within cloud ecosystems (Azure or AWS) and understanding Delta Lake architecture.
Experience defining user event tracking frameworks from scratch (e.g., event naming conventions, schema contracts).

About the role:

  • As an Associate Product Manager on the VMDR team, you'll help define how security and IT teams discover, assess, prioritize and remediate vulnerabilities across on-prem, cloud, container and remote assets. Success is measured in real risk reduction (TruRisk), not raw finding counts.
  • This role is for early-career problem-solvers with hands-on vulnerability management experience who want to grow into a full product manager. You'll own well-scoped features end to end and learn alongside senior PMs, engineering and Threat Research.

Key responsibilities:

1. Product definition and roadmap

  • Own and evolve well-scoped features in core VMDR modules such as Asset Discovery & Inventory, Vulnerability Detection (Cloud Agent, network scanners, passive sensors), TruRisk Prioritization (QDS, threat intel, CISA KEV, EPSS), Dashboards & Reporting, and Remediation (Patch Management, TruRisk Eliminate).
  • Collaborate with engineering to define product requirements and specifications: PRDs, user stories, prioritization logic, workflows, wireframe annotations and acceptance criteria.
  • Assist in developing the product roadmap and feature prioritization using frameworks such as RICE or MoSCoW, balancing customer asks, competitive gaps and engineering effort.
  • Groom the backlog in Jira, prioritize with engineering, QA and UX, and track delivery against quarterly release plans.

2. Vulnerability assessment and threat analysis

  • Perform hands-on vulnerability assessments: run authenticated and agent-based scans, review detections, investigate false positives/negatives and validate detection coverage.
  • Conduct threat analysis on high-impact CVEs and zero-days (exploit availability, ransomware and malware association, CISA KEV listing, EPSS trend) with Threat Research, and turn findings into detection and prioritization requirements.
  • Translate concepts such as CVSS vs. EPSS vs. QDS, asset criticality, toxic combinations, SLA breaches and MTTR into product features with measurable risk reduction.
  • Test and validate features before release: scans, detections, QQL queries, dashboards, reports and APIs.

3. Customer reporting and insight

  • Help design and generate vulnerability management reports for customers: executive TruRisk summaries
  • Partner with SMEs, SSAs/TAMs, support and customers to refine requirements, triage escalations, validate assumptions and iterate fast.
  • Define workflows for integrations with ServiceNow (ITSM/CMDB), Jira, SIEM/SOAR

4. Market research and competitive intelligence

  • Assist in market research to identify new opportunities and customer needs in vulnerability and exposure management (CTEM, attack surface management, cloud and container security).
  • Run competitive analysis against Tenable, Rapid7, Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, CrowdStrike Falcon Spotlight and exposure management platforms; maintain feature comparison matrices.
  • Stay current on industry trends and regulatory requirements affecting VM: NIST CSF/SP 800-40, PCI DSS v4.0, ISO 27001, SOC 2, SEC cyber disclosure rules, EU NIS2, DORA, CERT-In and DPDP Act (India).

5. Product collateral and enablement

  • Help prepare product collateral: user guides, FAQs, datasheets, release notes, solution briefs and demo scripts.
  • Create sales enablement content and support launches, webinars and customer demos.

You’ll use traces, customer feedback, and expert corrections to identify failures and create feedback loops that continuously improve the product.

Turn regulatory complexity into product behavior. Help translate written requirements across jurisdictions into structured rules that capture applicability, conditions, exceptions, deadlines, and dependencies. You’ll define requirements and validate behavior with experts so our agents can determine what a customer needs to do and drive the next steps.

Build and improve workflows yourself. Work alongside operations and subject matter experts to understand how tasks are performed, then build workflows using Commenda’s workflow builder. You’ll identify where agents can take over work, where human review adds value, and how to make the overall process faster and more reliable.

Design how customers, service providers, and agents work together. Our products support customers buying services from Commenda, working with third-party providers, and handling work in-house. You’ll define responsibilities, permissions, handoffs, approvals, and visibility so each participant knows what needs to happen and can trust the work being done.

Talk to customers, prototype, and prioritize. Lead product interviews and feedback sessions, use Claude Code or Codex to prototype user journeys, and test ideas before committing engineering effort. You’ll combine customer insight, product analytics, and evaluation results to make roadmap decisions and measure whether what we ship improves outcomes.

What we’re looking for
At least two years of product management experience, with examples of products or workflows you’ve taken from an ambiguous problem through launch and iteration.
Hands-on experience with AI evaluations. You’ve defined what good output or behavior looks like, evaluated results against that standard, and used failures to guide improvements. You understand that a compelling demo is only the beginning of building a reliable AI product.
Advanced proficiency with Claude Code or Codex. These tools are part of how you work. You can independently build prototypes, explore product ideas, and test workflows. You don’t need to know how to code, but you need to communicate effectively with engineers and define precise requirements.
Strong judgment about agentic user experiences. You can reason through what an agent should do autonomously, where people need control, and how users should understand progress, review work, and recover when something goes wrong.
Exceptional spoken and written English and a confident customer presence. You can lead interviews, ask precise questions, explain complex ideas clearly, and earn customers’ trust.
Strong ownership and organizational skills. You can coordinate work across engineering, internal and external domain experts, operations, and customer success, keep decisions and dependencies clear, and drive unresolved issues to completion.
A willingness to get into the details. You’re comfortable learning how work actually happens, investigating edge cases, configuring workflows yourself, and validating results with experts.
Familiarity with Figma and product analytics tools such as Mixpanel. You use prototypes and data to understand behavior, test assumptions, and make product decisions.
Curiosity and rigor in complex domains. You’re interested in developing a working knowledge of legal, tax, and regulatory requirements, checking assumptions, and preserving the details that determine the right outcome.

Experience shipping a customer-facing AI or agentic product is a plus, as is experience with Braintrust or another AI evaluation and observability platform. A background in tax, accounting, entity management, or compliance is helpful but not required.

About the team

We’re an ambitious, intense team spread across Bangalore, San Francisco, and Seattle. We work like a sports team: we practice, challenge each other, and take shared responsibility for winning. People here move quickly, form their own opinions, and take on problems without waiting to be assigned them.

AI is part of how we build every day. You’ll work alongside engineers and domain experts who use agents to tackle complex work, experiment with new tools, and push what the product can do. We value curiosity, imagination, and the willingness to turn an unconventional idea into something customers can use.

You’ll have real ownership early, direct access to the people making decisions, and room to grow as you prove what you can take on.

*Job Title:* Edge Management Platform (EMP)
*Job Function:* Technical Platforms & Infrastructure mandatory
*Experience:* Relevant experience in technical product management
*Employment Type:* Full-time
*Work Location:* Bangalore

*Immediate joiners within 30 days preferred. *

1. Role Overview

We are looking for a technically strong and customer-focused *Product Manager for an Edge Management Platform (EMP)* to drive the product strategy, roadmap, and evolution of a platform that simplifies application deployment and management across distributed infrastructure environments.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with technical platforms such as cloud infrastructure, virtualisation, hypervisors, Kubernetes, container platforms, or infrastructure management solutions.

Prior experience in Edge Computing is not mandatory. However, candidates must demonstrate strong technical platform understanding, sound product management capabilities, and the ability to translate complex infrastructure challenges into simple, scalable, and user-friendly product experiences.

The role requires a product owner who can make independent prioritisation decisions, understand customer needs, collaborate closely with engineering teams, and deliver measurable business and technical outcomes.

2. Key Responsibilities

* *Product Strategy & Roadmap:* Define and maintain the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and feature priorities in alignment with customer needs and business objectives.
* *Technical Platform Ownership:* Develop a strong understanding of the underlying infrastructure, including cloud platforms, hypervisors, Kubernetes, virtualisation, and application deployment technologies.
* *Customer Experience:* Identify opportunities to simplify application deployment, infrastructure management, monitoring, and operational workflows for application teams.
* *Self-Service & Automation:* Drive product capabilities such as self-service provisioning, API-based integrations, automated deployments, resource management, and lifecycle operations.
* *Product Prioritisation:* Evaluate competing requirements and balance new features against reliability, scalability, security, automation, and technical debt.
* *Engineering Collaboration:* Work closely with engineering, architecture, design, and operations teams to define requirements, evaluate dependencies, and guide implementation.
* *Stakeholder Management:* Gather and prioritise input from customers, engineering teams, business stakeholders, and other product teams.
* *Platform Reliability:* Ensure product decisions support operational visibility, failure handling, resilience, and consistent management across distributed environments.
* *Product Delivery & Outcomes:* Define success metrics, monitor adoption and performance, and use customer feedback and measurable results to improve the platform continuously.

3. Required Skills & QualificationsTechnical Skills

* 9+ years of experience
* Cloud platforms and infrastructure management.
* Virtualisation technologies and hypervisors.
* Kubernetes, containers, and orchestration platforms.
* Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) or Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS).
* Application deployment, monitoring, provisioning, and lifecycle management.
* Distributed systems, APIs, and automation frameworks.
* Understanding of how application platforms interact with underlying infrastructure.
* Ability to explain technical concepts and platform capabilities in simple, business-oriented language.

Product Management Skills

* Demonstrated ownership of product strategy, roadmap, prioritisation, and product decisions.
* Experience translating user problems into product features, requirements, and capabilities.
* Ability to balance customer requests, engineering constraints, technical improvements, and business priorities.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience defining product success metrics and evaluating outcomes.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will:

* Have worked as a Product Manager, Technical Product Manager, Platform Product Manager, or in a comparable product ownership role.
* Have hands-on exposure to infrastructure-related products or technically complex platforms.
* Demonstrate a clear understanding of platform users, their challenges, and the value delivered by the product.
* Show evidence of making product decisions rather than solely coordinating engineering delivery, managing sprints, or tracking project milestones.
* Be comfortable applying experience from cloud, Kubernetes, virtualisation, or infrastructure platforms to new problem spaces, including Edge Management.

*Note:* Direct Edge Computing experience is an advantage, not a mandatory requirement.

You are a builder at heart. You enjoy creating something from scratch, transforming ideas into tangible, high-impact products.

ABOUT FINKRAFT.AI 
Finkraft.ai is a B2B SaaS company that enables enterprises to maximise GST claims on travel and expense data. The Hotel vertical is our primary growth unlock for the next 18 months. This PM owns it. 
THE PROBLEM YOU ARE SOLVING 
A corporate employee books a hotel through a TMC or GDS. The booking passes through a PMS like Opera Cloud. The invoice is generated by the hotel, sometimes routed through a Concur integration or a bank lodge card program. By the time the finance team tries to claim GST on that invoice, the corporate GSTIN is missing, the folio is incomplete, the tax breakdown is wrong, or the invoice never arrived. 
This happens at scale across every enterprise client Finkraft serves. Your job is to understand every node in that chain — hotel, PMS, GDS, OTA, TMC, Concur, bank, payment player — and build the product that fixes it.

Full ecosystem map completed: every player in the hotel invoicing and GST chain documented — where data breaks, who owns the fix, and what Finkraft's integration surface is at each node. 
Field engagement calendar live: structured visit schedule across TMCs, hotel chains, corporates, and software companies — minimum 15 discovery meetings completed, findings structured into roadmap inputs. 
One PRD shipped to engineering: based on field findings and existing client pain, a product spec written, reviewed, and in active development. 
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
Product Strategy and Roadmap 
Own the end-to-end product strategy for the Hotel vertical: what gets built, in what sequence, and why 
Define the roadmap based on enterprise client pain, ecosystem partner signals, and competitive landscape — not internal assumptions 
Present roadmap to leadership, Sales, and enterprise clients at QBRs; defend prioritisation decisions with data and customer evidence 
Track roadmap delivery against committed timelines; own the gap between what was promised and what shipped

Extract structured product intelligence from every field meeting: integration documentation, data flow maps, GSTIN handling gaps, invoice format standards, and API availability 
Convert field findings into product inputs within 5 business days of every meeting — not raw notes, structured inputs 
Ecosystem Integration Ownership

Strong work management and organizational skills; ability to work from a backlog, coordinate multiple workstreams, track actions and dependencies, prioritize work, and communicate dependencies and tradeoff implications

Strong stakeholder communication skills; ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, platform administrators, vendors, and product leadership

Experience with product maintenance and testing, including supporting routine updates and enhancements, validating functionality through testing, and assessing whether changes continue to meet user needs

Title: Product Manager / Senior Product Manager

About INDmoney
INDmoney is a personal finance super app that helps millions of Indians track, invest and grow their money in one place. Users invest in US stocks, Indian stocks, mutual funds, IPOs and fixed deposits, and manage credit cards, loans and net worth from a single app.
About the role
Every day, thousands of users tell us what’s broken — through support tickets, app reviews, call transcripts, chatbot logs and drop-off data. Most companies route these to a backlog. We want one person who owns them end to end.
You’ll pick up a consumer problem, find out why it’s happening, and ship the fix — whatever shape the fix takes. Some days that’s a one-line change to an order status screen. Some days it’s a new state in a backend workflow, a rewrite of a help-centre article, a new macro or lookup tool for our support reps, or a process change with Ops and Compliance. You decide what the right fix is, get it built (or build it), and verify the problem actually went away.
You’ll work across Product, Engineering, Customer Support, Operations and Compliance, and report directly to product leadership. Your scorecard is simple: fewer tickets, faster resolutions, fewer users stuck.
What you’ll do
Mine CRM tickets, call recordings, chatbot transcripts, Play Store/App Store reviews and product analytics funnels to find the problems worth solving, and size them.
Run root-cause analysis: trace a user complaint back through app state, API responses, backend workflows and ops processes to the actual failure point.
Spec and ship fixes across the full stack of the problem: frontend copy and UI states, backend status handling, retry/edge-case logic, ops workflows, help-centre content and internal tools for CS reps.
Write clear, plain-language user-facing copy for error states, status screens and help articles.
Build or improve tools for the support team: dashboards, lookup views, canned responses, escalation flows.
Close the loop: instrument fixes, watch ticket volumes and funnels, and confirm the problem is gone before moving on.
Flag patterns upstream — if the same class of issue keeps recurring, drive the structural fix with the relevant product or engineering owner.
What we’re looking for
2–8 years in product, operations, support engineering, solutions engineering or a similar role where you owned problems end to end.
Comfortable with SQL; you can pull your own data from a warehouse without waiting on anyone.
Strong systems thinking: you can read an API response, follow a state machine, and reason about why a payment, order or KYC step got stuck.
Able to write a crisp spec and a crisp help article — and know which one the problem needs.
Evidence of shipping: you can point to things you fixed and the metric that moved.
High ownership and low ego. You’d rather solve the problem than argue about whose problem it is.
Nice to have
Experience at a broker, fintech or consumer app in India — familiarity with SEBI/RBI flows (KYC, DDPI, settlements, pay-in/pay-out, corporate actions) is a plus.
Can read code or write basic scripts (Python/JS) to prototype a tool or debug a flow.
Hands-on with CRM/ticketing, issue-tracking and product analytics tools.
Experience building internal tools or agent-facing workflows.
Exposure to LLM/chatbot tooling for support automation.
Why join
Real impact, fast. Your fixes will reach millions of investors and show up in ticket volumes within weeks.
Ownership. You own the problem from complaint to resolution, with direct access to the founders and senior leadership.
Growth. Competitive compensation with ESOPs, a learning budget and a team that ships every week.
Breadth. You’ll touch product, engineering, ops, compliance and support in a single role — a rare vantage point on how a fintech actually runs.
Visibility. The problems you solve are the ones leadership hears about most. Good work here is seen.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About The Job

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.
Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.
Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.
Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.
Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.
Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.
Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.

Mandatory:

5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)
3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry
Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.
Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.
Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.
Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.
Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.
Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.
Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io
We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About The Job

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.
Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.
Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.
Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.
Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.
Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.
Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.
Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.
Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.
Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.
Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.
Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.
Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.

Mandatory:

8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.
Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).
Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.
Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.
Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.
Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.
Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.
Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.
Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.
A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.

Role Overview

The immediate focus is platform release execution performed directly with R&D teams. This includes release readiness, technical improvements, security and compliance changes, infrastructure evolution, validation, retrofitting, and other work required to advance and maintain the platform. The TPM will operate under the mentorship of the lead Windchill+ Platform TPM while progressively assuming ownership of recurring backlog, dependency, and release-management responsibilities.

Over time, the role will expand into broader service-level improvements. The TPM will help define how platform capabilities affect the Windchill+ service experience and will apply Design for Operations thinking earlier in the development lifecycle. Design for Operations is an evolving practice within the organization, and this role will help establish practical ways to incorporate operational requirements, installed-base impacts, customer enablement, and service readiness into backlog definition.

Responsibilities

The responsibilities below represent a superset of the work this role may perform. Actual day-to-day focus will vary over the course of any given release and across releases. The TPM is not expected to perform all of these responsibilities all of the time, or to do so without support from the broader team.

Partner directly with Windchill+ Platform R&D teams to define, refine, prioritize, and maintain executable product backlogs.
Translate product, service, security, compliance, and operational requirements into clear deliverables, epics, stories, acceptance criteria, and release outcomes.
Own day-to-day TPM execution for assigned platform initiatives through discovery, planning, development, validation, and release.
Coordinate platform readiness for Windchill product releases, maintenance releases, security updates, supporting component changes, and installed-base retrofits.
Work with engineering and QA leads to assess technical approaches, dependencies, resource needs, delivery estimates, validation requirements, and release feasibility.
Lead backlog refinement and support sprint planning, PI planning, release planning, story acceptance, and TPM readouts with globally distributed Agile teams.
Manage work across Product Management, Platform R&D, QA, Cloud Engineering, operations, integrated products, and shared services, converting dependencies into explicit backlog and accountable ownership.
Facilitate technical discovery and design spikes when requirements, architecture, or operational impacts are not sufficiently understood.
Maintain a reliable view of planned, completed, deferred, and at-risk work; identify decisions and escalations early enough to protect delivery.
Balance urgent tactical needs with longer-term platform objectives and roadmap priorities.
Begin applying Design for Operations to assigned work by considering provisioning, configuration, monitoring, support, maintenance, security, upgrades, retrofitting, validation, and customer enablement during backlog definition.
Continuously strengthen technical and product-management expertise through hands-on collaboration, mentoring, and formal or self-directed learning.

Growth Opportunities

As experience and organizational practices mature, the TPM will expand from hands-on platform execution into broader service-level ownership:

Independently manage multiple platform workstreams across releases, including more complex cross-team and installed-base changes.
Lead selected Design for Operations assessments and help evolve the organization's methods, templates, and working practices.
Define how proposed capabilities change the experience for customers, administrators, partners, support teams, and service operators.
Own selected service improvements from definition through release, connecting the intended service experience to the required platform, automation, documentation, enablement, and operational backlog.
Partner with the Offering Owner on changes that affect the Service Guide, service catalog, customer commitments, or broader offering definition.

Experience writing deliverables, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements.

Ability to understand complex technical dependencies and drive decisions across multiple engineering and stakeholder teams.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with developers, architects, QA engineers, operations teams, Product Managers, and senior stakeholders.
Ability to work independently while maintaining alignment across globally distributed teams.

Preferred

Debound · Delhi NCR
You will sit between the engineering teams building our digital platforms and the project directors, client organisations and site teams who use them. Your job is to turn how infrastructure delivery actually works into specifications an engineering team can build against, and to keep what gets built honest to what was asked for.

What you'll own
Requirement gathering across a difficult stakeholder set. Project directors, resident engineers, client organisations and site teams each describe the same process differently. You will run the discovery, resolve the contradictions, and write the version everyone signs off on.
Specifications and acceptance criteria. Written clearly enough that an engineer can build from them and a reviewer can test against them.
Code and delivery review. Not as the approving engineer, but as the person who checks that what shipped matches what was specified, and who catches the edge cases nobody raised in the requirements session.
Feasibility judgement on AI features. Deciding what is genuinely deliverable, what is a demo dressed as a product, and how to phase the difference.
Translation in both directions. Explaining engineering constraints to non-technical stakeholders, and site realities to engineers who have never been to a project site.

What we're looking for
Requirements and elicitation experience. Evidence of specs you have written, acceptance criteria you have defined, and scope you have held. We are more interested in ambiguity you resolved than in features you listed.
A technical foundation strong enough to read code. A computer science degree, or several years shipping software before moving into product or analysis. You will not write production code, but you will read pull requests and judge whether an implementation matches its spec.
Written and spoken communication of a high standard. You will produce documents that go to senior stakeholders and to client organisations. Send us something you have written.
Working literacy in AI and agentic systems. Enough to challenge an estimate, evaluate a vendor claim, and understand why a demo that works on ten documents may not work on ten thousand.
Comfort with complex, regulated delivery environments. Structured processes, audit requirements and documentation standards should feel normal rather than obstructive.

Signals that would move you to the top of the list
Infrastructure, construction, EPC or PMC domain exposure — highways, bridges, railways, urban development, power, or water.
Experience with government or multilateral clients, and with the documentation and approval cycles they require.
Having worked on project monitoring, ERP, GIS or field-data-collection platforms.
Any hands-on work with LLM tooling, workflow automation, or data pipelines, however small.
Familiarity with BIM, DPR workflows, or construction supervision processes.

What this role is not
It is not a delivery or scrum-master role, and it is not roadmap authorship at a distance from the build. You will be in the detail: in requirement sessions, in the spec, in the pull request, and on site when that is what it takes to understand the problem.
Equally, it is not an engineering role. If you want to stay hands-on writing code, this will frustrate you.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from investors including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil, and Goldman Sachs, and was named one of America’s best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About The Role

Tax is where trust is won or lost. Every calculation, filing, and payment is a promise to our customers and to the agencies they answer to. As Rippling scales into the enterprise and expands globally, the Tax Platform is mission-critical infrastructure: it must be accurate, explainable, and reliable at a level most payroll systems were never designed for.

We’re looking for a Director of Product, based in Bangalore, to lead Rippling’s Global Tax Platform team. You’ll own the end-to-end system that calculates, files, and pays taxes globally — across employees and contractors, across every country we operate in, and across federal, state, and local jurisdictions.

The scope covers:

Calculation engine, including the multi-year effort to build Tax Foundry — an AI-enabled tax calculation and policy engine that replaces our third-party dependency. 
Filings and agency communications across all jurisdictions globally. 
Tax payments and reconciliation — accurate, on-time, and fully traceable. 
Upstream data audits and self-serve resolution so issues are caught before they block filings. 
In-product explainability so every tax value can be traced to its source inputs and rules. 
Enterprise readiness — multi-entity, multi-country, equity comp, and complex tax structures at scale. 

The goal is simple: no surprises. Customers should never be caught off guard by their tax data, and the team should never be pulled into reactive firefights during filing season.

What You Will Do

Own the vision and execution for the Tax Platform across calculation, filing, payments, and reconciliation globally. 
Lead a team of Senior Product Leads across calculation, filings, payments, data quality, and enterprise tax. 
Drive measurable improvements in filing accuracy, on-time payment rates, weekly data accuracy, customer self-serve, and enterprise escalations. 
Make the call on Tax Foundry while maintaining a credible third-party backup plan. 
Build opinionated, configurable workflows that reduce reliance on Tax Ops and CX. 
Partner with Engineering, Tax Ops, CX, Payroll, Compliance, Legal, and GTM to align expansion with platform architecture. 
Serve as a Senior Product Leader in Bangalore, operating tightly with leadership in San Francisco. 

What You Will Need

Serve as a senior product leader in Bangalore, operating tightly with leadership in San Francisco. 
12+ years of Product Management experience. 
Proven experience leading senior IC PMs across multiple teams. 
Experience owning complex, multi-surface platforms with regulatory, tax, or financial complexity. 
Strong systems thinker — you see primitives, not just features. 
Track record of shipping both 0-to-1 launches and scaled products used by large customer bases. 
Comfortable operating at multiple altitudes: strategy, architecture, UX, and execution rigor. 
Strong cross-functional leadership across engineering, tax/compliance, operations, and GTM. 
High ownership mindset — accountable for outcomes, not output. 
Exceptional written and verbal communication in a highly cross-functional, globally distributed role. 
Payroll, tax, accounting, or fintech experience is a strong plus. 
Strong alignment with our leadership principles: in particular, Go and See, and Are Right, a Lot. 

If you don’t necessarily meet all of the requirements listed here, we still encourage you to apply because skills can be used in lots of different ways, your life experience is equally important sometimes.

About the Company

Elevate Now is a doctor-led clinical weight loss platform in India. It diagnoses the underlying drivers of weight gain, such as insulin resistance, inflammation and hormonal imbalances, and delivers personalised treatment under medical supervision through a fully online, subscription-based model. Every member is paired with a physician trained in obesity medicine and a dedicated health coach, supported by blood diagnostics and continuous glucose monitoring.

The company has onboarded over 30,000 paying members and is backed by Physis Capital, W Health Ventures, Narayana Health and other early-stage investors.

Role Summary

Doctors are at the centre of the Elevate Now model. The quality of every consult, prescription and follow-up depends on how well the tools around them work. As Product Manager for Doctor Experience, you will own the products that physicians use every day, making it faster and easier for them to review a member’s data, make sound clinical decisions and stay in sync with the health coach and care team.

Success looks like more consults handled per doctor without a drop in quality, less time spent on admin and documentation, higher doctor satisfaction and retention, and better member outcomes and adherence as a result.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Own the roadmap for doctor-facing products, including the consult workflow, patient records and charts, prescriptions, follow-ups and care plans.

Build tools that improve collaboration between doctors, health coaches and support teams, including handoffs, escalations and shared notes.

Define and track metrics such as consult duration, doctor utilisation, documentation time, follow-up completion rate and doctor NPS.

Write clear PRDs and prioritise based on clinical impact, doctor productivity and member outcomes.

Experience in healthtech, digital health or a subscription-based care model.

Experience building with or evaluating AI tools in a clinical or documentation setting.

Experience in an early-stage startup where scope is broad and processes are still being built.

Work at the intersection of healthcare, product, and data, where growth improves access to medicines for real patients.
Collaborate closely with leadership, engineering, and operations in a fast-moving team.

Senior Product Manager
Zuddl is the unified event platform that B2B marketing teams at companies like CrowdStrike, Figma, Stripe, TikTok, Checkpoint, and Iterable use to run their most important conferences, field events, and webinars, all from one system. We're backed by Y Combinator, Alpha Wave, and Qualcomm Ventures, and we're going after every legacy player in a market that's being rebuilt from scratch.
About the Role
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who has owned a product end to end before, ideally as a founder, and who works largely on their own.
You'll own a major domain of the Zuddl platform that spans several modules. Examples are the full event workflow from registration through production and check-in, or the data and integration layer that connects events to a customer's CRM and marketing stack. You own the roadmap, the technical direction with engineering, and the outcomes for that domain. Leadership will challenge your thinking and add context when you ask for it, but won't set direction for you. You are expected to frame ambiguous problems, make hard tradeoffs, and drive complex cross-functional work without much intervention.
You should also be truly AI-native. At Zuddl, product work runs on AI: research, specs, data analysis, and prototypes that go from problem to something clickable in days. This is how you already work, and you think about where AI creates leverage in the product itself.
What You'll Own
Working with people
Be the primary driver for complex, high-impact initiatives that cut across modules
Lead cross-functional work across engineering, design, PMM, CS, Support, and Sales. Resolve disagreements and keep everyone aligned through ambiguity
Make difficult decisions under ambiguity, with strong independent product judgment
Building the roadmap
Form your own view of where Zuddl wins, loses, and should differentiate. Spot market changes that should change direction
Look past individual requests to find the systemic problems underneath, and decide which gaps deserve real investment
Understand not just what competitors built, but why, and where they're heading. Decide where we match, differentiate, or ignore
Prioritize major investments on your own and make the hard tradeoffs
Own your OKRs and the roadmap behind them, including how modules fit together as one platform
Building the feature
Bring strong customer intuition from repeated exposure to users and workflows. Form a sharp initial view, then use research to validate or challenge it
Frame complex, ambiguous problems well. Challenge the premise and reframe before the team commits to a solution
Write PRDs with clear justification for every call
Have strong judgment on where to match the market, where to differentiate, and where not to invest
Find the abstractions and platform investments that unlock multiple future features, without over-generalizing
Break complex initiatives into stages that reduce product, customer, and technical risk
Say no to low-leverage work, even under customer or internal pressure
Hold a very high bar for end-to-end workflows. Catch the subtle friction and inconsistency others miss
See second- and third-order consequences before they become customer or engineering problems
Shipping the feature
Own the release plan for complex or high-risk launches: feature flags, rollout cohorts, backwards compatibility, and first-time user experience
Anticipate what Sales, CS, Support, and Implementation will need, and drive enablement
Shape positioning for complex or strategic launches, grounded in customer, market, and competitive understanding
Work out why a launch is or isn't working, and decide the right response: product, UX, GTM, or enablement
Assess partnership and integration opportunities with external third parties
What We're Looking For
5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product end to end, from roadmap to execution
Founder or founder-like experience strongly preferred: you've built and owned a product with that level of ownership and speed
B2B SaaS experience is a must
Startup experience is required. You're comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and fast iteration
Experience at a marketing- or design-led company is a strong plus. So is event tech or martech
Truly AI-native: AI is your default for research, specs, data analysis, and prototyping, and you can show us how
You love technology and can hold detailed conversations with your engineering team. An engineering background is a bonus
You go deep on data and turn it into decisions
Excellent communicator and stakeholder manager. You tell the story well, listen to other views, and still drive the decision that's best for the customer and the business
Equally comfortable on the long-term vision, next week's release, and what went wrong with last month's launch
How You Operate
High agency: you turn business goals into execution plans without detailed direction
First-principles thinker, willing to challenge "how we've always done it"
Bias to action: you ship and iterate instead of waiting for perfect information
You surface risks early
Accountable: you own the wins and the misses
What Success Looks Like
Your domain has a clear roadmap the company trusts and a track record of shipping against it
Launches land well with customers, and Sales, CS, and Support are ready for them
Your decisions hold up, and the team needs little leadership intervention to move
Why You Want To Work Here
Competitive compensation
ESOPs
Remote working, with an option to rent coworking spaces
Flexible leave program
Home workstation setup allowance
A culture built on trust, transparency, and integrity
Ground floor opportunity at a fast-growing Series A startup

Our users do hard, regulated work: confirming how a bank process really runs, redesigning it, and deciding what to automate. The job is not to make that work look simple. It is to remove the labour that shouldn’t be there, keep the expert judgment that should, and make human review mean something.

Prototype with AI tools quickly enough to test ideas with users in days, and raise the team’s practice to match.

Intelligence layer at the core. You will be shaping the substrate that turns institutional knowledge into governed, production-grade operations. This is enterprise infrastructure with real consequences.
