About the Team

This role reports to the Director of Product Management, responsible for Product Adoption & Insights, NIVA (Nutanix Intelligent Virtual Agent), Customer Success, and Professional Services Strategy.

The team focuses on helping customers realize value faster through trusted adoption insights, AI-powered recommendations, customer success innovations, and strategic services offerings.

This role will be based in Bangalore, India, and follows a hybrid work model.

About the Company

Elevate Now is a doctor-led clinical weight loss platform in India. It diagnoses the underlying drivers of weight gain, such as insulin resistance, inflammation and hormonal imbalances, and delivers personalised treatment under medical supervision through a fully online, subscription-based model. Every member is paired with a physician trained in obesity medicine and a dedicated health coach, supported by blood diagnostics and continuous glucose monitoring.

The company has onboarded over 30,000 paying members and is backed by Physis Capital, W Health Ventures, Narayana Health and other early-stage investors.

Role Summary

A member’s journey depends on physical things reaching them on time and in the right condition: medicines, diagnostic kits and sample collection, and devices. As Product Manager for Logistics & Fulfillment, you will own the product layer behind all of it, from the moment an order is created to the moment it is delivered, collected or returned.

Success looks like faster and more reliable delivery, a lower cost per order, fewer fulfillment related support contacts, and ops teams who can run a growing order volume without adding headcount at the same rate.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Own the roadmap for the logistics and fulfillment product surface, including order management, dispatch, delivery partner integrations, tracking, and returns or reverse logistics.
Define, track and improve core metrics such as order to delivery turnaround time, on time delivery rate, first attempt delivery success, RTO and NDR rates, and cost per order.
Work closely with operations, pharmacy or warehouse teams and delivery partners to turn on-ground problems into clear product requirements and tooling.
Build and improve integrations and routing logic with courier partners and 3PLs, including serviceability checks, partner allocation, SLA tracking and fallback handling.
Design ops-facing tools such as exception queues, dashboards and automation that reduce manual follow-ups.
Improve the member-facing delivery experience: delivery status and notifications, rescheduling, address handling and issue reporting.
Partner with clinical and compliance stakeholders so that prescription-linked and handling-sensitive workflows are built into the fulfillment flow.
Write clear PRDs, prioritise ruthlessly, run experiments, and use data to decide what to build next.
Collaborate with engineering, design and data teams to ship quickly and iterate.

Requirements (Must-Haves)

3+ years of experience as a Product Manager.
Hands-on experience building logistics, delivery or fulfillment products, for example order management, last mile delivery, WMS or OMS tooling, courier or 3PL integrations, or shipment tracking.
Experience in e-commerce, quick commerce, e-pharmacy, marketplace or a similar operations-heavy consumer business.
Strong understanding of operational metrics and how product changes move them.
Comfortable working with ops and field teams and translating their problems into product solutions.
Working comfort with data (SQL or analytics tools) to analyse funnels, delays and costs.
Clear written communication and strong stakeholder management.

Benefits

Why Join Elevate Now
Own a high-impact growth charter with direct visibility into business outcomes.
Work at the intersection of healthcare, product, and data, where growth improves access to medicines for real patients.
Collaborate closely with leadership, engineering, and operations in a fast-moving team.

Search, indexing and query as a product surface: End-to-end ownership of how customers express and satisfy a query on Couchbase — SQL++ query, global secondary indexes, full-text search, and vector and hybrid search. The roadmap in your area, the PRFAQs and PRDs, the launch, the adoption, and the iteration after launch.

Retrieval for AI applications: Make Couchbase the retrieval layer that RAG applications and agents actually use — hybrid search relevance, metadata filtering, recall and freshness, and cost per query. Working backwards from the customer: Start with the customer and work backwards. Write the PRFAQ before any code is written. Validate with real, named enterprise customers. Make clear tradeoff calls about what to build and what to defer based on what the enterprise ICP universally needs — not features chasing competitors or one-off requests outside the ICP.

Engineering partnership: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the query, indexing and search engineering teams. Earn their trust by being technically credible, decisive on scope, and clear on the why. Let’s build something epic together.

To support this vision, we are evolving our software delivery model through a DevSecOps approach, embedding security, automation, and operational excellence across the software lifecycle.

This role focuses on enabling engineering teams to deliver software faster, more securely, and with greater reliability through platform capabilities, standardised pipelines, and integrated security practices.

Role Overview

The Product Owner – DevSecOps is responsible for defining and prioritising the backlog for DevSecOps capabilities, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, security controls, and developer enablement services.

The role acts as the bridge between engineering, security, platform, and business stakeholders, ensuring that DevSecOps investments deliver measurable improvements in delivery velocity, quality, security, and compliance.

Own and prioritise the DevSecOps backlog, aligning with platform strategy, security requirements, and engineering needs.
Define and sequence features such as CI/CD pipelines, IaC capabilities, environment provisioning, and security tooling.

Program Increment (PI) Planning & Delivery
Lead backlog refinement and planning activities for Program Increments, ensuring clear, prioritised, and outcome-driven deliverables.
Ensure features deliver measurable improvements in automation, standardisation, and developer experience.

Security & Compliance Integration
Drive the inclusion of security controls (e.g., scanning, secrets management, policy-as-code) into delivery pipelines.
Ensure alignment with enterprise compliance frameworks and audit requirements (e.g., ISO, governance standards).

Platform & Enablement Focus
Prioritise initiatives that enable self-service, reusable “golden paths,” and standardised DevSecOps patterns across teams.
Balance platform standardisation with product team flexibility and adoption.

Technical Alignment & Architecture Enablement
Collaborate with architects and technical leads to support architectural runway, including infrastructure modernisation, pipeline standardisation, and reduction of technical debt.
Ensure adequate backlog allocation for platform capabilities and engineering enablement.

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication
Act as the primary interface between DevSecOps teams and stakeholders across engineering, security, and leadership.
Provide clear visibility into priorities, progress, risks, and outcomes.

Value Delivery & Continuous Improvement
Define success metrics (e.g., deployment frequency, lead time, security posture, incident reduction).
Continuously refine priorities based on feedback, adoption, and performance data.

4+ years’ experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role in software delivery environments.
Experience working with DevOps or DevSecOps practices, including CI/CD, cloud platforms, or infrastructure automation.
Proven experience working within Agile frameworks (SAFe, Scrum, etc.).
Experience delivering platform or enablement capabilities (preferred).

Skills Required

Job Title: Dairy Product Manager

Location: India


Purpose of the Role

The Dairy Product Manager will play a key role in strengthening and growing De Heus Indias dairy business.

We are looking for a business-oriented and field-driven dairy specialist who can connect market and customer needs with nutrition, formulation, product positioning and commercial execution.

This role is not only about technical product management. It requires someone who understands dairy farmers and the Indian market, can translate technical knowledge into practical solutions, and can motivate and strengthen our commercial organization.

The ultimate goal is to build stronger product competitiveness, sustainable volume growth, improved NAV and profitability, while developing stronger technical capabilities within the organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage the dairy product portfolio in line with market needs and De Heus strategy.
  • Understand the needs of dairy farmers, dealers and customers and translate them into practical product concepts, feeding solutions and technical advice.
  • Work closely with Nutrition and Formulation teams to improve product performance, consistency and cost competitiveness.
  • Identify opportunities to improve COGS and formulation flexibility without compromising product quality or animal performance.
  • Support the Commercial team with product positioning, technical selling and clear customer value propositions.
  • Regularly visit farms, dealers and markets to understand customer needs, competitor activities and changing market conditions.
  • Be hands-on and practical in the field, including farm troubleshooting and direct customer support when required.
  • Benchmark De Heus dairy products against key competitors in terms of performance, specification, price and customer value.
  • Develop and strengthen technical tools, product claims, proof points and practical concepts to support sales growth.
  • Support new product development and continuous improvement of existing products based on market opportunities and customer feedback.
  • Work closely with Purchasing, Quality, Operations, Nutrition and Formulation teams to identify and evaluate new raw materials and by-products that can strengthen product and cost competitiveness.
  • Provide technical training and coaching to Sales teams, Senior Consultants, dealers and key customers.
  • Motivate and strengthen the technical and commercial capabilities of the field organization.
  • Support major customer visits, farm troubleshooting and important technical discussions.
  • Monitor dairy market trends, milk economics, feed trends, competitor activities and farmer profitability.
  • Maintain close communication with the De Heus Asia Hub and Global Ruminant team, sharing market insights and applying relevant De Heus concepts and expertise in India.
  • Actively embrace, adapt and implement De Heus concepts, philosophy and technical know-how in the Indian market.
  • Contribute directly to the dairy business strategy, volume growth, NAV improvement and profitability.

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong technical background in dairy nutrition, ruminant nutrition or animal nutrition.
  • Solid experience and practical understanding of the Indian dairy feed market.
  • Good understanding of dairy farmers, dealer networks and commercial dynamics.
  • Ability to connect technical knowledge with business and commercial realities.
  • Strong understanding of feed formulation, raw materials and cost competitiveness.
  • Practical, hands-on and field-oriented mindset someone who is comfortable working directly with farmers, animals, feed and field teams.
  • Strong commercial mindset, with a clear focus on customer value and profitable growth.
  • Proactive attitude and strong ownership able to identify issues and opportunities and drive actions without waiting for direction.
  • Strong communication, influencing and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to train, coach and motivate Sales teams and Senior Consultants.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Commercial, Nutrition, Formulation, Purchasing, Quality and Operations.
  • Strong problem-solving capability and willingness to take responsibility for results.
  • Willingness to learn, embrace and apply De Heus concepts and philosophy.
  • Good working English communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with the Asia Hub and Global teams.

Preferred Background

  • Degree in Animal Nutrition, Veterinary Science, Dairy Science, Animal Science or a related field.
  • Several years of relevant experience in the dairy feed / animal nutrition industry.
  • Experience with a leading feed, nutrition or dairy company would be an advantage.
  • Strong field experience working directly with dairy farms, customers and commercial teams.
  • Existing network within the Indian dairy industry would be highly valuable.
  • Experience in technical training, product management or commercial technical support would be an advantage.

Key Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Improvement in dairy product competitiveness.
  • Sustainable improvement in dairy volume, NAV and profitability.
  • Stronger technical and commercial support to the Sales organization.
  • Successful product and formulation improvements.
  • Improvement in COGS competitiveness and formulation flexibility.
  • Better customer retention and conversion.
  • Stronger technical capability within the Sales and Senior Consultant teams.
  • Increased speed and quality of market feedback into product and formulation decisions.
  • Successful implementation of relevant De Heus concepts and technical know-how in the Indian market.
  • Development of a stronger, differentiated and more competitive dairy portfolio.

Reporting & Collaboration

The Dairy Product Manager will work closely with the Managing Director, Commercial, Nutrition, Formulation, Purchasing, Quality and Operations teams, as well as the De Heus Asia Hub and Global Ruminant team.


The role will act as a key bridge between:

Market & Customer Commercial Product & Nutrition Formulation & Raw Materials Operations

The Dairy Product Manager is expected to bring market reality into product decisions and translate De Heus technical knowledge into practical commercial value for Indian dairy farmers and customers.


In Short

We are looking for someone who understands dairy technically, understands the Indian market commercially, is practical and proactive in the field, can motivate and develop our people, and can turn this knowledge into stronger products, customer value and profitable growth.
